Name: Belt of Stoneskin
Description: This belt grants the wearer the effects of stoneskin once per day. The effect lasts for up to 10 minutes and absorbs up to 120 points of damage before being discharged. The wearer must supply the material component when activating the belt.

Name: Belt of Physical Perfection +4
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, bear’s endurance

Name: Belt of Physical Might +6
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +6 enhancement bonus to two physical ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution), chosen at creation.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, bear’s endurance

Name: Shadowform Belt
Description: This belt allows the wearer to assume a shadowy, incorporeal form as a standard action. While in this form, the wearer gains concealment (20% miss chance), can move through solid objects as if incorporeal (but must end her turn in an open space), and gains a fly speed of 40 feet (good maneuverability). The wearer can remain in shadowform for up to 10 minutes per day, which need not be consecutive.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, shadow walk, gaseous form

Name: Belt of Physical Perfection +6
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +6 enhancement bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, bear’s endurance

Name: Robe of Stars
Description: This garment is typically black or dark blue and embroidered with small white or silver stars. The robe has 6 tiny white stars that can be plucked off and thrown up to 70 feet. Each functions as a +5 shuriken and dissipates after it hits or misses. In addition, once per day the wearer can use plane shift upon herself only. The robe also grants a +1 luck bonus on all saving throws.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, magic missile, plane shift

Name: Robe of Gates
Description: This robe appears to be an ordinary garment. Once per week, the wearer can use gate (travel version only). The wearer can use the robe only to open a portal for planar travel and cannot call creatures.

Name: Otherworldly Kimono
Description: This elaborate kimono grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can transform into an incorporeal spirit form for up to 10 rounds. While incorporeal, the wearer gains a fly speed of 60 feet (good maneuverability) and can move through solid objects, but must end her turn in an open space.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, ethereal jaunt, eagle’s splendor

Name: Bodywrap of Mighty Strikes +5
Description:
This long cloth is wrapped around the chest multiple times like a bandage. Once per round, the wearer may add an enhancement bonus of +1 to +5 on one attack and damage roll for an unarmed strike or natural attack (for one specific attack, not all attacks made with an unarmed strike that round). The wearer may use this item an additional time per round when his BAB reaches +6, +11, and +16.
Choosing to enhance an unarmed strike is not an action and may occur when it is not the wearer’s turn (such as when making an attack of opportunity). The wearer must decide to use the item before the attack roll is made, but does not have to expend all uses at the same time.
Additionally, the bodywrap can grant melee weapon special abilities to a creature’s unarmed attacks, so long as those special abilities to be added apply to unarmed attacks. Special abilities count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of the item, but do not modify attack or damage bonuses. Any special abilities are set at the time of creation.
A bodywrap of mighty strikes cannot have a modified bonus (enhancement bonus plus special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +7.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator's caster level must be at least three times the bodywrap's bonus, plus any requirements of the melee weapon special abilities

Name: Resplendent Robe of the Thespian
Description: This robe grants the wearer a +6 enhancement bonus to Charisma. In addition, the wearer gains a +10 competence bonus on Perform checks. Once per day, as a standard action, the wearer can fascinate creatures within 30 feet as though using the bard’s fascinate ability (Will DC 18 negates).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, charm monster, eagle’s splendor

Name: Robe of the Archmagi
Description: This robe functions as +5 armor that does not hinder spellcasting. The wearer gains spell resistance 18. The robe is available in white, gray, or black; white robes function only for good-aligned wearers, black only for evil-aligned wearers, and gray for neutral wearers. If worn by someone of the wrong alignment, the robe loses its magic.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, spell resistance, creator must be of same alignment

Name: Bodywrap of Mighty Strikes +6
Description: This bodywrap functions as other bodywraps of mighty strikes, allowing enhancement bonuses to unarmed strikes and natural attacks. The total modified bonus (enhancement plus special ability equivalents) cannot exceed +7.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator's caster level must be at least three times the bodywrap's bonus

Name: Robe of Eyes
Description: This robe is embroidered with small eye designs. The wearer gains darkvision 120 feet and can see invisible and ethereal creatures. The wearer gains a +10 competence bonus on Perception checks. The robe negates blur, displacement, and similar concealment effects within 120 feet.

Name: Bodywrap of Mighty Strikes +7
Description: This bodywrap functions as other bodywraps of mighty strikes, granting enhancement bonuses and special abilities to unarmed strikes and natural attacks. The total modified bonus cannot exceed +7.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator's caster level must be at least three times the bodywrap's bonus

Name: Merciful Baldric
Description: This baldric grants the wearer the ability to deal nonlethal damage without penalty. When using a melee weapon, the wearer can choose to have the weapon gain the merciful weapon special ability. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can grant all melee weapons she wields the merciful special ability for 1 minute.

Name: Mantle of Faith
Description: This thick mantle grants the wearer damage reduction 5/evil if good-aligned, 5/good if evil-aligned, or 5/chaotic if lawful-aligned (and vice versa). The wearer must have a non-neutral alignment to gain this benefit.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, shield of faith

Name: Mantle of Spell Resistance
Description: This mantle grants the wearer spell resistance 21.

Name: Eyes of Charming
Description: These crystal lenses grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks. Once per day, the wearer can use charm monster (caster level 13th).

Name: Monocle of the Investigator
Description: This single glass lens grants the wearer a +10 competence bonus on Perception checks and Sense Motive checks. Once per day, the wearer can use analyze dweomer (caster level 13th).

Name: Sea Tyrant’s Patch
Description: This black eye patch grants the wearer blindsight 30 feet and water breathing while worn. Once per day, the wearer can use control water (caster level 13th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, control water, water breathing

Name: Swordmaster’s Blindfold
Description: This black silk blindfold grants its wearer blindsight 60 feet. While wearing the blindfold, the wearer is considered blinded beyond 60 feet but gains a +4 insight bonus to AC and on attack rolls against creatures within 60 feet.

Name: Mindmaster’s Eyes
Description: These crystalline lenses grant the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Intelligence and a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma. Once per day, the wearer can use dominate person (caster level 15th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, dominate person, fox’s cunning, eagle’s splendor

Name: Eyes of the Dragon
Description: These glowing lenses grant the wearer darkvision 120 feet and low-light vision. In addition, once per day, the wearer can use dragon’s breath (caster level 15th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, dragon’s breath, darkvision

Name: Truesight Goggles
Description: These lenses grant the wearer continuous true seeing (caster level 15th).

Name: Slippers of the Triton
Description: These sea-green slippers grant the wearer a swim speed of 60 feet and the ability to breathe water. The wearer can move through water without penalty and gains a +8 competence bonus on Swim checks. Once per day, the wearer can use control water (caster level 15th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, control water, water breathing

Name: Horseshoes of Crushing Blows +4
Description: These iron horseshoes grant the creature wearing them a +4 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with hoof attacks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, greater magic fang

Name: Horseshoes of Crushing Blows +5
Description: These iron horseshoes grant the creature wearing them a +5 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with hoof attacks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, greater magic fang

Name: Talons of Leng
Description: These black, razor-sharp talons grant the wearer two claw attacks that each deal 1d6 points of slashing damage (1d4 if Small). These are primary natural attacks. The wearer can use these claws in addition to any other natural attacks she possesses. In addition, three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause her claws to deal an additional 2d6 points of negative energy damage for 1 round.

Name: Gauntlets of the Weaponmaster
Description: These gleaming gauntlets grant the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength and a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls made with any manufactured weapon. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +4 competence bonus on damage rolls with manufactured weapons for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bull’s strength, heroism

Name: Judge’s Wig
Description: This curled white wig grants the wearer a +10 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks. The wearer can detect lies at will (as the spell, Will DC 16 negates). Three times per day, the wearer can pronounce judgment upon a creature within 60 feet; the target must succeed at a Will save (DC 19) or be affected as though by geas/quest (caster level 13th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, detect lies, geas/quest

Name: Helm of Teleportation
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 244, Core Rulebook pg. 518
Description: This helm allows the wearer to use teleport three times per day.

Name: Halo of Menace
Description: This glowing halo radiates an aura of menace. Enemies within 20 feet must succeed at a Will save (DC 18) or take a –2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and AC for as long as they remain within the area and for 1d4 rounds thereafter. A creature that successfully saves is immune to that halo’s effect for 24 hours.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, unholy aura or holy aura

Name: Mask of Giants, Greater
Description: This mask transforms the wearer into a Huge giant (as enlarge person, except the wearer’s type changes to giant). The transformation lasts for up to 10 minutes per day, which need not be consecutive.

Name: Helm of Brilliance
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 244, Core Rulebook pg. 518
Description: This polished steel helm is set with gems that glow faintly. The helm grants fire resistance 30. It has 10 rubies and 10 diamonds. Each ruby can be used to produce one fireball (caster level 10th), and each diamond can be used to produce one wall of fire (caster level 10th). If all the gems are removed, the helm loses its magical properties.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, fireball, wall of fire

Name: Helm of Electric Radiance
Description: This crackling helm grants the wearer electricity resistance 30. Once per day, the wearer can unleash a chain lightning effect (caster level 15th, Reflex DC 19 half).

Name: Crown of Heaven
Description: This radiant golden crown sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius. The wearer gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws and a +4 sacred bonus on attack rolls against evil creatures. Once per day, the wearer can use sunburst (caster level 17th, Reflex DC 22 partial).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, sunburst, holy aura

Name: Headband of Mental Resilience
Description: This iron-banded circlet reinforces the wearer’s mind against mental intrusion. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects. In addition, once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can automatically succeed at a saving throw against a mind-affecting effect.

Name: Headband of Mental Superiority +4
Description: This simple metal headband grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, eagle’s splendor, fox’s cunning, owl’s wisdom

Name: Headband of Aerial Agility +6
Description:
This headband is decorated with feathers from a number of colorful birds. It grants boons to flying magic, and more powerful versions grant the power of flight. The wearer of a headband of aerial agility +2 treats his caster level as if it were one level higher when casting spells or creating extracts that grant flight. A headband of aerial agility +4 gains the same benefits and, on command, grants the wearer the ability to fly (as the fly spell) three times per day. A headband of aerial agility +6 functions like a +4 version, but the headband grants the ability to use fly at will.
All versions also grant the wearer an enhancement bonus to one mental ability score (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma) of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn. This bonus is chosen when the headband is created and cannot be changed. If the headband grants a bonus to Intelligence, it also grants skill ranks as a headband of vast intelligence.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, Extend Spell, fly

Name: Headband of Mental Prowess +6
Description:
This simple copper headband has a small yellow gem set so that when it rests upon the forehead of the wearer, the yellow gem sits perched on the wearer’s brow as if it were a third eye in the middle of her forehead. The headband grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to two mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma) of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn.
These bonuses are chosen when the headband is created and cannot be changed. If the headband grants a bonus to Intelligence, it also grants skill ranks as a headband of vast intelligence.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, eagle’s splendor, fox’s cunning, owl’s wisdom (any two)

Name: Headband of Mental Superiority +6
Description: This simple metal headband grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, eagle’s splendor, fox’s cunning, owl’s wisdom

Name: Amulet of Natural Armor +5
Description: This amulet, usually crafted from bone or beast scales, toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor bonus of +5.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, creator’s caster level must be at least three times the amulet’s bonus

Name: Amulet of Mighty Fists +4
Description: This amulet grants its wearer a +4 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with unarmed attacks and natural weapons.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator’s caster level must be at least three times the amulet’s bonus

Name: Amulet of Mighty Fists +5
Description: This amulet grants its wearer a +5 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with unarmed attacks and natural weapons.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator’s caster level must be at least three times the amulet’s bonus

Name: Amulet of the Planes
Description: This device usually appears to be a black circular amulet, although any character looking closely at it can see a dark, moving swirl of color like a miniature planar vortex. The amulet allows its wearer to utilize the plane shift spell. However, this is a difficult item to master. The user must make a DC 15 Intelligence check to get the amulet to function properly. Failure means the amulet transports the wearer and all those traveling with him to a random plane (as determined by the GM).

Name: Ring of friend shield
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 170, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring is linked to another ring of friend shield. When a pair is created, the rings are attuned to each other. If one wearer takes damage, half of that damage (rounded down) is transferred to the other wearer, provided both are on the same plane and within 100 feet of each other. The transfer occurs automatically and requires no action. If either ring is removed, the effect ends until the ring is worn again.

Name: Ring of protection +5
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 173, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring grants a +5 deflection bonus to AC.

Name: Ring of shooting stars
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 174, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description:
This ring has four modes of operation, activated at will unless otherwise noted.

• Dancing lights (at will).
• Light (at will).
• Faerie fire (2/day).
• Ball lightning (1/day): The wearer can release up to four balls of lightning, one per round as a standard action. Each ball deals 3d6 points of electricity damage (Reflex DC 14 half) to a target within 120 feet.
• Shooting stars (1/day): The wearer can fire up to five missiles of light as a full-round action. Each missile requires a ranged touch attack and deals 4d12 points of electricity damage.

Only one mode may be used at a time.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, dancing lights, faerie fire, lightning bolt

Name: Ring of spell storing
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 174, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: A ring of spell storing contains up to five levels of spells that the wearer can cast. The ring must be attuned to the wearer. Any spellcaster can cast a spell of 1st through 5th level into the ring by touching it as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring is attuned to the wearer, she can cast any spell stored in it as if she had cast the spell herself. Once cast from the ring, the spell disappears.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, imbue with spell ability

Name: Ring of continuation
Description: This ring allows the wearer to extend the duration of beneficial spells affecting her. Once per day as a free action when a spell with a duration of at least 1 round that is affecting the wearer expires, she can extend that spell’s duration by 1 minute. The spell must have originally been cast on the wearer and must not have a duration of instantaneous or permanent.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, extend spell, persistent spell

Name: Ring of inner fortitude, greater
Description: This ring grants the wearer immunity to fatigue and exhaustion effects. In addition, once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can remove the fatigued or exhausted condition from herself.

Name: Ring of wizardry III
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: This ring allows a wizard to prepare extra spells. It doubles the number of 3rd-level spells a wizard can prepare each day. This ring does not grant extra spells to other arcane spellcasters, even if they prepare spells (such as magi).

Name: Spiritualist rings
Description: These rings are crafted in pairs and are typically worn by a spiritualist and her phantom. While both rings are worn, the phantom gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and Charisma. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the spiritualist can allow her phantom to use her own saving throw bonuses in place of the phantom’s for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have the phantom class feature

Name: Ring of telekinesis
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: This ring allows the wearer to use telekinesis on command (CL 9th). The effect functions as the spell telekinesis. The ring can be used at will.

Name: Ring of regeneration
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 173, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring continually grants the wearer regeneration 1. The wearer regains 1 hit point per round. Damage dealt by fire or acid suppresses this regeneration for 1 round. The wearer can regrow lost limbs as if under the effects of regenerate, though the limb must be reattached within 2d10 minutes.

Name: Ring of spell turning
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 174, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: This ring reflects 1d4+6 levels of spells back at the caster as if under the effects of spell turning. The reflected spells must directly target the wearer. Once the total spell levels are exceeded, the ring becomes inert.

Name: Ring of wizardry IV
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: This ring allows a wizard to prepare extra spells. It doubles the number of 4th-level spells a wizard can prepare each day. This ring does not grant extra spells to other arcane spellcasters, even if they prepare spells (such as magi).

Name: Ring of three wishes
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 174, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: This ring contains three wishes. Upon creation, the ring is granted 1d3 wishes (roll d3). Each wish is cast as the spell wish. When all wishes are used, the ring becomes a nonmagical band.

Name: Ring of djinni calling
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 169, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring is made of silver and set with a large opal. Once per day, the wearer can summon a djinni as if using summon monster VII. The djinni serves the wearer for up to 1 hour. The ring can also be used once per day to grant one wish from the summoned djinni. After granting three wishes total, the ring loses its magical properties.

Name: Ring of elemental command
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 170, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring comes in four varieties (air, earth, fire, or water). Each grants control over its associated element. The wearer can use various spell-like abilities depending on the ring type, including elemental resistance 30, elemental body, and summoning elementals. If the wearer defeats a powerful elemental creature of the ring’s type, the ring’s powers increase, granting additional spell-like abilities.

Name: Ring of spell storing, major
Description: A major ring of spell storing contains up to ten levels of spells that the wearer can cast. The ring must be attuned to the wearer. Any spellcaster can cast a spell of 1st through 9th level into the ring by touching it as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring is attuned to the wearer, she can cast any spell stored in it as if she had cast the spell herself. Once cast from the ring, the spell disappears.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, imbue with spell ability

Name: Rod of Absorption
Description:
This rod absorbs spells or spell-like abilities into itself. The magic absorbed must be a single-target spell or a ray directed at either the character holding the rod or her gear. The rod nullifies the spell’s effect and stores its potential until the wielder releases this energy in the form of spells of her own. Absorption requires no action if the rod is in hand. The wielder can instantly detect the spell’s level as the rod absorbs that spell’s energy.

A running total of absorbed (and used) spell levels is tracked. The wielder can use captured spell energy to cast any spell she has prepared without expending the prepared spell. Restrictions: stored spell energy must be equal to or greater than the level of the spell to be cast; any material components required for the spell must be present; and the rod must be in the wielder’s hand when she casts the spell.

For spontaneous casters who do not prepare spells, the rod’s energy can be used to cast any spell of the appropriate level or levels that they know.

A rod of absorption can absorb a maximum of 50 spell levels and thereafter can only discharge any remaining potential. The rod cannot be recharged. The wielder knows the rod’s remaining absorbing potential and current amount of stored energy.

To determine the absorption potential remaining in a newly found rod, roll d% and divide the result by 2. Then roll d% again; on a result of 71–100, half the levels already absorbed by the rod are still stored within.

Name: Rod of Flailing
Description:
On command, this rod activates, changing from a normal-seeming rod to a +3/+3 dire flail. The dire flail is a double weapon; each head can be used to attack. The wielder can gain an extra attack with the second head at the cost of making all attacks at a –2 penalty (as if she had the Two-Weapon Fighting feat).

Once per day, as a free action, the wielder can cause the rod to grant her a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws for 10 minutes. The rod need not be in weapon form to grant this benefit.

Transforming the rod into a weapon or back into a rod is a move action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Rod, bless

Name: Metamagic Rod (Normal, +3 Spell Level)
Description: This normal metamagic rod is a metamagic rod that applies a metamagic feat with a +3 spell level adjustment to spells of 6th level or lower, without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The specific feat depends on the rod variant (for example, Maximize Spell or Widen Spell).

Name: Rod of Rulership
Description:
This rod looks like a royal scepter worth at least 5,000 gp in materials and workmanship alone. As a standard action, the wielder can command the obedience and fealty of creatures within 120 feet. Creatures totaling 300 Hit Dice can be ruled. Creatures with Intelligence scores of 12 or higher each are entitled to a DC 16 Will save to negate the effect. Ruled creatures obey the wielder as if she were their absolute sovereign.

If the wielder gives a command contrary to the nature of the creatures commanded, the magic is broken.

The rod can be used for 500 total minutes before it crumbles to dust. This duration need not be continuous.

Name: Rod of Security
Description: This rod creates a nondimensional space, a pocket paradise. The rod’s possessor and up to 199 other creatures can stay there in complete safety for a period of time—up to 200 days divided by the number of creatures affected (fractions rounded down). While within the pocket paradise, creatures don’t age, and natural healing takes place at twice the normal rate. Fresh water and food (fruits and vegetables only) are abundant. The climate is comfortable for all creatures present. When the duration expires, all occupants return to the place from which they entered.

Name: Rod of Shadows
Description: This ebon rod is so dark it seems to absorb the light around it. It functions as a +2 light mace. While wielding it, the wielder can see in darkness as if she had the see in darkness ability. Three times per day, the wielder can use it to create a deeper darkness effect (caster level 8th). To use this ability, the wielder must touch the target object, which is a standard action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, deeper darkness, true seeing

Name: Rod of Mind Mastery
Description:
This rod is a simple, unadorned piece of clear crystal that has been magically hardened. While holding the rod, the wielder is under a constant nondetection effect, as the spell. In addition:

• Three times per day on command, the wielder can use detect thoughts as the spell.
• Once per day as an immediate action, the wielder may determine whether someone is lying to her, as the discern lies spell.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, detect thoughts, discern lies, nondetection

Name: Rod of Lordly Might
Description:
This rod has spell-like functions usable once per day, and also can be used as various magic weapons and tools. Pushing any button is an action equivalent to drawing a weapon.

Once per day spell-like functions:
• Hold person on a touched creature (Will DC 14 negates). The wielder chooses to use this power (free action) and must succeed at a melee touch attack; if the attack fails, the effect is lost.
• Fear upon all enemies viewing it (10-foot maximum range; Will DC 16 partial). Standard action.
• On a successful touch attack, deal 2d4 hit points of damage (Will DC 17 half) and cure the wielder of the same amount; the wielder must choose to use this power before attacking as with hold person.

Unlimited-use weapon forms:
• Normal form: +2 light mace.
• Button 1: +1 flaming longsword.
• Button 2: +4 battleaxe.
• Button 3: +3 shortspear or +3 longspear; handle can be lengthened up to 12 feet, for an overall length of 6 to 15 feet. At 15 feet, it is suitable for use as a lance.

Unlimited-use utility functions:
• Button 4: climbing pole/ladder. A spike and hooks deploy; the rod lengthens to anywhere between 5 and 50 feet in a single round, stopping when button 4 is pushed again. Horizontal bars fold out 1 foot apart in a staggered progression. The rod is held by spike and hooks and can bear up to 4,000 pounds. The wielder can retract the climbing pole by pushing button 5.
• The ladder function can be used to force open doors: plant the base 30 feet or less from the portal and in line with it, then push button 4; the force exerted has a Strength modifier of +12.
• Button 6: indicates magnetic north and gives the wielder knowledge of approximate depth beneath the surface or height above it.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Rod, bull’s strength, fear, flame blade, hold person, inflict light wounds

Name: Metamagic Rod (Greater, +2 Spell Level)
Description: This greater metamagic rod applies a metamagic feat with a +2 spell level adjustment to spells of 9th level or lower, without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The specific feat depends on the rod variant (for example, Persistent Spell).

Name: Scepter of Heaven
Description:
This ornate scepter of bronze and mithral has a flanged head like a golden-white sunburst. It acts as a +1 evil outsider bane morningstar. When wielded by a good-aligned creature:

• The wielder gains a +2 sacred bonus on caster level checks made to dispel magic against effects with the evil descriptor or effects created by evil outsiders.
• The wielder can use bless weapon on command and at will as the spell.
• Once per day on command, if the wielder can, she can shoot a spear of purity (Ultimate Magic) from the scepter.

If the wielder wears a crown of heaven, the scepter’s caster level increases to 15th (increasing its aura to strong) and, when used as a weapon, it gains the holy property. A good-aligned wielder may also use holy smite, holy sword, and holy word, as the spells, once per day each.

A scepter of heaven is of good alignment. Any evil creature attempting to wield one gains one negative level. The negative level remains as long as the rod is in hand and disappears when the rod is no longer held. This negative level cannot be overcome in any way while the rod is being held.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Rod, bless weapon, dispel evil, holy smite, holy sword, holy word, spear of purity, creator must be good

Name: Metamagic Rod, Quicken (Normal)
Description: This normal metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Quicken Spell feat to spells of 6th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day.

Name: Rod of Dwarven Might
Description:
This dwarven version of the more famous rod of lordly might has no spell-like powers; however, when wielded by a dwarf, it increases all AC, attack roll, CMD, CMB, and saving throw bonuses from a dwarf’s racial traits by +1. The rod shares the mundane powers of a rod of lordly might, but its magical weapon forms are tailored to dwarven preferences:

• In its normal form, it can be used as a +1 returning light hammer.
• When button 1 is pushed, it becomes a +3 dwarven longhammer.
• When button 2 is pushed, it becomes a +4 dwarven waraxe.
• When button 3 is pushed, it becomes a +2 light crossbow or a +2 heavy crossbow.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Rod, bull’s strength

Name: Rod of Alertness
Description:
This rod is indistinguishable from a +1 light mace. It grants a +1 insight bonus on initiative checks. If grasped firmly, it enables the wielder to use detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, detect magic, discern lies, light, or see invisibility; each different use is a standard action.

If the head is planted in the ground and the possessor wills it to alertness (standard action), it senses creatures within 120 feet that intend to harm the possessor, creates the effect of a prayer spell upon all creatures friendly to the possessor in a 20-foot radius, and sends forth a mental alert to those friendly creatures warning them of any unfriendly creatures within the 120-foot radius. These effects last 10 minutes; this function can be used once per day.

Once per day, the rod can also simulate animate objects, utilizing up to 11 Small objects located roughly around the perimeter of a 5-foot-radius circle centered on the planted rod. Objects remain animated for 11 rounds.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, alarm, animate objects, detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, detect magic, discern lies, light, prayer, see invisibility

Name: Metamagic Rod (Greater, +3 Spell Level)
Description: This greater metamagic rod applies a metamagic feat with a +3 spell level adjustment to spells of 9th level or lower, without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The specific feat depends on the rod variant (for example, Maximize Spell or Widen Spell).

Name: Metamagic Rod, Quicken (Greater)
Description: This greater metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Quicken Spell feat to spells of 9th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day.

Name: Cloak of Displacement, Major
Description: This item appears to be a normal cloak, but when worn, it grants the wearer a constant displacement effect, as the spell. This effect grants a 50% miss chance against attacks.

Name: Wings of Flying
Description: These feathered wings appear to be nothing more than a plain cloak of feathers. When the wearer speaks the command word, the cloak turns into a pair of wings that allow the wearer to fly as the spell (average maneuverability). The wearer can fly for up to 5 minutes per day, which need not be continuous.

Name: Cloak of Etherealness
Description: This silvery-gray cloak seems to shimmer and ripple like water. On command, the wearer can become ethereal as per the spell etherealness. This effect lasts for up to 10 minutes per day, which need not be continuous.

Name: Wings of the Gargoyle
Description:
These heavy, stone-textured wings grant the wearer a fly speed of 60 feet (average maneuverability). The wearer can fly for up to 1 hour per day, which need not be continuous.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can gain damage reduction 10/magic for 12 rounds.

Name: Wyvern Cloak
Description:
This dark, scaled cloak grants the wearer a fly speed of 60 feet (good maneuverability). The wearer can fly for up to 10 minutes per day, which need not be continuous.
Three times per day as a standard action, the wearer can make a tail sting attack that deals 2d6 points of damage plus poison (Fortitude DC 18 negates; initial and secondary damage 1d4 Con).

Name: Crystal Ball with See Invisibility
Description: This crystal sphere allows the user to see distant locations as if using scrying (CL 13th). In addition, the viewer can see invisible creatures and objects as if under the effects of see invisibility.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, scrying, see invisibility

Name: Horn of Valhalla
Description: When blown, this horn summons a number of berserkers to fight for the blower for 1 hour. The type and number of berserkers depend on the horn’s variety. The horn can be used once per week.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster VI

Name: Crystal Ball with Detect Thoughts
Description: This crystal sphere allows the user to see distant locations as if using scrying (CL 13th). In addition, the viewer can read thoughts as if using detect thoughts (Will DC 16 negates).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, scrying, detect thoughts

Name: Last Leaves of the Autumn Dryad
Description: These delicate leaves grant the user the ability to use tree stride once per day (CL 11th).

Name: Instant Fortress
Description: This metal cube is small enough to fit in a pocket. When activated by speaking a command word, it grows to form a tower 20 feet square and 30 feet high, with arrow slits and a battlemented roof. The fortress has a single door that is barred from the inside, and it is immune to normal weapons. The fortress can be activated once per week. Creatures in the area when the fortress expands take 10d10 points of damage (Reflex DC 19 half).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage’s magnificent mansion

Name: Manual of Bodily Health +2
Description: This tome contains health and fitness secrets. If a character reads the manual over 1 week and spends 8 hours per day studying it, she gains a +2 inherent bonus to Constitution. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Manual of Gainful Exercise +2
Description: This tome contains fitness and strength secrets. If a character reads the manual over 1 week and spends 8 hours per day studying it, she gains a +2 inherent bonus to Strength. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Manual of Quickness of Action +2
Description: This tome contains agility and reflex secrets. If a character reads the manual over 1 week and spends 8 hours per day studying it, she gains a +2 inherent bonus to Dexterity. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Tome of Clear Thought +2
Description: This thick book contains tips for improving memory and logic. If anyone reads this book over a period of 1 week, studying its contents for 8 hours per day, he gains a +2 inherent bonus to Intelligence. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Tome of Leadership and Influence +2
Description: This ponderous book details suggestions for persuading and inspiring others. If anyone reads this book over a period of 1 week, studying its contents for 8 hours per day, he gains a +2 inherent bonus to Charisma. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Tome of Understanding +2
Description: This thick book contains philosophical insights and profound knowledge. If anyone reads this book over a period of 1 week, studying its contents for 8 hours per day, he gains a +2 inherent bonus to Wisdom. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Lord’s Banner, Terror
Description: This banner grants a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects to allies within 30 feet. In addition, once per day the bearer can cause enemies within 30 feet to become shaken for 1 minute (Will DC 18 negates).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, remove fear, fear

Name: Carpet of Flying (10 ft. by 10 ft.)
Description: This rug is able to fly through the air as if affected by an overland flight spell (CL 9th). The 10-foot-by-10-foot version carries up to 800 pounds and flies at a speed of 40 feet (perfect maneuverability). It can fly for up to 9 hours per day.

Name: Darkskull
Description: This humanoid skull, crafted of obsidian, radiates an aura of desecration in a 20-foot radius, as if under the effects of a desecrate spell (CL 13th). Undead within the area gain a +2 profane bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws. The skull can be activated or deactivated with a command word.

Name: Orb of Pure Law
Description: This flawless sphere emits ordered energy. Once per day as a standard action, the bearer can cause the orb to emit a 30-foot-radius burst of lawful energy. Chaotic creatures in the area take 5d6 points of damage (Will DC 18 half). Lawful creatures instead gain 5d6 temporary hit points for 1 hour.

Name: Cube of Force
Description: This small cube can be activated to create a force barrier around the user. Each face of the cube corresponds to a different type of barrier (living matter, nonliving matter, spells, or all). The cube has 36 charges and expends charges each round while active depending on the type of barrier chosen. When all charges are exhausted, the cube becomes inert.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, wall of force

Name: Page of Spell Knowledge (8th)
Description: This sheet of parchment is covered in densely scribbled arcane formulas. A spontaneous arcane spellcaster can study the page for 1 hour to permanently add the spell on the page to her list of spells known. The spell must be of a level she can cast and must appear on her class spell list. Once used, the page becomes blank.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast the spell scribed on the page

Name: Pearl of Power (8th)
Description:
This seemingly normal pearl of average size and luster is a potent aid to all spellcasters who prepare spells. Once per day on command, a pearl of power enables the possessor to recall any one spell of a particular level that she had prepared and then cast that day. The spell is then prepared again, just as if it had not been cast.

The spell must be of a particular level, depending on the pearl. Different pearls exist for recalling one spell per day of each level from 1st through 9th and for the 0-level spells.

A pearl of power only functions for spells prepared by the possessor.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be recalled

Name: Crystal Ball with Telepathy
Description: This crystal sphere allows the user to see distant locations as if using scrying (CL 15th). In addition, the viewer can communicate telepathically with creatures seen through the ball as if using telepathy.

Name: Horn of Blasting, Greater
Description: This horn functions as a horn of blasting except it deals 10d6 points of sonic damage to creatures (Fortitude DC 18 half) and 20d6 points of sonic damage to objects. If used more than once per day, there is a 20% cumulative chance each additional use that it explodes, dealing 10d6 points of sonic damage to the blower and destroying the horn.

Name: Pearl of Power (Two Spells)
Description:
This seemingly normal pearl of average size and luster is a potent aid to all spellcasters who prepare spells. Once per day on command, a pearl of power enables the possessor to recall two spells of a particular level that she had prepared and then cast that day. The spells are then prepared again, just as if they had not been cast.

The spells must be of the same particular level, depending on the pearl. A pearl of power only functions for spells prepared by the possessor.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be recalled

Name: Gem of Seeing
Description: This gem can be used as a standard action to grant the effects of true seeing for 30 minutes. The gem can be used three times per day.

Name: Lord’s Banner, Victory

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, heroism, remove fear

Name: Crystal Ball with True Seeing
Description: This crystal sphere allows the user to see distant locations as if using scrying (CL 15th). In addition, the viewer sees things as they actually are, as if under the effects of true seeing.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, scrying, true seeing

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, water breathing, freedom of movement

Name: Bowl of Conjuring Water Elementals
Description: This bowl summons a Large water elemental when filled with water and a command word is spoken. The elemental remains for up to 10 minutes. The bowl can be used once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster VI or summon monster VII

Name: Brazier of Conjuring Fire Elementals

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster VI or summon monster VII

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster VI or summon monster VII

Name: Stone of Conjuring Earth Elementals
Description: When placed on the ground and a command word spoken, this stone summons a Large earth elemental that serves the user for up to 10 minutes. The stone can be used once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster VI or summon monster VII

Name: Mirror of Opposition
Description: This mirror duplicates creatures reflected within it. Up to two Medium or smaller creatures can be duplicated per day. The duplicates are hostile to their originals and persist for up to 15 rounds.

Name: Strand of Prayer Beads, Greater
Description:
This strand of prayer beads contains a number of magical beads. A greater strand includes a bead of blessing, bead of healing, bead of karma, bead of smiting, and bead of summons. Each bead can be used once per day.

Bead of blessing: Grants the effects of bless (CL 10th).
Bead of healing: Cures 3d8+10 points of damage.
Bead of karma: Grants a +4 insight bonus to caster level for 10 minutes.
Bead of smiting: Grants a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls against evil creatures for 10 minutes.
Bead of summons: Summons a creature as if using summon monster VI.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bless, cure serious wounds, divine power, summon monster VI, creator must be able to cast divine spells

Name: Lord’s Banner (Crusades)
Description: This banner grants allies within 30 feet a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and saving throws against fear effects. In addition, once per day the bearer can grant allies within 30 feet the effects of righteous might for 10 rounds.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, righteous might, heroism

Name: Efreeti Bottle
Description: This sealed flask contains an efreeti. Once per day, the stopper can be removed to release the efreeti, which serves the opener for 10 minutes before returning to the bottle. The efreeti may grant up to three wishes per week, as normal for its kind.

Name: Cubic Gate
Description: This small cube has six sides, each keyed to a different plane. By pressing a side, the user can open a gate to the corresponding plane as if using plane shift or gate (CL 17th). The cube has 50 charges and expends charges based on the effect used.

Name: Iron Flask
Description: This metal flask can imprison a creature as if using trap the soul (CL 20th). Once per day, the flask can be opened to release the imprisoned creature, which obeys the opener’s commands for 1 hour before returning to the flask.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, trap the soul

Name: Mirror of Mental Prowess
Description: This mirror grants the viewer a +2 inherent bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma after studying it for 1 week, 8 hours per day. Once used, the mirror loses its magic.

Name: Mirror of Life Trapping
Description: This mirror can trap the life force of creatures reflected in it. Up to 12 creatures can be stored within the mirror at one time. A creature looking into the mirror must succeed at a DC 23 Will save or be imprisoned within it as if affected by imprisonment (CL 17th). Creatures within the mirror do not age and do not require sustenance.

Name: Staff of illumination
Description:
This radiant staff sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet. The light can be suppressed or resumed as a swift action. The staff allows use of the following spells:

• continual flame (1 charge)
• daylight (2 charges)
• searing light (2 charges)
• sunbeam (4 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, continual flame, daylight, searing light, sunbeam

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, grease, spike stones, wall of stone, web

• instant summons (4 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, instant summons, secret chest, shrink item

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, alarm, glyph of warding, symbol of pain

• polar ray (5 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, enervation, polar ray, ray of enfeeblement, scorching ray

• keen edge (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, bull’s strength, keen edge, righteous might

Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 198, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 494
Description:
This pale ash staff is inlaid with silver and capped with a crystal sphere. It allows use of the following spells:

• heal (4 charges)
• raise dead (5 charges)
• regenerate (5 charges)
• resurrection (5 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, heal, raise dead, regenerate, resurrection

Name: Staff of one hundred hands
Description:
This intricate staff appears carved from interwoven arms and hands. It functions as a +3/+3 quarterstaff and allows use of the following spells:

• haste (3 charges)
• telekinesis (4 charges)
• mass hold person (5 charges)
• chain lightning (5 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, chain lightning, haste, mass hold person, telekinesis

Name: Staff of passage
Description:
This tall silver staff is etched with winding paths and doorways. It allows use of the following spells:

• dimension door (4 charges)
• teleport (5 charges)
• greater teleport (5 charges)
• plane shift (5 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, dimension door, greater teleport, plane shift, teleport

Name: Staff of the hierophant
Description:
This golden staff is topped with a radiant holy symbol. It functions as a +3/+3 quarterstaff and allows use of the following spells:

• flame strike (3 charges)
• blade barrier (4 charges)
• greater dispel magic (4 charges)
• mass cure critical wounds (5 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, blade barrier, flame strike, greater dispel magic, mass cure critical wounds

Name: Staff of power
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 495
Description:
This potent staff functions as a +2/+2 quarterstaff and grants the wielder a +2 enhancement bonus to AC and saving throws while held. It allows use of the following spells:

• magic missile (1 charge)
• ray of enfeeblement (1 charge)
• lightning bolt (2 charges)
• fireball (2 charges)
• wall of force (3 charges)
• globe of invulnerability (3 charges)
• hold monster (3 charges)
• cone of cold (4 charges)
• teleport (5 charges)

The staff can be broken as a last resort. When broken, it releases a retributive strike that deals damage in a 30-foot radius. The wielder can choose to be at the center of the blast or avoid it. The damage dealt depends on the number of charges remaining.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, cone of cold, fireball, globe of invulnerability, hold monster, lightning bolt, magic missile, ray of enfeeblement, teleport, wall of force

Name: Bracers of Armor (+7)
Description:
These items appear to be wrist or arm guards, sometimes etched with symbols of protection or depictions of vigilant-looking animals. Bracers of armor surround the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting him an armor bonus of +1 to +8, just as though he were wearing armor. Both bracers of armor must be worn for the magic to be effective.
Alternatively, bracers of armor can be enchanted with armor special abilities. See Table 3–3: Armor Special Abilities for a list of abilities. Special abilities usually count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of an item, but do not improve AC. Bracers of armor cannot have a modified bonus (armor bonus plus armor special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +8. Bracers of armor must have at least a +1 armor bonus to grant an armor special ability.
Bracers of armor cannot have any armor special abilities that add a flat gp amount to their cost. Bracers of armor and ordinary armor do not stack. If the wearer receives a larger armor bonus from another source, the bracers of armor cease functioning and do not grant their armor bonus or their armor special abilities. If the bracers of armor grant a larger armor bonus, the other source of armor ceases functioning.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, creator’s caster level must be at least two times that of the bonus placed on the bracers, plus any requirements of the armor special abilities

Name: Bracers of Armor (+8)
Description:
These items appear to be wrist or arm guards, sometimes etched with symbols of protection or depictions of vigilant-looking animals. Bracers of armor surround the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting him an armor bonus of +1 to +8, just as though he were wearing armor. Both bracers of armor must be worn for the magic to be effective.
Alternatively, bracers of armor can be enchanted with armor special abilities. See Table 3–3: Armor Special Abilities for a list of abilities. Special abilities usually count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of an item, but do not improve AC. Bracers of armor cannot have a modified bonus (armor bonus plus armor special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +8. Bracers of armor must have at least a +1 armor bonus to grant an armor special ability.
Bracers of armor cannot have any armor special abilities that add a flat gp amount to their cost. Bracers of armor and ordinary armor do not stack. If the wearer receives a larger armor bonus from another source, the bracers of armor cease functioning and do not grant their armor bonus or their armor special abilities. If the bracers of armor grant a larger armor bonus, the other source of armor ceases functioning.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, creator’s caster level must be at least two times that of the bonus placed on the bracers, plus any requirements of the armor special abilities

Name: Monkey Belt, Greater
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +10 competence bonus on Climb checks. In addition, the wearer gains a climb speed of 30 feet and can always choose to take 10 on Climb checks, even when distracted or threatened.

Name: Anaconda’s Coils
Description: This thick, scaled belt grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and a +4 competence bonus on grapple combat maneuver checks. Once per day, as a swift action, the wearer can gain the constrict ability for 1 minute, dealing 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large) on a successful grapple check.

Name: Serpent Belt, Greater
Description: This scaled belt grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to natural armor. Once per day, as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +6 enhancement bonus on grapple combat maneuver checks for 1 minute.

Name: Belt of Fallen Heroes
Description: This belt contains small tokens representing fallen champions. Once per day, as a swift action, the wearer can call upon one of these spirits to gain a +4 morale bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, or skill checks for 1 minute. The specific benefit is chosen at activation.

Name: Gorgon Belt
Description: This heavy iron belt grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and a +2 natural armor bonus. Once per day, as a standard action, the wearer can attempt to petrify a creature within 30 feet (Fortitude DC 16 negates). The petrification effect lasts for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, flesh to stone

Name: Elemental Earth Belt
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and the ability to move across stone and earth as if under the effects of pass without trace. Once per day, the wearer can gain the effects of stoneskin for 10 minutes.

Name: Sash of Flowing Water
Description: This blue silk sash grants the wearer a swim speed of 30 feet and the ability to breathe underwater. In addition, once per day, the wearer can use control water (caster level 10th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, water breathing, control water

Name: Xorn Robe
Description:
This brown and gray robe is always dirty, and the chest and the back of each shoulder is decorated with a gem-like eye pattern. The wearer gains a +5 bonus on Perception checks, and can use earth glide to pass through up to 20 feet of natural or worked stone per day. The distance traveled with earth glide does not need to be consecutive, but it must be used in 5-foot increments.
The wearer is able to safely chew, swallow, digest, and derive nutrition from gems, precious metals, and metallic ore, with 100 gp worth of these materials sustaining him for 1 full day. If the wearer removes the robe after such a meal, he is sickened until 24 hours have passed since the last meal of this kind. Wearing the robe again immediately negates this penalty.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, passwall, purify food and drink

Name: Corset of Dire Witchcraft
Description: This slimming garment is fastened with laces, buckles, and buttons and reinforced with ribs of leather or bone. A corset of dire witchcraft grants a +4 armor bonus to AC. If the wearer is a witch, each day when she communes with her familiar to prepare spells, she may enhance one hex she knows, increasing its caster level by +2 for 24 hours. This enhancement ends if the corset is removed or if she uses it to enhance a different hex.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, creator must be a witch

Name: Bodywrap of Mighty Strikes +3
Description:
This long cloth is wrapped around the chest multiple times like a bandage. Once per round, the wearer may add an enhancement bonus of +1 to +5 on one attack and damage roll for an unarmed strike or natural attack (for one specific attack, not all attacks made with an unarmed strike that round). The wearer may use this item an additional time per round when his BAB reaches +6, +11, and +16.
Choosing to enhance an unarmed strike is not an action and may occur when it is not the wearer’s turn (such as when making an attack of opportunity). The wearer must decide to use the item before the attack roll is made, but does not have to expend all uses at the same time. For example, if the wearer can use the item twice per round, he can use it once on his turn when making an attack and save the second for the possibility of making an attack of opportunity.
Additionally, the bodywrap can grant melee weapon special abilities to a creature’s unarmed attacks, so long as those special abilities to be added apply to unarmed attacks. See Table 3–8: Melee Weapon Special Abilities (page 137) for a list of abilities. Special abilities count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of the item, but do not modify attack or damage bonuses. Any special abilities are set at the time of creation.
A bodywrap of mighty strikes cannot have a modified bonus (enhancement bonus plus special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +7. Unlike an amulet of mighty fists, a bodywrap needs to have a +1 enhancement bonus to grant a melee weapon special ability.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator's caster level must be at least three times the bodywrap's bonus, plus any requirements of the melee weapon special abilities

Name: Robe of Scintillating Colors
Description:
The wearer of this robe can cause the garment to display a shifting pattern of incredible hues, color after color cascading from the upper part of the robe to the hem in sparkling rainbows of dazzling light. The colors daze those near the wearer, conceal the wearer, and illuminate the surroundings. It takes 1 full round after the wearer speaks the command word for the colors to start flowing on the robe. The colors create the equivalent of a gaze attack with a 30-foot range.
Those who look at the wearer are dazed for 1d4+1 rounds (Will DC 16 negates). This is a mind-affecting pattern effect.
Every round of continuous scintillation of the robe gives the wearer better concealment. The miss chance on attacks against the wearer starts at 10% and increases by 10% each round until it reaches 50% (total concealment). Additionally the robe continuously illuminates a 30-foot radius. The effect can be used no more than a total of 10 rounds per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, blur, rainbow pattern

Name: Vest of Stable Mutation
Description:
This leather vest stabilizes and controls an alchemist’s mutagenic transformations. If the wearer has the mutagen class feature, she can drink a mutagen and choose to gain only the benefits (ability score bonus and natural armor bonus) without taking the normal penalty to an ability score. In addition, once per day when the wearer drinks a mutagen, she can extend its duration by 10 minutes per alchemist level.
If the wearer does not have the mutagen class feature, the vest has no effect.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, beast shape I

Name: Spectral Shroud
Description:
This gray cloak-like shroud can be wrapped around the wearer’s shoulders and torso. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Stealth checks. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can become incorporeal for 1 round, gaining the incorporeal subtype and the ability to move through solid objects, though she must end her turn in an open space. While incorporeal, the wearer cannot make physical attacks but can cast spells normally.
In addition, the shroud allows the wearer to speak with dead once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, etherealness, speak with dead

Name: Darksight Goggles
Description: These dark lenses grant the wearer darkvision 120 feet. If the wearer already has darkvision, the range increases by 60 feet. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can see through magical darkness as if under the effects of true seeing for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, darkvision, true seeing

Name: Sniper Goggles
Description: These precision-crafted goggles grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on ranged attack rolls. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +10 competence bonus on a single ranged attack roll.

Name: Rainbow Lenses
Description: These colorful lenses grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can produce a prismatic spray effect in a 15-foot cone (Reflex DC 18 partial).

Name: Annihilation Spectacles
Description: These dark spectacles allow the wearer to focus destructive energy through her gaze. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can fire a ray of force with a range of 60 feet that deals 10d6 points of force damage (Fortitude DC 18 half).

Name: Eyes of Doom
Description: These black crystal lenses grant the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can target a creature within 30 feet; the target must succeed at a Will save (DC 17) or be frightened for 1 round and shaken for 1d4 rounds thereafter.

Name: Shoes of the Firewalker
Description: These heavy boots grant the wearer immunity to fire damage while standing on or moving across natural lava or fire. In addition, the wearer can move across molten rock and similar surfaces as if they were solid ground. Once per day, the wearer can use fire shield (warm shield only) on herself.

Name: Dryad Sandals
Description: These sandals grant the wearer the ability to use tree stride once per day (caster level 12th). In addition, the wearer can move through undergrowth at her normal speed and without taking damage or suffering impairment.

Name: Horseshoes of the Mist
Description: These horseshoes can be affixed to a horse’s hooves. The horse can move through fog, mist, and similar obscuring effects without penalty and does not suffer miss chances due to concealment from such effects. Once per day, the horse can use gaseous form on itself (caster level 11th).

Name: Vampiric Gloves
Description: These black leather gloves grant the wearer the ability to drain life from foes. Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause her melee attacks to deal an additional 1d6 points of negative energy damage for 1 round. The wearer gains temporary hit points equal to the negative energy damage dealt (maximum 10 temporary hit points). These temporary hit points last for 1 minute.

Name: Giant Fist Gauntlets
Description: These massive iron gauntlets enlarge the wearer’s fists. The wearer’s unarmed strikes deal damage as if she were one size category larger. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, enlarge person, bull’s strength

Name: Gloves of the Shortened Path
Description: These supple gray gloves allow the wearer to teleport up to 30 feet as a move action three times per day, as dimension door (self only).

Name: Cat’s Eye Crown
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 240, Advanced Race Guide pg. 94
Description: This slender silver crown is decorated with a single cat’s eye gemstone as a centerpiece. When the gem is attached to the crown, its wearer gains darkvision 60 feet, or increases her darkvision by 60 feet if she already possesses that sense. The gemstone is detachable, and can be rolled into rooms, dropped into holes, thrown through windows, or planted on a creature. Once per day, on command, the crown’s wearer gains the benefit of the clairaudience/clairvoyance spell, but uses the cat’s eye gemstone as that spell’s sensor and gains darkvision when viewing through that sensor.

Name: Maw of the Wyrm
Description:
This fearsome helm, wrought into the shape of a roaring dragon’s maw, has dozens of glittering dragon scales across its surface. The helm’s wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks and a +4 insight bonus on saves to resist a dragon’s frightful presence aura.

Each helm is modeled after a particular type of chromatic or metallic dragon. Once per day on command, the wearer can breathe out a blast of energy, as the dragon’s breath spell (Advanced Player’s Guide) to mimic the breath weapon of the dragon the helm is modeled after (7d6 points of damage, Reflex DC 16 half).

Name: Mitre of the Hierophant
Description: This ostentatious hat functions only for a wearer who can cast divine spells. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Diplomacy and Knowledge (religion) checks. Once per day on command, the wearer can ask a single question of her patron deity, as if by using commune. Once per week on command, the wearer can touch a creature, atoning it for past misdeeds as if using an atonement spell.

Name: Magician’s Hat
Description: Mystic symbols embroidered in gold thread decorate this conical hat. Three times per day as a free action when casting a spell, the wearer can shift metamagic feats on prepared spells. The wearer can either move a metamagic feat from another prepared spell to a spell being cast or from the spell being cast to another prepared spell. In either case, the spell that gains the metamagic feat can’t exceed the spell slot of the spell that originally had the metamagic feat. For example, a wizard with detect thoughts, silent dispel magic, and dimension door prepared could cast a silent detect thoughts (and would now have dispel magic prepared), but could not cast silent dimension door. Moving metamagic feats does not increase spell casting time, even for quickened spells. The hat provides no benefit to spontaneous casting or spell-like abilities.

Name: Circlet of Mindsight
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 240, Pathfinder Society Field Guide pg. 51
Description:
This elaborate circlet of gold-and-platinum filigree bears tiny gems in settings that look disturbingly like human eyes. When worn, the circlet lets the wearer sense the presence of other thinking creatures in her immediate area. The wearer gains the benefits of blindsense 30 feet, but only against creatures with an Intelligence score that are susceptible to mind-affecting effects.

Undead, constructs, and mindless creatures like most oozes and vermin cannot be perceived when using the circlet, nor can creatures under the effects of mind blank or a ring of mind shielding.

The circlet does not interfere with the wearer’s ability to see normally. If the wearer has blindsense or blindsight, he is able to differentiate creatures detected with those senses from creatures detected with the circlet of mindsight.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, clairaudience/clairvoyance, detect thoughts

Name: Mask of the Skull
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 246, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 523
Description:
This fearsome-looking mask of ivory, beaten copper, or pale wood is typically fashioned into the likeness of a human skull with a missing lower jaw, allowing the bottom half of the wearer’s face to remain visible when the mask is worn.

Once per day, after it has been worn for at least 1 hour, the mask can be loosed to fly from the wearer’s face. It travels up to 50 feet away from the wearer and attacks a target assigned to it. The grinning skull mask makes a touch attack against the target based on the wearer’s base attack bonus. If the attack succeeds, the target must make a successful DC 20 Fortitude save or take 130 points of damage, as if affected by a finger of death spell. If the target succeeds at its saving throw, it nevertheless takes 3d6+13 points of damage. After attacking (whether successful or not), the mask flies back to its user. The mask has AC 16, 10 hit points, and hardness 6.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, animate objects, finger of death, fly

Name: Howling Helm
Description:
The wearer of this helm, crafted from a beast’s skull, gains the ability to communicate with dogs, wolves, dire wolves, foxes, jackals, coyotes, and similar canine animals as the speak with animals spell. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks and Charisma checks to influence wolf-like magical beasts such as blink dogs, winter wolves, and worgs.

On command three times per day, the wearer can unleash a terrifying howl. When he does so, he makes a single Intimidate check to demoralize all opponents within 30 feet that can hear the howl. At the start of the wearer’s following turn, 1d3 wolves appear as if summoned by the spell summon nature’s ally III. They act on the wearer’s initiative and follow her instructions (or attacking her opponents, if she cannot communicate with them) for 5 rounds before vanishing in a swirl of pine needles and snow.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, speak with animals, summon nature’s ally III

Name: Crown of Blasting (Major)
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 241, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 507
Description: On command, this elaborate golden crown projects a blast of searing light (5d8 maximized for 40 points of damage) once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, Maximize Spell, searing light

Name: Helm of Underwater Action
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 244, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 518
Description: The wearer of this helmet can see underwater. Drawing the small lenses in compartments on either side into position before the wearer’s eyes activates the visual properties of the helm, allowing her to see five times farther than water and light conditions would allow for normal human vision. (Weeds, obstructions, and the like block vision in the usual manner.) If the command word is spoken, the helm of underwater action gives the wearer a 30-foot swim speed and creates a globe of air around the wearer’s head and maintains it until the command word is spoken again, enabling her to breathe freely.

Name: Crown of Conquest
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 241, Advanced Race Guide pg. 78
Description:
This crown of steel and gold projects an aura of menacing power. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks, and whenever he confirms a critical hit, the crown creates a prayer effect centered on the crown’s wearer (caster level 5th).

If the wearer of the crown has the Leadership feat, he gains a +1 bonus to his Leadership score and any follower or cohort of the wearer gains a +1 bonus on attack rolls and saving throws against fear effects while within line of sight of the wearer.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bless, eagle’s splendor, prayer

Name: Batrachian Helm
Description:
This oily bronze helm is fashioned in the shape of a frog’s head. Three times per day as a swift action, the helm fires an unerring tongue of force at a visible target within 20 feet.

If the target is an unattended object weighing 250 pounds or less, it is pulled 20 feet toward the wearer. If the target is a creature of the wearer’s size or smaller, the wearer may make a combat maneuver check as a free action to pull the target 20 feet toward him.

If the target is a creature larger than the wearer, an unattended object weighing more than 250 pounds, or an immobile structure such as a wall, the wearer is pulled 20 feet toward the target. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity, and the object or creature stops if the movement would move it into a solid object or creature.

Name: Helm of Telepathy
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 244, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 518
Description: This pale metal or ivory helm covers much of the head when worn. The wearer can use detect thoughts at will. Furthermore, he can send a telepathic message to anyone whose surface thoughts he is reading (allowing twoway communication). Once per day, the wearer of the helm can implant a suggestion (as the spell, Will DC 14 negates) along with his telepathic message.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, detect thoughts, suggestion

Name: Headband of Arcane Energy
Description: This headband stores arcane energy. The wearer gains 3 arcane reservoir points each day that can be spent as if she possessed the arcane reservoir class feature. If the wearer already has an arcane reservoir, she instead gains 3 additional points per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must have the arcane reservoir class feature

Name: Headband of Counterspelling
Description: This jeweled headband allows the wearer to store a single spell of up to 6th level within it. If the wearer is targeted by the stored spell, the headband automatically counters it as if using counterspell.

Name: Headband of Knucklebones
Description: This headband allows the wearer to roll a set of magical knucklebones once per day as a standard action. The result grants a luck bonus between +1 and +4 on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 minute.

Name: Symbol of Sanguine Protection
Description: This ruby pendant is etched with a holy symbol. Once per day as an immediate action when the wearer takes damage from a melee attack, she can cause the symbol to flare with crimson light. The attacker takes 2d6 points of bleed damage (Fortitude DC 16 negates). The bleed damage persists for 3 rounds unless stopped normally.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, inflict serious wounds

Name: Amulet of Natural Armor +3
Description: This amulet, usually crafted from bone or beast scales, toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor bonus of +3.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, creator’s caster level must be at least three times the amulet’s bonus

Name: Ampoule of False Blood
Description: This glass vial worn as a pendant contains a dark red liquid. When the wearer is reduced to 0 or fewer hit points but not slain, the ampoule shatters and releases its contents. The wearer appears to die in a dramatic spray of blood. This effect functions as mislead, except that the illusory double appears to be a lifeless corpse. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until dismissed. Once activated, the ampoule is destroyed.

Name: Amulet of Magecraft
Description: This amulet enhances a spellcaster’s ability to shape magic. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on concentration checks and a +2 competence bonus on Spellcraft checks.

Name: Dragonfoe Amulet
Description: This amulet is fashioned in the shape of a dragon’s head. The wearer gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC against attacks made by dragons and a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities used by dragons.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from energy

Name: Amulet of Spell Mastery
Description: This amulet grants the wearer the ability to prepare one additional 1st-level spell each day. If the wearer does not prepare spells, she instead gains one additional 1st-level spell slot.

Name: Amulet of Bullet Protection +4
Description: This amulet grants the wearer a +4 luck bonus to AC against firearm attacks that target touch AC.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from arrows

Name: Hand of Stone
Description: This stone hand hangs from a thick cord. Once per day, the wearer can command the hand to detach and animate as if affected by animate objects. The hand functions as a Small animated object under the wearer’s control for 5 rounds, after which it returns to its inert form.

Name: Periapt of Proof Against Poison
Description: This periapt grants the wearer immunity to poison, including poison delivered by spells and spell-like abilities.

Name: Ring of inner fortitude, minor
Description: This ring grants the wearer a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against fatigue and exhaustion effects. In addition, once per day when the wearer would become fatigued or exhausted, she can ignore that condition for up to 10 rounds. If the effect causing the condition would last longer than 10 rounds, the condition resumes after the 10 rounds have elapsed.

Name: Ring of protection +3
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 173, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring grants a +3 deflection bonus to AC.

Name: Ring of spell storing, minor
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 174, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: A minor ring of spell storing contains up to three levels of spells that the wearer can cast. The ring must be attuned to the wearer. Any spellcaster can cast a spell of 1st through 3rd level into the ring by touching it as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than to be stored in the ring.
