If the ring is attuned to the wearer, she can cast any spell stored in it as if she had cast the spell herself. Once cast from the ring, the spell disappears.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, imbue with spell ability

Name: Ring of energy shroud
Description: This ring surrounds the wearer with a visible aura of one type of energy (acid, cold, electricity, or fire), chosen when the ring is created. Any creature striking the wearer with a melee attack takes 1d6 points of energy damage of the chosen type. This damage applies once per attacker per round.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, resist energy, elemental spell of chosen type

Name: Ring of arcane mastery
Description: This simple gold band is etched with tiny arcane symbols. The wearer gains a +1 competence bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance. In addition, once per day as a free action when casting a spell, the wearer can increase the spell’s caster level by 1 for all effects dependent on caster level. This increase does not grant additional spells per day and cannot raise the caster level above the wearer’s Hit Dice.

Name: Ring of invisibility
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 171, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring grants the wearer the ability to become invisible. By uttering a command word, the wearer activates the ring and becomes invisible as per the invisibility spell. The ring can be used at will.

Name: Ring of wizardry I
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: This ring allows a wizard to prepare extra spells. It doubles the number of 1st-level spells a wizard can prepare each day. This ring does not grant extra spells to other arcane spellcasters, even if they prepare spells (such as magi).

Name: Ring of revelation, superior
Description: This ring functions as a ring of revelation, lesser, except it can grant access to any revelation from the wearer’s mystery, including revelations that normally require the oracle to be at least 11th level. The wearer must meet all other prerequisites for the revelation. The wearer uses her oracle level to determine the revelation’s effects. If she does not have the oracle class feature, the ring has no effect.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have the revelation to be granted

Name: Ring of spell knowledge IV
Description: This ring functions as a ring of spell knowledge, except it can hold spells of up to 4th level. Through study, the wearer can gain knowledge of a single spell in addition to those allotted by her class and level. The wearer must encounter a written, active, or cast version of the spell and succeed at a DC 20 Spellcraft check to teach the spell to the ring. Arcane spells not on the wearer’s class list are treated as one level higher for storage and casting.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be granted

Name: Ring of evasion
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 170, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring continually grants the wearer the ability to avoid damage as if she had the evasion class feature. If the wearer already has evasion, she instead gains improved evasion.

Name: Ring of x-ray vision
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description:
This ring allows the wearer to see into and through solid matter. Vision range is 20 feet, with the wearer seeing as if she were looking at something in normal light, even if there is no illumination. X-ray vision can be activated or deactivated as a free action. The ring can be used for up to 1 minute per day. Solid objects within 20 feet are not concealed, but lead blocks the vision. The wearer can see through 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, 3 feet of wood or dirt, but thicker materials or different materials block the vision.

Using the ring is physically exhausting. Each minute of use requires the wearer to succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or take 1 point of Constitution damage.

Name: Ring of blinking
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 168, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: On command, this ring makes the wearer blink, as the blink spell. This effect can be activated at will.

Name: Conduit rod
Description: This copper-and-iron rod can store and redirect spell energy. When the wielder casts a spell with the electricity descriptor, she can choose to have the spell originate from the rod rather than from herself (as though the rod were the spell’s point of origin), provided the rod is within her reach. This does not change the spell’s range or area. In addition, once per day when the wielder would take electricity damage, she can use an immediate action to absorb up to 20 points of that damage. The absorbed electricity is stored in the rod for 1 minute. During that time, the wielder can add the stored electricity damage to a single melee attack made with the rod as a free action; the attack deals an additional amount of electricity damage equal to the amount absorbed (maximum 20). Any stored electricity is lost after 1 minute if not discharged.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, lightning bolt, protection from energy (electricity)

Name: Grounding rod
Description: This iron rod is etched with jagged runes and feels slightly warm to the touch. The rod grants the wielder resistance 10 against electricity. In addition, once per day as an immediate action when the wielder would take electricity damage, she can become immune to electricity damage for 1 round. During that round, any electricity damage that would have been dealt to her is instead harmlessly grounded into the earth (if she is not in contact with a surface capable of grounding electricity, this protection still functions but produces visible sparks and crackling energy around her).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, resist energy, protection from energy (electricity)

Name: Rod of the wayang
Description: This slim ebon rod is etched with shadowy figures. When the wielder uses it while casting a spell with the darkness or shadow descriptor, she treats her caster level as 2 higher for the purpose of overcoming spell resistance. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wielder can become partially insubstantial, gaining concealment (20% miss chance) for 1 round.

Name: Rod of Wonder
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 185, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 486
Description:
A rod of wonder is a strange and unpredictable device that produces bizarre magical effects when activated. Each time it is used, the wielder rolls d% and consults the rod of wonder table to determine the effect. Unless otherwise stated, effects have a range of 60 feet.

Many effects duplicate spells (caster level 10th), while others create unique outcomes such as explosions of butterflies, showers of gems, transformations, or sudden movement effects. Some effects target the wielder, some target a creature, and some affect an area. The rod can be used at will, but its effects are random each time.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, confusion, darkness, dispel magic, enlarge person, fireball, lightning bolt, polymorph, etc.

Name: Rod of Metamagic, Merciful (greater)
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 190, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 295
Description: The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that deal nonlethal damage as though using the Merciful Spell feat. A greater metamagic rod can affect spells of 9th level or lower.

Name: Rod of the python
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 184, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 485
Description: This rod is made of heavy dark wood and carved to resemble a snake. Upon command, the rod becomes a constrictor snake (as the monster entry) under the wielder’s control. The python acts on the wielder’s initiative and obeys spoken commands. It can be commanded to revert to rod form as a free action. If slain while in snake form, it reverts to rod form and cannot be used again for 24 hours.

Name: Trap-stealer’s rod
Description: This rod allows the wielder to disable magical traps more safely. Three times per day, the wielder can touch the rod to a magical trap and suppress it for 1d4 rounds as if using dispel magic (caster level 9th). If the trap is successfully suppressed, the wielder can attempt a Disable Device check to permanently disable it without triggering it.

Name: Metamagic rod (+3 spell level), minor
Description:
Metamagic rods hold the essence of a metamagic feat, allowing the user to apply metamagic effects to spells (but not spell-like abilities) as they are cast. This does not change the spell slot of the altered spell.

This entry represents a minor metamagic rod that applies a metamagic feat which increases the spell’s effective spell level adjustment by +3 without increasing the spell slot used. A minor metamagic rod can be used with spells of 3rd level or lower. The rod can be used up to three times per day.

Name: Rod of balance
Description: This brass rod bears symbols of equilibrium. When held, it grants the wielder a +4 bonus on Balance checks (Acrobatics checks to move on narrow or slippery surfaces). In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wielder can ignore penalties from difficult terrain for 1 minute.

Name: Rod of escape
Description: This rod aids in slipping bonds and confinement. The wielder gains a +10 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wielder can cast freedom of movement on herself.

Name: Rod of flame extinguishing
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 181, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 485
Description: This rod appears to be made of black iron. On command, it can extinguish nonmagical fires in a 20-foot-radius burst. It can also dispel magical fire effects as dispel magic (caster level 9th). In addition, once per day it can produce a cone of cold (caster level 9th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, cone of cold, dispel magic

Name: Rod of ruin
Description: This iron rod is pitted and scarred as though corroded. Once per day as a standard action, the wielder can touch the rod to a nonmagical object of up to 10 cubic feet per caster level (maximum 90 cubic feet). The object immediately crumbles into fine dust, as though affected by disintegrate, though magical items are unaffected. Constructs and creatures are not affected.

Name: Sapling rod
Description: This slender rod resembles a living branch tipped with a bud. When planted firmly into soil and activated as a standard action, the rod transforms into a Medium treant that obeys the wielder’s spoken commands for up to 10 minutes. After this duration, it reverts to rod form. If the treant form is reduced to 0 hit points, it reverts to rod form and cannot be used again for 24 hours.

Name: Rod of beguiling
Description: This slender silver rod is capped with a smiling mask. The wielder gains a +5 competence bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks. In addition, once per day she can cast charm monster (caster level 9th).

Name: Rod of nettles
Description: This gnarled wooden rod is covered in tiny thorn-like protrusions. Three times per day as a standard action, the wielder can cause thorny vines to erupt from the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute, and creatures within the area take 1d6 points of piercing damage each round they remain in the area (Reflex DC 15 negates the damage for that round).

Name: Rod of the viper
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 185, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 485
Description: This rod is shaped like a serpent and functions as a +1/+1 quarterstaff. Once per day on command, it can transform into a venomous viper (as the monster entry) that obeys the wielder’s commands. The viper remains for up to 10 minutes, after which it reverts to rod form. If slain, it reverts to rod form and cannot be used again for 24 hours.

Name: Stole of Justice
Description: This white stole is embroidered with golden scales. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can invoke the stole’s power to gain a +4 sacred bonus on attack rolls and saving throws against a single creature for 9 rounds. The wearer must be able to see the target to activate this ability.

Name: Jellyfish Cape
Description:
This translucent cape drips faintly with seawater. The wearer gains a swim speed of 30 feet and can breathe underwater.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cause the cape to lash out with stinging tendrils. Creatures adjacent to the wearer take 3d6 points of electricity damage (Reflex DC 16 half).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, water breathing, lightning bolt

Name: Cloak of the Diplomat
Description:
This elegant cloak is trimmed with fine silk and subtle embroidery. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast suggestion (DC 16) as a spell-like ability.

Name: Slashing Cloak
Description: This dark cloak’s hem is lined with razor-sharp edges. As a standard action, the wearer can sweep the cloak in a wide arc, making a melee attack against all adjacent creatures. This attack uses the wearer’s highest base attack bonus and deals 1d8 points of slashing damage (1d6 if Small). This ability can be used three times per day.

Name: Stone Cloak, Major
Description: This heavy cloak resembles overlapping plates of stone. Once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can gain damage reduction 10/adamantine for 3 rounds.

Name: Cloak of Displacement, Minor
Description: This item appears to be a normal cloak, but when worn, it grants the wearer a constant minor displacement effect, as the spell. This effect grants a 20% miss chance against attacks.

Name: Cloak of Resistance +5
Description: Flecks of silver or steel are often sown amid the fabric of these magical cloaks. This garment offers magical protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus

Name: Cloak of the Bat
Description:
Fashioned of dark brown or black cloth, a cloak of the bat bestows a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.
The wearer can hang upside down from the ceiling like a bat.
By holding the cloak’s edges, the wearer can fly as per the spell (average maneuverability). Flying in this way requires both hands and lasts for up to 7 minutes per day, which need not be continuous.

Name: Ioun Stone (Iridescent Spindle)
Description: This stone sustains its wearer without need of food or water.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, create food and water

Name: Orb of Foul Abaddon
Description: This black iron sphere radiates a faint aura of despair. Once per day as a standard action, the bearer can cause the orb to emit a 30-foot-radius burst. Living creatures in the area take 3d6 points of negative energy damage (Will DC 16 half). Evil creatures instead gain 3d6 temporary hit points for 1 hour.

Name: Carpet of Flying (5 ft. by 5 ft.)
Description: This carpet can fly as if using overland flight (CL 9th). It can carry up to 200 pounds and has a speed of 40 feet (perfect maneuverability). The carpet can fly for up to 9 hours per day.

Name: Horn of Antagonism
Description: When blown, this horn compels a single target within 30 feet to focus its attacks on the horn’s bearer for 5 rounds (Will DC 16 negates). The horn can be used once per day.

Name: Horn of Blasting
Description: This horn appears to be a normal trumpet. It can be sounded as a standard action to produce a cone of sound 40 feet long. Creatures in the area take 5d6 points of sonic damage (Fortitude DC 16 half). Objects in the area take 10d6 points of sonic damage. If the horn is used more than once per day, there is a 20% cumulative chance each additional use that it explodes, dealing 10d6 points of sonic damage to the blower and destroying the horn.

Name: Ioun Stone (Pale Lavender Ellipsoid)
Description: This stone absorbs spells targeted at its wearer, functioning as a spell turning effect that can absorb up to 4 spell levels per day.

Name: Ioun Stone (Pearly White Spindle)
Description: This stone grants its wearer fast healing 1.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure serious wounds

Name: Master’s Perfect Golden Bell
Description: When rung as a standard action, this bell grants all allies within 30 feet a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws for 5 rounds. The bell can be used once per day.

Name: Necromancer’s Athame
Description: This ritual dagger enhances necromantic magic. When used as a focus for necromancy spells, the caster increases the caster level of those spells by +1. In addition, once per day, the wielder can sacrifice a living creature with the athame to regain one expended necromancy spell of 3rd level or lower.

Name: Portable Hole
Description: This circular patch of cloth, when spread upon a surface, creates an extradimensional hole 10 feet deep and 6 feet in diameter. The hole can hold up to 2,000 pounds. Placing a portable hole inside a bag of holding creates a rift to the Astral Plane.

Name: Stone of Good Luck
Description: This stone grants its possessor a +1 luck bonus on saving throws, ability checks, and skill checks.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Ivory Goats)
Description: This set of three ivory goat statuettes can transform into goats. Each goat can be used once per day for up to 1 hour. One goat functions as a ram with a powerful charge attack.

Name: Rope of Entanglement
Description: This rope can be commanded to animate as if using animate rope. It can entangle a creature within 20 feet (Reflex DC 15 negates). An entangled creature can escape with a DC 20 Escape Artist check or Strength check. The rope can be used once per day and remains animated for up to 7 rounds.

Name: Golem Manual (Stone)
Description:
The wondrous items known as golem manuals contain all the information and magical power required to create a particular kind of golem. This effectively grants the Craft Construct feat to anyone using the manual to craft a golem of that type, and it provides an increase in caster level for the purpose of meeting the prerequisite to craft that specific type of golem.
Further, the manual grants a +5 competence bonus on skill checks to craft the golem and contains all the necessary spells, which can be activated by anyone who has the relevant spells on their class’s spell list (but only for the purpose of crafting the golem). When using a golem manual, you must still spend the normal amount of time to craft the golem and pay the cost of the golem’s body (or provide it through other means), but you do not need to pay the rest of the normal cost to create the golem.
The spells included in a golem manual require a spell trigger activation and can be activated only to assist in the construction of a golem. The cost of the book does not include the cost of constructing the golem’s body. Once the golem is finished, the writing in the manual fades and the book is consumed in flames. When the book’s ashes are sprinkled upon the golem, it becomes fully animated.
Stone: The book contains animate objects, geas/quest, limited wish, and stone shape. The reader may treat her caster level as one level higher than normal for the purpose of crafting a stone golem.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Construct, animate objects, geas/quest, limited wish, stone shape, creator must be caster level 14th

Name: Orb of Golden Heaven
Description: This radiant golden sphere emits holy light. Once per day as a standard action, the bearer can cause the orb to emit a 30-foot-radius burst. Evil creatures in the area take 3d6 points of damage (Will DC 16 half). Good creatures instead gain 3d6 temporary hit points for 1 hour.

Name: Mattock of the Titans
Description: This +3 adamantine mattock grants its wielder a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength. The wielder gains a +4 bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls made to sunder objects or against constructs.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength, creator must be caster level 9th

Name: Drinking Horn of Bottomless Valor
Description: This ornate horn is always filled with strong drink. Once per day, a creature that drinks from the horn gains the effects of heroism for 10 minutes.

Name: Boro Bead (5th)
Description: This small wooden bead is carved with druidic symbols. Once per day, when the wearer prepares spells, she can recover one expended 5th-level druid spell as if it had not been cast.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be a druid

Name: Chaos Emerald
Description: This emerald radiates unpredictable energy. Once per day as a standard action, the bearer can activate the emerald to produce a random effect as if using confusion (CL 9th).

Name: Page of Spell Knowledge (5th)
Description: This sheet of parchment is covered in densely scribbled arcane formulas. A spontaneous arcane spellcaster can study the page for 1 hour to permanently add the spell on the page to her list of spells known. The spell must be of a level she can cast and must appear on her class spell list. Once used, the page becomes blank.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast the spell scribed on the page

Name: Pearl of Power (5th)
Description:
This seemingly normal pearl of average size and luster is a potent aid to all spellcasters who prepare spells. Once per day on command, a pearl of power enables the possessor to recall any one spell of a particular level that she had prepared and then cast that day. The spell is then prepared again, just as if it had not been cast.

The spell must be of a particular level, depending on the pearl. Different pearls exist for recalling one spell per day of each level from 1st through 9th and for the 0-level spells.

A pearl of power only functions for spells prepared by the possessor.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be recalled

Name: Preserving Flask (5th)
Description: This stoppered glass flask can hold a single 5th-level potion. Any potion placed within the flask does not lose potency over time and cannot be spoiled by environmental effects. A potion can remain within the flask indefinitely without degradation.

Name: Maul of the Titans
Description: This +3 Large adamantine maul grants its wielder a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength. The wielder gains a +4 bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls made to sunder objects or against constructs.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength, creator must be caster level 9th

Name: Iron Bands of Binding
Description: When thrown at a creature within 30 feet, these bands wrap around the target, functioning as dimensional anchor and entangle (Reflex DC 17 negates entangle). The bands can be used once per day.

Name: Cube of Frost Resistance
Description: This cube provides resistance to cold 10 while carried. Once per day as a standard action, the bearer can activate the cube to gain protection from energy (cold only) for 7 rounds.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from energy

Name: Manual of Bodily Health +1
Description: This tome contains health and fitness secrets. If a character reads the manual over 1 week and spends 8 hours per day studying it, she gains a +1 inherent bonus to Constitution. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Manual of Gainful Exercise +1
Description: This tome contains fitness and strength secrets. If a character reads the manual over 1 week and spends 8 hours per day studying it, she gains a +1 inherent bonus to Strength. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Manual of Quickness of Action +1
Description: This tome contains agility and reflex secrets. If a character reads the manual over 1 week and spends 8 hours per day studying it, she gains a +1 inherent bonus to Dexterity. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Tome of Clear Thought +1
Description: This thick book contains tips for improving memory and logic. If anyone reads this book over a period of 1 week, studying its contents for 8 hours per day, he gains a +1 inherent bonus to Intelligence. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Tome of Leadership and Influence +1
Description: This ponderous book details suggestions for persuading and inspiring others. If anyone reads this book over a period of 1 week, studying its contents for 8 hours per day, he gains a +1 inherent bonus to Charisma. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Tome of Understanding +1
Description: This thick book contains philosophical insights and profound knowledge. If anyone reads this book over a period of 1 week, studying its contents for 8 hours per day, he gains a +1 inherent bonus to Wisdom. Once the book is read, it loses its magic.

Name: Staff of fire
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 197, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 494
Description:
Crafted from bronzewood with brass bindings, this staff allows use of the following spells:

• burning hands (1 charge)
• fireball (2 charges)
• wall of fire (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, burning hands, fireball, wall of fire

Name: Staff of courage
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 195, Pathfinder Society Field Guide pg. 54
Description:
This sturdy-looking hickory staff is capped with a figurine of an angel or other benevolent spirit, wings and arms outstretched as if in welcome. This staff allows use of the following spells:

• bless (1 charge)
• remove fear (1 charge)
• prayer (2 charges)
• remove paralysis (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, bless, prayer, remove fear, remove paralysis

Name: Staff of belittling
Description:
Someone who carries this blue-and-white staff need never feel small nor weak, as the staff brings everybody and everything down to size. This staff allows the use of the following spells:

• reduce person (1 charge)
• reduce animal (2 charges)
• shrink item (2 charges)
• mass reduce person (4 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, mass reduce person, reduce animal, reduce person, shrink item

Name: Staff of feast and famine
Description:
Leaves sprout from this wooden staff, some green and some black. When the wielder uses the staff, he plucks one of the leaves: a green leaf to provide sustenance or a black leaf to cause hunger or thirst. The staff allows the use of the following spells:

• create water (1 charge)
• goodberry (1 charge)
• purify food and drink (1 charge)
• cup of dust (2 charges; Advanced Player’s Guide)
• feast of ashes (2 charges; Advanced Player’s Guide)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, create water, cup of dust, feast of ashes, goodberry, purify food and drink

Name: Staff of rigor
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 298
Description:
This iron-shod wood staff allows use of the following spells:

• bane (1 charge)
• cause fear (1 charge)
• command (1 charge)
• magic weapon (1 charge)
• align weapon (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, align weapon, bane, cause fear, command, magic weapon

Name: Staff of swarming insects
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 201, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 495
Description:
Made of twisted darkwood covered with knots and nodules resembling crawling insects (which occasionally seem to move), this staff allows use of the following spells:

• summon swarm (1 charge)
• insect plague (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, insect plague, summon swarm

Name: Staff of authority
Description:
This stout ironbound staff functions as a +1/+1 quarterstaff. It allows the use of the following spells:

• forced quiet (1 charge; Ultimate Magic)
• interrogation (1 charge; Ultimate Magic)
• oppressive boredom (2 charges; Ultimate Magic)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, forced quiet, interrogation, oppressive boredom

Name: Staff of radiance
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, Pathfinder Society Field Guide pg. 54
Description:
This silver-tipped willow staff constantly emits light, as if from a light spell—the radiance is emitted from the staff’s metallic end and flickers as if with flame. The staff’s wielder can deactivate or activate this glowing light as a swift action. In addition, a staff of radiance allows use of the following spells:

• glitterdust (1 charge)
• daylight (2 charges)
• searing light (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, daylight, glitterdust, light, searing light

Name: Staff of size alteration
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 495
Description:
This staff of dark wood is stouter and sturdier than most magical staves, with a gnarled and twisted knot of wood at the top end. It allows use of the following spells:

• enlarge person (1 charge)
• reduce person (1 charge)
• shrink item (2 charges)
• mass enlarge person (3 charges)
• mass reduce person (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, enlarge person, mass enlarge person, mass reduce person, reduce person, shrink item

Name: Staff of journeys
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 198, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 297
Description:
This walking stick, which still has dark gray bark along its entire length, branches into an ornate fork at its top, decorated with wildflowers and different kinds of leaves. It allows use of the following spells:

• detect snares and pits (1 charge)
• endure elements (1 charge)
• longstrider (1 charge)
• pass without trace (1 charge)
• freedom of movement (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, detect snares and pits, endure elements, freedom of movement, longstrider, pass without trace

Name: Vambraces of the Genie (Djinni)
Description:
These silver vambraces are cool to the touch and etched with swirling wind patterns. The wearer gains electricity resistance 10.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast lightning bolt (CL 9th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resist energy, lightning bolt

Name: Vambraces of the Genie (Marid)
Description:
These blue-green vambraces are damp to the touch and etched with wave patterns. The wearer gains cold resistance 10.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast cone of cold (CL 9th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resist energy, cone of cold

Name: Vambraces of the Genie (Shaitan)
Description:
These stone-gray vambraces are heavy and etched with crystalline patterns. The wearer gains acid resistance 10.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast acid arrow (CL 9th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resist energy, acid arrow

Name: Bracelet of Friends
Description:
This charm bracelet has several amulets hanging from it, each inscribed with the name of a friend. The wearer can add a name to a blank charm by inscribing it and speaking the name aloud.
Up to five times per day as a standard action, the wearer can summon one of the named creatures as if using summon monster V. The summoned creature must be one whose name is on a charm. The summoned creature appears adjacent to the wearer and remains for up to 9 rounds. A creature whose name is inscribed on a charm can only be summoned if it is on the same plane as the wearer.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster V

Name: Bracers of Archery, Greater
Description: These wrist guards grant the wearer proficiency with all bows and a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls made with bows.

Name: Bracers of Armor (+5)
Description:
These items appear to be wrist or arm guards, sometimes etched with symbols of protection or depictions of vigilant-looking animals. Bracers of armor surround the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting him an armor bonus of +1 to +8, just as though he were wearing armor. Both bracers of armor must be worn for the magic to be effective.
Alternatively, bracers of armor can be enchanted with armor special abilities. See Table 3–3: Armor Special Abilities for a list of abilities. Special abilities usually count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of an item, but do not improve AC. Bracers of armor cannot have a modified bonus (armor bonus plus armor special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +8. Bracers of armor must have at least a +1 armor bonus to grant an armor special ability.
Bracers of armor cannot have any armor special abilities that add a flat gp amount to their cost. Bracers of armor and ordinary armor do not stack. If the wearer receives a larger armor bonus from another source, the bracers of armor cease functioning and do not grant their armor bonus or their armor special abilities. If the bracers of armor grant a larger armor bonus, the other source of armor ceases functioning.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, creator’s caster level must be at least two times that of the bonus placed on the bracers, plus any requirements of the armor special abilities

Name: Bracers of Sworn Vengeance
Description: These dark steel bracers bear etched oaths along their length. When the wearer designates a creature as her sworn enemy (a swift action), she gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and weapon damage rolls against that creature for 12 rounds. This ability can be used once per day.

Name: Belt of Giant Strength +2
Description: This belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Strength of +2.

Name: Belt of Incredible Dexterity +2
Description: This belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Dexterity of +2.

Name: Belt of Mighty Constitution +2
Description: This belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Constitution of +2.

Name: Belt of Teeth
Description: This belt is adorned with animal fangs and grants the wearer a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage if Medium (1d4 if Small). If the wearer already has a bite attack, its damage increases by one step. Once per day, as a swift action, the wearer can gain the benefits of rage for 5 rounds.

Name: Blinkback Belt
Description: This belt allows the wearer to have thrown weapons instantly return. Any weapon thrown by the wearer returns to her belt at the start of her next turn as if it had the returning special ability. This functions only if the weapon was drawn from the wearer’s belt.

Name: Plague Rat Belt
Description: This filthy leather belt is crawling with illusory rats. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on saving throws against disease. Once per day, as a standard action, the wearer can summon a swarm of rats (as summon swarm) that lasts for 7 rounds.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon swarm, remove disease

Name: Belt of Foraging
Description: This simple belt allows the wearer to sustain herself in the wilderness. Once per day, as a standard action, the wearer can create enough nourishing food and water to sustain up to four Medium creatures for 24 hours. The food spoils if not consumed within 24 hours.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, create food and water

Name: Cassock of the Clergy
Description: This simple cassock grants the wearer a +1 competence bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance. Once per day, when casting a cure spell, the wearer can maximize the spell’s healing as if using the Maximize Spell feat, without increasing the spell’s level.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure moderate wounds

Name: Mnemonic Vestments
Description: These robes allow a prepared spellcaster to recall one spell she has prepared and already cast. Once per day, as a swift action, the wearer can prepare a spell she has already cast that day, as long as she has a spell slot of the appropriate level available.

Name: Robe of Components
Description: This robe contains hidden pockets stocked with common spell components. The wearer can retrieve any material component worth 1 gp or less as a free action. The robe replenishes its supply each day at dawn.

Name: Sorcerer’s Robe
Description: This elegant robe grants the wearer a +1 competence bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance. If the wearer has a bloodline, once per day she can use one of her 1st-level bloodline powers one additional time.

Name: Eidolon Anchoring Harness
Description: This harness secures a summoner’s eidolon to the Material Plane. While worn, the eidolon gains a +2 circumstance bonus on saving throws against dismissal and banishment effects. Once per day, the wearer can grant the eidolon the benefits of dimensional anchor for 1 round.

Name: Robe of Useful Items
Description: This robe appears to be an ordinary robe, but it has small cloth patches sewn into it. Each patch can be detached and used to create a specific item, such as a dagger, bullseye lantern (filled and lit), ladder (24 feet long), rope (50 feet), sack, small wooden boat, or other common adventuring gear. Each patch can be used once, after which it disappears.

Name: Sash of the War Champion
Description: This broad sash grants the wearer a +1 competence bonus on attack rolls when charging. Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can grant herself a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and weapon damage rolls for 1 minute.

Name: Sipping Jacket
Description: This well-tailored jacket allows the wearer to consume a potion or similar liquid item stored on her person as a swift action once per day. The item must normally require a standard action to drink.

Name: Tunic of Careful Casting
Description: This simple tunic grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on concentration checks. Once per day, the wearer can ignore the need to make a concentration check to cast defensively.

Name: Vest of Escape
Description: This vest grants the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, freedom of movement

Name: Cackling Hag’s Blouse
Description: This ragged blouse grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. Once per day, as a standard action, the wearer can emit a terrifying cackle. Creatures within 30 feet must succeed at a Will save (DC 14) or be shaken for 1d4 rounds.

Name: Deadshot Vest
Description: This vest grants the wearer a +1 competence bonus on ranged attack rolls. Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +4 insight bonus on a single ranged attack roll.

Name: Prophet’s Pectoral
Description: This metal breastplate-like ornament grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge (religion) checks. Once per day, the wearer can use augury as the spell.

Name: Tunic of Deadly Might
Description: This tunic grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on damage rolls with melee weapons. Once per day, as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +4 competence bonus on damage rolls for 1 round.

Name: Vest of the Vengeful Tracker
Description: This vest grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Survival checks to track. Once per day, as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +5 insight bonus on a single Survival check made to track a creature.

Name: Resplendent Uniform
Description: This immaculate uniform grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks. Once per day, as a standard action, the wearer can grant allies within 30 feet a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute.

Name: Eyes of the Owl
Description: These lenses grant the wearer a +10 competence bonus on Perception checks made in dim light or darkness. In addition, the wearer gains low-light vision. If the wearer already has low-light vision, she can see three times as far as a human in dim light.

Name: Eyes of Keen Sight
Description: These lenses grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain the benefits of true strike on a single ranged attack made before the end of her turn.

Name: Treasure Hunter’s Goggles
Description: These goggles grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Appraise checks. Once per day, the wearer can activate the goggles as a standard action to gain the effects of locate object for 1 minute.

Name: Inquisitor’s Monocle
Description: This single-lens eyepiece grants the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks. Once per day, the wearer can activate the monocle as a swift action to gain the effects of discern lies for 1 minute.

Name: Kinsight Goggles
Description: These goggles grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can gain the benefits of see invisibility for 5 minutes.

Name: Burglar Boots, Minor
Description: These soft leather boots grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Disable Device and Stealth checks. Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain the benefits of expeditious retreat for 1 minute.

Name: Horseshoes of Crushing Blows +1
Description: These iron horseshoes grant the creature wearing them a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with hoof attacks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, magic fang

Name: Sandals of Quick Reaction
Description: These light sandals grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on initiative checks.

Name: Slippers of Cloudwalking
Description: These soft white slippers allow the wearer to walk upon clouds and fog as if they were solid ground.

Name: Slippers of Spider Climbing
Description: These slippers grant the wearer a climb speed of 20 feet and the ability to move on walls and ceilings as if under the effects of spider climb.

Name: Sandals of the Lightest Step
Description: These sandals allow the wearer to move silently. The wearer leaves no tracks and gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, pass without trace

Name: Boots of Striding and Springing
Description: These boots increase the wearer’s base land speed by 10 feet. In addition, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump.

Name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
Description: These horseshoes grant the creature wearing them the ability to move without touching the ground, as if under the effects of air walk (self only).

Name: Haunted Shoes
Description: These worn shoes whisper faintly. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause the shoes to emit a terrifying wail; creatures within 30 feet must succeed at a Will save (DC 16) or be shaken for 1d4 rounds.

Name: Jaunt Boots
Description: These boots allow the wearer to teleport up to 30 feet as a move action once per day, as dimension door (self only).

Name: Boots of Levitation
Description: These boots allow the wearer to use levitate at will (self only).

Name: Gauntlets of the Skilled Maneuver
Description: These gauntlets grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on combat maneuver checks.

Name: Ghostvision Gloves
Description: These thin gloves allow the wearer to see invisible and ethereal creatures within 30 feet for up to 3 rounds per day. The rounds need not be consecutive.

Name: Gloves of Arrow Snaring
Description: Once per day when the wearer would normally be hit by a ranged weapon attack, she can catch the weapon as if she had the Snatch Arrows feat.

Name: Trapspringer’s Gloves
Description: These gloves grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Disable Device checks made to disable traps and a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks made to locate traps.

Name: Gloves of Arcane Striking
Description: These gloves allow the wearer to use the Arcane Strike feat as if she possessed it. If the wearer already has Arcane Strike, the bonus damage increases by +1.

Name: Poisoner’s Gloves
Description: These black gloves grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks to create poisons. In addition, once per day the wearer can apply poison to a weapon as a swift action without risk of poisoning herself.

Name: Magnetist’s Gloves
Description: These metal-threaded gloves allow the wearer to pull a metal weapon within 30 feet to her hand as a standard action, as if using telekinesis (combat maneuver only). This ability can be used three times per day.

Name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
Description: These gloves grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Climb checks and a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Name: Circlet of Persuasion
Description: This silver circlet grants the wearer a +3 competence bonus on Charisma-based checks.

Name: Grappler’s Mask
Description: This leather mask grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on combat maneuver checks made to grapple and a +2 competence bonus to CMD against grapple attempts.

Name: Helm of Fearsome Mien
Description: This intimidating helm grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

Name: Jingasa of the Fortunate Soldier
Description: This conical helm grants the wearer a +1 insight bonus to AC. Once per day, when the wearer would be hit by an attack, she can negate the hit as an immediate action.

Name: Helm of Comprehend Languages and Read Magic
Description: This helm grants the wearer the continuous ability to understand all spoken and written languages, as comprehend languages, and to read magical writings, as read magic.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, comprehend languages, read magic

Name: Crown of Swords
Description: This iron crown bristles with small blades. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cause the crown to fire a volley of force blades at a single target within 30 feet, dealing 5d6 points of force damage (Reflex DC 14 half).

Name: Crown of Blasting, Minor
Description: This gem-studded crown allows the wearer to use searing light once per day (caster level 6th).

Name: Mask of the Krenshar
Description: This snarling mask grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can emit a terrifying shriek; creatures within 30 feet must succeed at a Will save (DC 14) or be shaken for 1d4 rounds.

Name: Plague Mask
Description: This beaked mask grants the wearer immunity to inhaled poisons and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against disease.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, delay poison, remove disease

Name: Headband of Alluring Charisma +2
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 252, Core Rulebook pg. 516
Description: This attractive headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma.

Name: Headband of Inspired Wisdom +2
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 252, Core Rulebook pg. 516
Description: This simple headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

Name: Headband of Vast Intelligence +2
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 252, Core Rulebook pg. 516
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Intelligence. The headband grants skill ranks as normal for a headband of vast intelligence.

Name: Headband of Aerial Agility +2
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity while flying and a +5 competence bonus on Fly checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cat’s grace, fly

Name: Shifter’s Headband +2
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution while under the effects of a polymorph effect.

Name: Headband of Ponderous Recollection
Description: This headband allows the wearer to reroll a single Knowledge check once per day and take the better result.

Name: Headband of Ki Focus
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Wisdom for the purpose of determining ki points.

Name: Headband of Unshakeable Resolve
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

Name: Hollywreath Band
Description: This wreath of holly grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on saving throws against charm effects and a +2 competence bonus on saving throws against compulsion effects.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

Name: Headband of Deathless Devotion
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on saving throws against death effects. Once per day, when the wearer would be reduced to negative hit points, she instead remains at 1 hit point.

Name: Phylactery of the Shepherd
Description: This small silver charm grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Handle Animal and wild empathy checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, speak with animals

Name: Headband of Intuition
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on initiative checks.

Name: Headband of Fortune’s Favor
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +1 luck bonus on saving throws and skill checks.

Name: Amulet of Elemental Strife
Description: This amulet shines brightly when brought within 60 feet of an outsider with the elemental subtype, shedding light as a torch. The amulet glows a different color depending on the subtype of the elemental or elementals present (white for air, yellow for earth, red for fire, and blue for water). If more than one subtype is present, the gem flickers back and forth between the appropriate colors.

Name: Righteous Fist Amulet
Description: This golden amulet is used by religious sects as a way to help the faithful capture fugitives or defend themselves without doing undue harm to potential converts. While the wearer is using her divine powers of retribution (such as a cleric’s smite, an inquisitor’s smiting judgment, or a paladin’s smite), the amulet grants her the ability to make unarmed strikes in melee combat as if she had the Improved Unarmed Strike feat.

Name: Amulet of Mighty Fists +1
Description: This amulet grants its wearer a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with unarmed attacks and natural weapons.

Name: Necklace of Fireballs (Type III)
Description: This item appears to be a string or cluster of spherical beads, sometimes with the ends tied together to form a necklace. (It does not count as an item worn around the neck for the purpose of determining which of a character’s worn magic items is effective.) If a character holds it, however, all can see the strand as it really is—a golden chain from which hang a number of golden spheres. The spheres are detachable by the wearer (and only by the wearer), who can easily hurl one of them up to 70 feet.

Name: Necklace of Fireballs (Type IV)
Description: This item functions as a Necklace of Fireballs (Type III) but contains more beads (and thus a greater total number of fireballs).

Name: Stormlure
Description: A stormlure is usually fashioned from pieces of creatures known for their affinity to air—the feathers of birds, the shells of flying insects, and the scales of a dragon. When activated, stormlures call to the wind, causing a tempestuous gale. Once per day on command, the wearer of a stormlure is surrounding by swirling winds for 1 minute, granting a 50% miss chance against all ranged attacks, including rays and other ranged spells that require a roll to hit. This wind does not hinder the wearer of the stormlure in any way. At any one time during this duration, as a swift action, the wearer can cause the air around her to fill with crackling lightning, dealing 4d6 points of electricity damage to all creatures adjacent to her. A DC 14 Reflex save halves this damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, lightning bolt, wind wall

Name: Necklace of Fireballs (Type V)
Description: This item functions as a Necklace of Fireballs (Type III) but contains more beads (and thus a greater total number of fireballs).

Name: Amulet of Bullet Protection +2
Description: This amulet, usually crafted from the splintered remains of spent firearm bullets shaped into a rough holy symbol or clover, grants the wearer a luck bonus to AC against firearm attacks that target touch AC.

Name: Feychild Necklace
Description: This necklace is set with a bloodstone sculpted to look like a scintillating green eye. It gives the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Charisma checks and Charisma-based checks made to interact with gnomes, a +2 competence bonus on similar checks when dealing with beings of the fey creature type, and a –2 penalty on similar checks when interacting with anyone else. The wearer can read, speak, and understand the Gnome language. If the wearer is not a gnome, she gains low-light vision, and may cast dancing lights, ghost sound, prestidigitation, and speak with animals each once per day as a spell-like ability.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be a gnome

Name: Carcanet of Detention
Description: Comprised of thick iron links, the carcanet of detention is commonly worn by prison guards and elite members of the city watch. Once per day, the wearer of the carcanet may command it to animate and attempt to wrap around one Medium or smaller creature within 15 feet. The target receives a DC 15 Reflex saving throw to avoid the chain. If the saving throw fails, the target is entangled and cannot move from its current location. As a full-round action, the target can attempt a new saving throw to end the effect; otherwise it persists for 10 minutes or until ended by the wearer as a swift action, at which point it returns to its carcanet form. The chain has a hardness of 10 and 15 hit points.

Name: Periapt of Health
Description: This simple periapt usually appears as a blue gemstone fastened to a silver chain designed to be worn about the neck. The wearer is immune to all disease, including supernatural diseases.

Name: Ring of counterspells
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 168, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: Upon first examination, this ring seems to be a ring of spell storing. However, while it allows a single spell of 1st through 6th level to be cast into it, that spell cannot be cast out of the ring again. Instead, should that spell ever be cast upon the wearer, the spell is immediately countered, as a counterspell action, requiring no action (or even knowledge) on the wearer’s part. Once so used, the spell cast within the ring is gone. A new spell (or the same one as before) may be placed into it again.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, imbue with spell ability

Name: Ring of maniacal devices
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 172, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 292
Description: This elaborately decorated ring is crafted with the design of a fierce dragon wrapped greedily around a shining gemstone. It grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on all Craft (traps) and Disable Device checks. Even if he has no ranks in these skills, the wearer may make Craft (traps) and Disable Device checks as if he were trained in them.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, fox’s cunning, creator must have 5 ranks in the relevant skill

Name: Ring of planar focus
Description:
This large silver ring has a massive setting for a cloudy white crystal about an inch in diameter. Once per week as a standard action, the wearer can tap the ring with a forked rod attuned to a specific plane (the focus for a plane shift spell). When tapped, the crystal transforms into a rough topographical map of the plane in question for 1 minute.
The wearer can manipulate the crystal to focus on a single specific location within the plane, although the topographical elements remain rough and display only large or well-known features around the desired location. If the wearer has been to that location personally, she can focus the crystal on the location in 1 full round. Otherwise, she can attempt a DC 15 Knowledge (planes) check to focus on a location of her choice as a full-round action.
This location must be a public or well-known area, such as a public plaza in the Common Quarter in the City of Brass. Obscure locations (such as Calistria’s private Garden of Hidden Fruits) or locations controlled by a divinity cannot be focused on—in all cases, the GM has final say on whether a region can be focused upon.
If the wearer casts plane shift to travel to the focused location while the map is active, she arrives without error at the site, rather than 5d% miles away. Once a ring of planar focus is used to aid a casting of plane shift, it becomes inactive for 24 hours.

Name: Ring of rat fangs
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 172, Advanced Race Guide pg. 155
Description: This bone ring is the shape of an elongated rat biting its own tail. The wearer gains a bite attack as a primary natural attack. This attack deals 1d4 points of piercing damage for a Medium wearer or 1d3 points of damage for a Small wearer. After about a week of wearing the ring, the wearer’s appearance becomes more ratlike, though she still looks like a member of her original race (for example, a human might gain prominent teeth).

Name: Ring of sacred mistletoe
Description:
This tiny ring of living mistletoe coils about the wearer’s finger of its own accord. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Handle Animal, Knowledge (nature), and wild empathy checks, and a wearer with the woodland stride ability can move effortlessly, without harm or impediment, even through magically created or manipulated plants. This does not allow the wearer to move through solid objects or creatures.

Furthermore, the wearer can use shillelagh once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, pass without trace, shillelagh

Name: Ring of spell knowledge II
Description:
This ring comes in four types: ring of spell knowledge I, ring of spell knowledge II, ring of spell knowledge III, and ring of spell knowledge IV. All of them are useful only to spontaneous arcane spellcasters. Through study, the wearer can gain the knowledge of a single spell in addition to those allotted by her class and level.
A ring of spell knowledge I can hold 1st-level spells only, a ring of spell knowledge II 1st- or 2nd-level spells, a ring of spell knowledge III spells of 3rd level or lower, and a ring of spell knowledge IV up to 4th-level spells.
A ring of spell knowledge is only a storage space; the wearer must still encounter a written, active, or cast version of the spell and succeed at a DC 20 Spellcraft check to teach the spell to the ring. Thereafter, the arcane spellcaster may cast the spell as though she knew the spell and it appeared on her class’ spell list.

Arcane spells that do not appear on the wearer’s class list are treated as one level higher for all purposes (storage and casting).

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be granted

Name: Ring of swarming stabs
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, Advanced Race Guide pg. 155
Description: This ring is crafted of hardened leather strips, into which bits of fur, feathers, bone, and ivory have been woven. Twice per day, when the wearer is flanking an opponent, he can as a swift action deal an additional 1d6 points of damage on a successful melee attack against that opponent. This is a sneak attack for any effects that reduce or negate such damage.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, guidance, creator must be able to sneak attack

Name: Ring of grit mastery
Description:
This ring is made out of fused firearm bullets, making it a chunky but overall impressive ring. Twice per day, as a free action, when the wearer regains grit, she can choose to store it in the ring of grit mastery instead of regaining the grit point. She can store up to 2 grit points within the ring in this way. She can spend the grit points stored in the ring either of the following ways.
Once per day, without the need to take an action to do so, the wearer can spend 1 grit point stored in the ring to grant herself a +2 insight bonus to initiative.

Once per day, as a standard action, the wearer of the ring can spend 2 grit points stored within the ring to activate a bullet shield as the spell (Ultimate Combat).

Any grit points stored in the ring disappear at the start of each day.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, anticipate peril, bullet shield, creator must have the grit class feature

Name: Cloak of Resistance +2
Description: Flecks of silver or steel are often sown amid the fabric of these magical cloaks. This garment offers magical protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus

Name: Cloak of the Scuttling Rat
Description:
This ragged cloak is made of dozens of rat pelts sewn together. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Climb checks and a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks in urban environments.
Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a climb speed of 20 feet for 1 minute.

Name: Seafoam Shawl
Description:
This light shawl is the color of sea foam and smells faintly of salt. The wearer can breathe water as easily as air and gains a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.
Once per day, the wearer can speak a command word to gain a swim speed of 30 feet for 10 minutes.

Name: Treeform Cloak
Description: This cloak is covered in leaves and small twigs. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can transform into a Small or Medium tree, as tree shape, for up to 1 hour. While in tree form, the wearer can see and hear as normal but cannot move.

Name: Eagle Cape
Description:
This cloak is fashioned from the feathers of a giant eagle. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Fly checks.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can gain a fly speed of 60 feet (average maneuverability) for 5 minutes.

Name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
Description: This cloak appears to be made of leather until the wearer enters salt water. At that time, the cloak of the manta ray adheres to the individual, and he appears nearly identical to a manta ray. He gains a swim speed of 60 feet and the ability to breathe underwater. In addition, he gains a +3 natural armor bonus.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, water breathing, alter self

Name: Hunter’s Cloak
Description:
This hooded cloak is stitched with animal patterns and hunting scenes. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Survival checks to track.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can gain the benefits of the scent ability for 10 minutes.

Name: Boro Bead (2nd)
Description: This small wooden bead is carved with druidic symbols. Once per day, when the wearer prepares spells, she can recover one expended 2nd-level druid spell as if it had not been cast.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be a druid

Name: Cautionary Creance
Description: This silken cord can be tied around the waist. If the wearer is moved more than 60 feet from the point where the cord was secured, she is instantly pulled back to that point as if affected by dimension door. The creance functions once per day.

Name: Escape Ladder
Description: This compact bundle unfolds into a 30-foot-long rope ladder when thrown into the air. The ladder anchors itself to a solid surface above and remains in place for 10 minutes.

Name: Far-Reaching Sight
Description: This small crystal lens grants the user a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks to see distant objects. Once per day, the user can cast clairvoyance (CL 5th).

Name: Ioun Stone (Clear Spindle)
Description: This stone sustains the wearer without need of food or drink.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, create food and water

Name: Marvelous Pigments
Description: These pigments enable their possessor to create actual, permanent objects by simply depicting them in two dimensions. The pigments must be applied to a surface and are sufficient to create objects totaling 1,000 cubic feet. Objects created must be contiguous and fit within the space available. The pigments cannot create magic items or creatures.

Name: Page of Spell Knowledge (2nd)
Description: This sheet of parchment is covered in densely scribbled arcane formulas. A spontaneous arcane spellcaster can study the page for 1 hour to permanently add the spell on the page to her list of spells known. The spell must be of a level she can cast and must appear on her class spell list. Once used, the page becomes blank.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast the spell scribed on the page

Name: Pearl of Power (2nd)
Description:
This seemingly normal pearl of average size and luster is a potent aid to all spellcasters who prepare spells. Once per day on command, a pearl of power enables the possessor to recall any one spell of a particular level that she had prepared and then cast that day. The spell is then prepared again, just as if it had not been cast.

The spell must be of a particular level, depending on the pearl. Different pearls exist for recalling one spell per day of each level from 1st through 9th and for the 0-level spells.

A pearl of power only functions for spells prepared by the possessor.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be recalled

Name: Preserving Flask (2nd)
Description: This stoppered glass flask can hold a single 2nd-level potion. Any potion placed within the flask does not lose potency over time and cannot be spoiled by environmental effects. A potion can remain within the flask indefinitely without degradation.

Name: Restorative Ointment
Description: This unguent has five applications. Each application cures 1d8+5 points of damage, removes fatigue, and neutralizes poison (as neutralize poison).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure light wounds, neutralize poison

Name: Stone Salve
Description: When applied to a creature that has been petrified, this salve reverses the effect as if by stone to flesh.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, stone to flesh

Name: Wind-Caller Compass
Description: This brass compass always points toward the strongest prevailing wind within 1 mile. Once per day, the user can call forth a gust of wind (as the spell, CL 5th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, gust of wind

Name: Goblin Fire Drum, Greater
Description: When struck as a standard action, this drum releases a 15-foot-radius burst of fire centered on the drum. Creatures in the area take 4d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 15 half). The drum can be used once per day.

Name: Knight’s Pennon, Battle
Description: This small banner can be attached to a lance or similar weapon. While carried into battle, it grants the bearer a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls made during a charge.

Name: Knight’s Pennon, Parley
Description: This small banner can be attached to a lance or similar weapon. While carried, it grants the bearer a +2 morale bonus on Diplomacy checks.

Name: Void Dust
Description: When sprinkled into the air, this dust creates a 10-foot-radius area that suppresses extradimensional travel for 10 minutes. Effects such as dimension door and teleport cannot function within the area.

Name: Incense of Meditation
Description: This incense enables a divine spellcaster to prepare spells with heightened focus. When burned for 1 hour during prayer or meditation, it allows the user to prepare one additional spell of up to 3rd level that day. The incense is consumed when used.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to prepare divine spells

Name: Admixture Vial
Description: This crystal vial allows the user to change the energy type of a spell with the energy descriptor to another energy type (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) once per day, as if using the Elemental Spell metamagic feat without increasing the spell’s level.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, Elemental Spell, creator must be able to cast spells with the energy descriptor

Name: Bag of Holding (Type II)
Description:
This bag appears similar to a type I bag of holding but is larger. It can hold up to 500 pounds not exceeding 70 cubic feet.

If a bag of holding is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is ruined, and its contents are lost forever. If a bag of holding is placed within a portable hole, it creates a rift to the Astral Plane.

Name: Bone Razor
Description: This curved blade carved from bone allows its wielder to harvest bone fragments from a corpse. Once per day, the user can animate a skeleton as if using animate dead (CL 7th), using the harvested bones.

Name: Horn of the Huntmaster
Description: This brass hunting horn grants its bearer a +2 competence bonus on Survival checks. Once per day when sounded, it grants all allies within 30 feet a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls against animals and magical beasts for 5 minutes.

Name: Insistent Doorknocker
Description: This ornate brass doorknocker can be affixed to any door. When struck as a standard action, it casts knock on the door (CL 9th). It can be used three times per day.

Name: Ioun Stone (Dusty Rose Prism)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +1 insight bonus to AC.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, shield of faith

Name: Mallet of Building
Description: This heavy wooden mallet allows its wielder to cast mending at will and fabricate once per day (CL 9th).

Name: Polymorphic Pouch
Description: This small leather pouch can hold one Tiny or smaller creature. Once per day, the creature placed within is affected by beast shape I for up to 9 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, beast shape I

Name: Scabbard of Stanching
Description: A weapon placed in this scabbard gains the ability to halt bleeding. When the weapon deals damage to a creature suffering from bleed damage, the bleed damage ends immediately.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure moderate wounds

Name: School of Eyes
Description: This small cluster of glass eyes can be scattered as a standard action. The eyes function as arcane eyes (CL 9th) and last for 9 minutes. The school can be used once per day.

Name: Sheath of Bladestealth
Description: A weapon stored in this sheath becomes invisible while sheathed. Once drawn, it remains invisible for 1 round. The sheath functions once per day.

Name: Stone of Alliance
Description: This smooth stone can be attuned to up to three creatures. When one attuned creature takes damage, another attuned creature can choose to take up to half that damage instead as an immediate action.

Name: Summoning Shackle
Description: This iron manacle can bind a summoned creature. While shackled, the creature cannot use teleportation or planar travel abilities.

Name: Eversmoking Bottle
Description: This stoppered bottle produces a cloud of smoke that spreads in a 50-foot radius when opened. The smoke functions as obscuring mist. The bottle can be stoppered to end the effect.

Name: Sustaining Spoon
Description: When placed in an empty container, this spoon creates a bland but nourishing porridge sufficient to feed one Medium creature. The spoon can be used three times per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, create food and water

Name: Wind Fan
Description: This ornate fan can create a gust of wind (as the spell) when waved. It can be used once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, gust of wind

Name: Grim Lantern
Description: This black iron lantern burns with a sickly green flame. Undead within 30 feet take a –2 penalty on attack rolls. The lantern can be used for up to 1 hour per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, hide from undead

Name: Coin of the Untrodden Road
Description: When flipped and allowed to fall to the ground, this silver coin points toward the safest path to a stated destination within 1 mile. The coin can be used once per day.

Name: Horn of Battle Clarity
Description: When sounded, this horn grants all allies within 30 feet a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against confusion and fear effects for 5 minutes. It can be used once per day.

Name: Life Link Badge
Description: This silver badge can be attuned to one creature. When that creature takes damage, the wearer of the badge can choose to take half of that damage instead as an immediate action. The badge functions once per day.

Name: Martyr’s Tear
Description: This crystalline tear can be crushed as a standard action to transfer up to 30 points of damage from one adjacent creature to the user. The tear is destroyed when used.

Name: Pipes of Haunting
Description: These wooden panpipes create a haunting melody when played. Once per day, creatures within 30 feet must succeed at a DC 16 Will save or become shaken for 5 rounds.

Name: Rope of Knots
Description: This 50-foot rope can tie itself into complex knots at the command of its owner. The rope can attempt a Use Rope check with a +15 bonus once per round.

Name: Singing Bell of Striking
Description: When rung as a standard action, this bell emits a resonant tone that deals 3d6 points of sonic damage to one target within 60 feet (Fortitude DC 15 half). It can be used once per day.

Name: Stone Familiar
Description: This small carved stone animal functions as a wizard’s familiar while carried. It grants the wearer the Alertness feat while held. The stone familiar cannot move or act independently.

Name: Book of Extended Summoning, Greater
Description: This spellbook allows a spellcaster who prepares spells to extend the duration of one summon monster spell per day as though using the Extend Spell feat, without increasing the spell’s level. The spell extended can be up to 5th level.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, Extend Spell, summon monster V

Name: Dragonbone Divination Sticks
Description: These carved sticks allow the user to cast augury once per day (CL 7th).

Name: Horn of Goodness/Evil
Description: This horn produces a 40-foot-radius burst of sound when blown. Good creatures within the area gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 hour. Evil creatures instead take a –1 penalty on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 hour (Will DC 14 negates). The horn can be used once per day.

Name: Naga-Scale Bindi
Description: This small decorative mark placed on the forehead grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma for 1 hour per day. The duration can be divided as desired.

Name: Bottle of Shadows
Description: This dark glass bottle contains a captured shadow. When opened, it releases a shadow (as the undead creature) under the control of the opener for 9 rounds. The bottle can be used once per week.

Name: Cape of Bravado
Description: This flamboyant cape grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. Once per day, the wearer can demoralize all enemies within 30 feet as a standard action.

Name: Instant Bridge
Description: This small wooden rod unfolds into a 30-foot-long wooden bridge when thrown across a gap. The bridge can support up to 2,000 pounds and remains for 10 minutes.

Name: Mirror of Guarding Reflections
Description: This hand mirror can reflect a single targeted spell back at its caster as if using spell turning. The mirror can reflect up to 3 spell levels per day.

Name: Folding Boat
Description: This small wooden box can unfold into a 10-foot-long boat that can carry up to 4 Medium creatures. It can also unfold into a 24-foot-long ship that can carry up to 15 Medium creatures. The boat can be used once per day and remains in its expanded form for up to 24 hours.

Name: Bottle of Air
Description: This glass bottle appears empty. When uncorked and placed over the mouth and nose, it provides a continuous supply of fresh air. The bottle can supply air indefinitely.

Name: Bag of Holding (Type III)
Description:
This bag appears similar to a type I bag of holding but is larger. It can hold up to 1,000 pounds not exceeding 150 cubic feet.

If a bag of holding is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is ruined, and its contents are lost forever. If a bag of holding is placed within a portable hole, it creates a rift to the Astral Plane.

Name: Balm of Impish Grace
Description: When applied to the body as a standard action, this balm grants the user a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity for 10 minutes.

Name: Candle of Clean Air
Description: When lit, this candle purifies the air within a 20-foot radius, neutralizing smoke, fog, and poisonous vapors. The candle burns for 1 hour.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, gust of wind, neutralize poison

Name: Harp of Charming
Description: This beautifully crafted harp allows its player to cast charm monster (Will DC 16 negates) once per day when played for at least 1 round.

Name: Manual of War
Description: This heavy tome grants its reader a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge (engineering) and Profession (soldier) checks after 1 hour of study. The bonus lasts for 24 hours.

Name: Bracers of Armor (+2)
Description:
These items appear to be wrist or arm guards, sometimes etched with symbols of protection or depictions of vigilant-looking animals. Bracers of armor surround the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting him an armor bonus of +1 to +8, just as though he were wearing armor. Both bracers of armor must be worn for the magic to be effective.
Alternatively, bracers of armor can be enchanted with armor special abilities. See Table 3–3: Armor Special Abilities for a list of abilities. Special abilities usually count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of an item, but do not improve AC. Bracers of armor cannot have a modified bonus (armor bonus plus armor special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +8. Bracers of armor must have at least a +1 armor bonus to grant an armor special ability.
Bracers of armor cannot have any armor special abilities that add a flat gp amount to their cost. Bracers of armor and ordinary armor do not stack. If the wearer receives a larger armor bonus from another source, the bracers of armor cease functioning and do not grant their armor bonus or their armor special abilities. If the bracers of armor grant a larger armor bonus, the other source of armor ceases functioning.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, creator’s caster level must be at least two times that of the bonus placed on the bracers, plus any requirements of the armor special abilities

Name: Bracers of Falcon’s Aim
Description:
These leather bracers are etched with tiny feathers. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on ranged attack rolls made within 30 feet.
Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can ignore the miss chance from concealment for 1 round.

Name: Inquisitor’s Bastion Vambraces
Description:
These sturdy steel vambraces grant the wearer a +1 sacred bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities.
If the wearer has the judgment class feature, she can use one judgment one additional time per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

Name: Bracers of Archery, Lesser
Description: These wrist guards grant the wearer proficiency with all bows and a +1 competence bonus on attack rolls made with bows.

Name: Spellguard Bracers
Description: These silver bracers protect the wearer’s magic. Once per day as an immediate action when the wearer is targeted by a spell, she gains a +4 bonus on her saving throw against that spell.

Name: Bonebreaker Gauntlets
Description:
These heavy gauntlets grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on grapple combat maneuver checks.
Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause her unarmed strikes to deal an additional 2d6 points of damage for 1 round.

Name: Vambraces of Defense
Description:
