These steel vambraces grant the wearer a +1 shield bonus to AC.
Once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can gain a +4 shield bonus to AC for 1 round.

Name: Verdant Vine
Description: This living vine coils about the wearer’s forearm. Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause the vine to lash out, making a melee touch attack against a creature within 10 feet. On a hit, the target is entangled for 1d4 rounds (Reflex DC 15 negates).

Name: Longarm Bracers
Description: These slender bracers extend the wearer’s reach. Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer’s reach increases by 5 feet for 1 round.

Name: Bracers of the Glib Entertainer
Description:
These brightly polished bracers grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Perform checks.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast enthrall (DC 15) as a spell-like ability.

Name: Feather Token (Anchor)
Description: This small feather can be thrown up to 20 feet. When it hits a solid surface, it transforms into a heavy iron anchor. The anchor weighs 1,000 pounds and remains for 24 hours before reverting to feather form.

Name: Universal Solvent
Description: This substance has the unique property of being able to dissolve any adhesive it comes in contact with. A single flask of universal solvent can dissolve sovereign glue and similar magical adhesives.

Name: Ioun Torch
Description: This crystalline sphere sheds light as a torch (20-foot radius). It floats near the owner’s head and orbits as an ioun stone does.

Name: Stubborn Nail
Description: This iron nail can be hammered into a surface. Once embedded, it cannot be removed by any means short of destroying the surface it is embedded in.

Name: War Paint of the Terrible Visage
Description: This thick, red paste is applied to the face and body. Once applied, the wearer gains a +1 circumstance bonus on Intimidate checks for 1 hour.

Name: Elixir of Love
Description: This sweet-smelling liquid causes the imbiber to become enamored with the first creature she sees after drinking it (as charm person, Will DC 14 negates). The effect lasts for 1 hour.

Name: Unguent of Timelessness
Description: When applied to any matter that was once alive, this ointment allows that substance to resist the passage of time. Each year that passes reduces to 1 day for the coated object.

Name: Feather Token (Fan)
Description: This feather can be waved to create a gust of wind as the spell gust of wind (CL 4th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, gust of wind

Name: Formula Alembic
Description: This alchemical device grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks when creating alchemical items.

Name: Hybridization Funnel
Description: This brass funnel allows a character to combine two potions. When two potions are poured into the funnel, the result is a single potion that has the effects of both original potions. The two potions must have the same caster level. If the potions have different caster levels, both potions are ruined.

Name: Soul Soap
Description: This small bar of soap can be used to cleanse corruption and foul influences. When used to wash a creature for 10 minutes, it grants a +2 resistance bonus on the next saving throw the creature attempts against a curse or disease within 24 hours.

Name: Dust of Tracelessness
Description: When this fine dust is sprinkled over a creature or object, it leaves no trail. For 5 minutes, the target leaves no footprints or scent and gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks to avoid leaving tracks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, pass without trace

Name: Elixir of Hiding
Description: This draught grants the imbiber a +10 competence bonus on Stealth checks for 1 hour.

Name: Elixir of Swimming
Description: This potion-like elixir grants the imbiber a +10 competence bonus on Swim checks for 1 hour.

Name: Elixir of Tumbling
Description: This fluid grants the imbiber a +10 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks for 1 hour.

Name: Elixir of Vision
Description: This elixir grants the imbiber low-light vision for 1 hour. If the imbiber already has low-light vision, its range doubles for the duration.

Name: Nightdrops
Description: These dark droplets can be applied to the eyes as a standard action. For 1 hour, the user gains a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks in dim light or darkness.

Name: Oil of Silence
Description: When applied to a creature or object, this oil creates a 5-foot-radius area of silence centered on the target for 3 rounds.

Name: Silversheen
Description: This metallic paste can be applied to a weapon as a standard action. For 1 hour, the weapon is treated as silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Name: Traveler’s Any-Tool
Description: This simple metal rod can transform into nearly any tool. It can become any mundane tool weighing up to 2 pounds. The tool remains in that form until the user commands it to return to rod form. It does not grant proficiency with the tool created.

Name: Bottle of Messages
Description: This stoppered bottle can hold a small written message. Once per day, the owner can speak a command word to send the bottle to a designated creature on the same plane. The bottle flies unerringly to the creature at a speed of 30 feet per round. If the creature is unwilling to receive the bottle, it falls to the ground at the creature’s feet.

Name: Feather Token (Bird)
Description: This feather transforms into a Small bird (as summon monster I) when tossed into the air. The bird remains for 1 hour before reverting to feather form.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster I

Name: Origami Swarm
Description: This folded paper packet unfolds into a swarm of Tiny paper animals that function as a rat swarm for 3 rounds. Afterward, the swarm collapses into inert paper.

Name: Alluring Golden Apple
Description: This golden apple can be thrown up to 30 feet. Any creature within 10 feet of where it lands must succeed at a DC 13 Will save or be fascinated for 1 round.

Name: Feather Token (Tree)
Description: This feather can be thrown up to 20 feet. When it strikes a surface, it transforms into a large oak tree, 60 feet tall with a 5-foot-diameter trunk. The tree remains for 1 hour before vanishing.

Name: Key of Lock Jamming
Description: When inserted into a lock and turned, this key causes the lock to become stuck. The lock cannot be opened by any means short of destroying it or using knock.

Name: Feather Token (Swan Boat)
Description: This feather transforms into a swan-shaped boat capable of carrying up to eight Medium creatures. The boat lasts for 1 day before reverting to feather form.

Name: Animated Portrait
Description: This painted portrait animates when commanded. The subject in the portrait can move and speak, relaying simple messages. The portrait can function for up to 10 minutes per day.

Name: Bottled Misfortune
Description: This stoppered bottle contains a swirling gray mist. When opened and directed at a creature within 30 feet, the target must succeed at a DC 14 Will save or take a –2 penalty on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute.

Name: Elixir of Truth
Description: This elixir forces the imbiber to speak truthfully (as zone of truth, Will DC 13 negates) for 10 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, zone of truth

Name: Feather Token (Whip)
Description: This feather transforms into a +1 whip when thrown to the ground. The whip remains for 1 hour before reverting to feather form.

Name: Scabbard of Honing
Description: This simple scabbard hones any blade placed within it. A weapon sheathed in the scabbard for at least 1 minute gains a +1 competence bonus on the next attack roll made with that weapon.

Name: Seer’s Tea
Description: When brewed and consumed, this fragrant tea grants the drinker a +5 competence bonus on one Knowledge check made within the next hour.

Name: Abjurant Salt
Description: This coarse white salt can be scattered in a 5-foot square. For 10 minutes, creatures summoned or called by conjuration spells cannot enter the area unless they succeed at a DC 13 Will save.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

Name: Arrow Magnet
Description: This small metal disk can be thrown to the ground as a standard action. For 1 minute, all ranged weapon attacks that pass within 10 feet of the disk are redirected to strike it instead (if possible). The disk has hardness 10 and 30 hit points.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from arrows

Name: Dust of Darkness
Description: When this fine black dust is thrown into the air, it creates an area of darkness as the spell darkness (CL 3rd). The effect lasts for 10 minutes.

Name: Campfire Bead
Description: This small red bead can be thrown to the ground as a standard action. It instantly creates a warm, crackling campfire that burns for 8 hours and produces light as a torch.

Name: Archon’s Torch
Description: This torch burns with a bright white flame. Evil creatures within 20 feet of the torch take a –1 penalty on attack rolls and saving throws against fear effects.

Name: Book of Extended Summoning, Lesser
Description: This spellbook allows a spellcaster who prepares spells to extend the duration of one summon monster spell per day as though using the Extend Spell feat, without increasing the spell’s level.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, extend spell, summon monster I

Name: Iron Rope
Description: This 50-foot length of rope is as flexible as hemp rope but as strong as iron. It has hardness 10 and 30 hit points. It can be commanded to stiffen or become flexible as a free action.

Name: Snapleaf
Description: This dried leaf can be affixed to a creature’s clothing. When the wearer falls more than 5 feet, the leaf activates and casts feather fall and invisibility on the wearer (CL 5th). The invisibility lasts for 5 rounds. The leaf is consumed when activated.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, feather fall, invisibility

Name: Bottled Yeti Fur
Description: When opened and applied, this bottle of thick white fur grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Fortitude saves against cold effects for 1 hour.

Name: Defoliant Polish
Description: When applied to a bladed weapon, this polish allows it to ignore hardness 5 or less when striking wooden objects for 1 hour.

Name: Dust of Emulation
Description: When sprinkled upon a creature, this dust grants a +2 competence bonus on a single skill check of the user’s choice made within 1 minute.

Name: Steadfast Gut-Stone
Description: This small, smooth stone is swallowed whole. For the next 24 hours, the imbiber gains a +2 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves against nausea and sickened effects. The stone passes naturally after 24 hours.

Name: Dust of Dryness
Description:
This small cloth packet is about the size of a hand and is full of dust. When thrown into water, it absorbs up to 100 gallons of water and becomes a marble-sized pellet. The pellet can be thrown to release the stored water.
If used against a water elemental or similar creature, it deals 2d6 points of damage (no save).

Name: Merform Belt
Description: This belt grants the wearer the ability to transform into a merfolk-like form as a standard action. While in this form, the wearer gains a swim speed of 60 feet, can breathe water, and gains a +2 natural armor bonus. The wearer retains the ability to breathe air. The transformation can be maintained for up to 10 minutes per day, which need not be consecutive.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, alter self, water breathing

Name: Belt of Giant Strength +6
Description: This belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Strength of +6.

Name: Belt of Incredible Dexterity +6
Description: This belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Dexterity of +6.

Name: Belt of Mighty Constitution +6
Description: This belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Constitution of +6.

Name: Belt of Physical Might +4
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to two physical ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution), chosen at creation.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, bear’s endurance

Name: Belt of Mighty Hurling, Greater
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength for the purpose of determining attack and damage rolls with thrown weapons only. In addition, thrown weapons deal damage as if the wearer’s Strength score were 4 points higher than normal.

Name: Gunman’s Duster
Description: This long, weathered leather coat grants the wearer a +4 armor bonus to AC. The wearer gains fire resistance 10 and electricity resistance 10. In addition, once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can gain the benefits of evasion for 1 round. If the wearer already has evasion, he instead gains improved evasion for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from energy, resist energy

Name: Bodywrap of Mighty Strikes +4
Description:
This long cloth is wrapped around the chest multiple times like a bandage. Once per round, the wearer may add an enhancement bonus of +1 to +5 on one attack and damage roll for an unarmed strike or natural attack (for one specific attack, not all attacks made with an unarmed strike that round). The wearer may use this item an additional time per round when his BAB reaches +6, +11, and +16.
Choosing to enhance an unarmed strike is not an action and may occur when it is not the wearer’s turn (such as when making an attack of opportunity). The wearer must decide to use the item before the attack roll is made, but does not have to expend all uses at the same time. For example, if the wearer can use the item twice per round, he can use it once on his turn when making an attack and save the second for the possibility of making an attack of opportunity.
Additionally, the bodywrap can grant melee weapon special abilities to a creature’s unarmed attacks, so long as those special abilities to be added apply to unarmed attacks. See Table 3–8: Melee Weapon Special Abilities (page 137) for a list of abilities. Special abilities count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of the item, but do not modify attack or damage bonuses. Any special abilities are set at the time of creation.
A bodywrap of mighty strikes cannot have a modified bonus (enhancement bonus plus special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +7. Unlike an amulet of mighty fists, a bodywrap needs to have a +1 enhancement bonus to grant a melee weapon special ability.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator's caster level must be at least three times the bodywrap's bonus, plus any requirements of the melee weapon special abilities

Name: Smuggler’s Collapsible Robe
Description: This robe appears to be an ordinary garment, but it can collapse into a tiny bundle that fits in the palm of the hand as a swift action. While worn, the robe creates a spacious extradimensional space capable of holding up to 100 pounds of items. Retrieving an item is a move action. If the robe is removed, the contents remain stored but are inaccessible until the robe is worn again. If the robe is destroyed, the contents are lost as with a bag of holding.

Name: Mantle of Immortality
Description: This long, black mantle grants its wearer immunity to death effects and energy drain. In addition, the wearer does not age, and any aging penalties she has already taken are removed while she wears the mantle. Bonuses from aging still apply. If the mantle is removed, aging penalties return immediately. The mantle does not prevent death from old age.

Name: Poisoner’s Jacket (Greater)
Description: Three times per day, the wearer of this dark jacket can create a vial containing one dose of any poison from the Core Rulebook that costs 3,000 gp or less. The jacket’s poison always looks like a murky amber fluid. This poison becomes inert after 1 hour.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, major creation, poison

Name: Eyes of Eyebite
Description: These dark, gleaming lenses allow the wearer to use eyebite once per day (caster level 11th).

Name: Sniper Goggles, Greater
Description: These precision-crafted goggles grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on ranged attack rolls and a +2 competence bonus on ranged damage rolls. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +20 competence bonus on a single ranged attack roll.

Name: Getaway Boots
Description: These boots allow the wearer to teleport up to 30 feet as an immediate action once per day, as dimension door (self only).

Name: Horseshoes of Crushing Blows +3
Description: These iron horseshoes grant the creature wearing them a +3 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with hoof attacks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, greater magic fang

Name: Horseshoes of Glory
Description: These golden horseshoes grant the creature wearing them a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects. Once per day, the creature can emit a triumphant whinny; allies within 30 feet gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws against fear for 1 minute.

Name: Burglar Boots, Major
Description: These soft leather boots grant the wearer a +10 competence bonus on Disable Device and Stealth checks. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, freedom of movement

Name: Boots of Teleportation
Description: These boots allow the wearer to use teleport three times per day (caster level 9th).

Name: Gloves of the Commanding Conjurer
Description: These dark gloves grant the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution. In addition, when the wearer casts a summon monster spell, the duration of the spell increases by 50%. Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can grant a summoned creature within 30 feet a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bear’s endurance, summon monster V

Name: Gauntlet of Rust, Greater
Description: This heavy iron gauntlet allows the wearer to corrode metal objects with a touch. Three times per day as a standard action, the wearer can make a melee touch attack against a metal object to deal 6d6 points of damage to it (ignoring hardness).

Name: Iron Circlet of Guarded Souls
Description: This thin iron band is cold to the touch and etched with tiny protective sigils. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against death effects and negative energy effects. In addition, once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can negate a single negative level she would gain.

Name: Laurel of Command
Description: This wreath of golden leaves grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Charisma-based skill checks. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can use greater command (Will DC 17 negates).

Name: Mask of Giants, Lesser
Description: This fearsome mask transforms the wearer into a Large humanoid giant (as enlarge person, except the wearer’s type changes to giant). The transformation lasts for up to 10 minutes per day, which need not be consecutive.

Name: Steel-Mind Cap
Description: This simple steel skullcap grants the wearer a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects. In addition, once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can negate a mind-affecting effect that has just targeted her.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

Name: Stormlord’s Helm
Description: This helm crackles faintly with electricity. The wearer gains resistance 10 against electricity. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can call down a bolt of lightning, as call lightning (caster level 11th).

Name: Helm of Brilliance, Lesser
Description: This polished steel helm is set with gems that glow faintly. The helm has 10 rubies and 10 diamonds. The wearer gains fire resistance 20. Each ruby can be used to produce one fireball (caster level 10th), and each diamond can be used to produce one wall of fire (caster level 10th). Once a gem is used, it crumbles to dust.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, fireball, wall of fire

Name: Soulbound Eye
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 253, Rival Guide pg. 41
Description:
Appearing at first like an expensive, masochistic adornment, this almond-sized star ruby is set in a gold clasp, one side of which is festooned with several long spikes. A soulbound eye is not an item that most creatures would voluntarily wear— they are instead crafted by powerful creatures who wish to use another creature as a sort of remote-viewing slave.
A soulbound eye must be attached to a willing or helpless creature by pressing the spike-covered surface to the creature’s brow—the gem swiftly and painfully embeds itself in the victim’s forehead, immediately activating to forge a shared link between the wearer and the creature who placed the item on its head (the “master”).
Once implanted, the soulbound eye allows the master to observe the world around the wearer through the wearer’s senses. It also allows for telepathic communication between the wearer and the master. Neither of these features function across planar boundaries.
The soulbound eye’s wearer is not compelled to obey its master’s telepathic commands, but the master can use the soulbound eye as a conduit for hold monster, modify memory, pain strike (Advanced Player’s Guide), and suggestion spells, treating the wearer as the target of the spell no matter the distance between master and wearer. The victim is allowed any normal saving throws or spell resistance against spells cast through the soulbound eye.
An implanted soulbound eye functions like a cursed item once it is in place—it can only be removed if the curse is first lifted via an effect like remove curse or break enchantment. Once removed, a soulbound eye crumbles to fragments.

Name: Winter Wolf Headband
Description: Crafted of pale bone or silver, this headband features a snarling wolf’s head centered on the wearer’s forehead. The wearer gains cold resistance 10. Once per day, the wearer may transform into a Large white-furred wolf for 11 minutes. In addition, once per day the wearer may breathe a 30-foot cone of cold that deals 7d6 points of cold damage (Reflex DC 16 for half). The wearer may use this breath weapon even when transformed.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, beast shape II, dragon’s breath (Advanced Player’s Guide), resist energy

Name: Headband of Alluring Charisma +6
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 248, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 516
Description: This attractive silver headband is decorated with a number of small red and orange gemstones. The headband grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Charisma of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn.

Name: Headband of Inspired Wisdom +6
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 250, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 516
Description: This simple bronze headband is decorated with an intricate pattern of fine green etchings. The headband grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Wisdom of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn.

Name: Headband of Vast Intelligence +6
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 251, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 517
Description:
This intricate gold headband is decorated with several small blue and deep purple gemstones. The headband grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Intelligence of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn. A headband of vast intelligence has one skill associated with it per +2 bonus it grants. After being worn for 24 hours, the headband grants a number of skill ranks in those skills equal to the wearer’s total Hit Dice.
These ranks do not stack with the ranks a creature already possesses. These skills are chosen when the headband is created. If no skill is listed, the headband is assumed to grant skill ranks in randomly determined Knowledge skills.

Name: Shifter's Headband +6
Description:
This band of reddish fox fur is marked on the front with a distinctive symbol that constantly shifts into a different character. The headband grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to one mental ability score (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma) of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn. This bonus is chosen when the headband is created and cannot be changed.
If the headband grants a bonus to Intelligence, it also grants skill ranks as a headband of vast intelligence.
If the wearer is a creature who uses magic to change form, she gains the following additional benefits.

Shifter’s headband +2: The wearer treats her caster level as if it were one level higher when casting spells or creating extracts of the polymorph subschool.

Shifter’s headband +4: Once per day while under the effect of a polymorph spell or extract, the wearer can assume another form allowed by that effect. This is a standard action.
Shifter’s headband +6: Whenever the wearer changes her shape with a polymorph effect, she gains DR 5/silver for 1 minute (this ends if she returns to her natural form).

These additional shapeshifter abilities are cumulative. For example, a creature wearing a shifter’s headband +4 gains the extra transformation ability and treats her caster level as 1 higher than normal for polymorph spells and extracts.

Name: Headband of Mental Prowess +4
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 250, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 517
Description:
This simple copper headband has a small yellow gem set so that when it rests upon the forehead of the wearer, the yellow gem sits perched on the wearer’s brow as if it were a third eye in the middle of her forehead. Often, the headband contains additional designs to further accentuate the appearance of a third, crystal eye.
The headband grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to two mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma) of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn.

These bonuses are chosen when the headband is created and cannot be changed. If the headband grants a bonus to Intelligence, it also grants skill ranks as a headband of vast intelligence.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor, fox's cunning, owl's wisdom (any two)

Name: Headband of Seduction
Description: This plain white band makes the wearer seem more attractive. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Charisma-based checks with other members of his creature type. If the wearer is of the humanoid type, he gains a +5 competence bonus on creatures of his subtype instead. Once per day, the wearer can attempt to affect a creature as the spell unnatural lust (Ultimate Magic) but with a duration of 10 minutes.

Name: Headband of Aerial Agility +4
Description:
This headband is decorated with feathers from a number of colorful birds. It grants boons to flying magic, and more powerful versions grant the power of flight. The wearer of a headband of aerial agility +2 treats his caster level as if it were one level higher when casting spells or creating extracts that grant flight. A headband of aerial agility +4 gains the same benefits and, on command, grants the wearer the ability to fly (as the fly spell) three times per day.
A headband of aerial agility +6 functions like a +4 version, but the headband grants the ability to use fly at will.
All versions also grant the wearer an enhancement bonus to one mental ability score (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma) of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn. This bonus is chosen when the headband is created and cannot be changed. If the headband grants a bonus to Intelligence, it also grants skill ranks as a headband of vast intelligence, usually granting ranks in Fly, Acrobatics, or Knowledge (planes).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, Extend Spell, fly

Name: Amulet of Natural Armor +4
Description: This amulet, usually crafted from bone or beast scales, toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor bonus of +4.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, creator’s caster level must be at least three times the amulet’s bonus

Name: Amulet of Proof Against Detection and Location
Description: This silver amulet protects the wearer from scrying and magical location. The wearer is protected by a nondetection effect (CL 8th).

Name: Amulet of Mighty Fists +3
Description: This amulet grants its wearer a +3 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with unarmed attacks and natural weapons.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator’s caster level must be at least three times the amulet’s bonus

Name: Amulet of Bullet Protection +5
Description: This amulet grants the wearer a +5 luck bonus to AC against firearm attacks that target touch AC.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from arrows

Name: Scarab of Protection
Description: This device appears to be a silver medallion in the shape of a beetle. If it is held for 1 round, it enables the possessor to determine whether there is poison in a creature or object he is handling, tasting, or smelling. The scarab can be used to detect poison 1/day. If it is placed around the neck, the scarab gives the wearer a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against poison and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against death effects. In addition, it absorbs energy drain and negative energy effects directed at the wearer. Each time a negative level would be bestowed upon the wearer, one of the scarab’s charges is instead permanently drained. The scarab has 12 charges.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, death ward, neutralize poison

Name: Necklace of Netted Stars
Description: This necklace is strung with small metal stars connected by delicate chains. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cause the necklace to detach and expand into a shimmering net of force that functions as a wall of force shaped into a 10-foot-square net. The net can entangle creatures in its area (Reflex DC 17 negates). The net persists for 5 rounds before collapsing back into necklace form.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, wall of force

Name: Ring of energy resistance, major
Description: This ring grants the wearer resistance 20 against one type of energy (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic), chosen when the ring is created.

Name: Ring of the ecclesiarch
Description: This gold ring is engraved with tiny religious symbols. The wearer gains a +2 sacred bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities cast by creatures of an alignment opposed to the wearer’s deity. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +2 sacred bonus on attack rolls against creatures of an alignment opposed to her deity for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, protection from chaos/evil/good/law (as appropriate)

Name: Ring of protection +4
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 173, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring grants a +4 deflection bonus to AC.

Name: Ring of return
Description: This ring is typically crafted with a tiny weapon motif. Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause a thrown weapon she has just used to instantly teleport back to her hand after the attack is resolved. The weapon must have been thrown by the wearer and must still be within 100 feet.

Name: Ring of freedom of movement
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 170, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring continually grants the wearer freedom of movement, as the spell. This effect allows the wearer to move and attack normally for the duration, even under the influence of magic that usually impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow, and web.

Name: Ring of wizardry II
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: This ring allows a wizard to prepare extra spells. It doubles the number of 2nd-level spells a wizard can prepare each day. This ring does not grant extra spells to other arcane spellcasters, even if they prepare spells (such as magi).

Name: Ring of inner fortitude, major
Description: This ring grants the wearer a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against fatigue and exhaustion effects. In addition, once per day when the wearer would become fatigued or exhausted, she can ignore that condition for up to 1 minute. If the effect causing the condition would last longer than 1 minute, the condition resumes after the minute has elapsed.

Name: Ring of energy resistance, greater
Description: This ring grants the wearer resistance 30 against one type of energy (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic), chosen when the ring is created.

Name: Ring of delayed doom
Description: Once per day, when the wearer would be reduced to –1 hit points or fewer, she can activate this ring as an immediate action. For 3 rounds, she cannot be reduced below 1 hit point and does not fall unconscious from hit point loss. At the end of the duration, she immediately takes all damage that would have reduced her below 1 hit point. This ring does not prevent death from effects that kill without dealing hit point damage.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, death ward, delay poison

Name: Suzerain scepter
Description: This ornately bejeweled baton confers the mark of rightful rulership on its bearer. The wielder of this scepter gains a +5 competence bonus on Knowledge (nobility) and Diplomacy checks. Furthermore, once per day, and on command, the wielder can affect up to seven living creatures with good hope, as the spell. If the wielder of a suzerain scepter has the Leadership feat, she may attract double the normal number of followers for her Leadership score; however, if the rod is out of the wielder’s possession for more than 1 week these extra followers leave. In addition, a suzerain scepter radiates a continuous bless effect that affects any cohort, follower, animal companion, familiar, special mount, or creature charmed or summoned by the wielder (but not called creatures or those under dominate or other compulsion effects). Whenever the wielder creates an effect that provides a morale bonus to such creatures (not including the scepter’s bless effect), that bonus increases by 1.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, Leadership, bless, good hope, greater command, the creator must have the Leadership feat

Name: Fiery nimbus rod
Description:
This rod functions as a +1 flaming burst light mace. Furthermore, when the rod confirms a critical hit, not only does it deal the extra damage from the flaming burst special ability, a nimbus of cold blue flames ignites the target for 1d4 rounds. This illuminates the target as the faerie fire spell. While the nimbus does not burn the target, it responds to melee attacks made against that foe. Each time an ignited foe takes damage from a melee attack, it takes and additional 1d10 fire damage.

Furthermore, once per day, as a free action, after hitting a foe with this rod, the wielder can surround the target of that attack with the nimbus, which has the same effect as the nimbus created by a confirmed critical hit.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, flame blade, flame strike or fireball, fairy fire

Name: Rod of Enemy Detection
Description: This rod pulses and vibrates in the wielder’s hand and points toward hostile creatures. As a standard action, the wielder can command the rod to detect enemies. The rod immediately reveals the direction of all creatures actively hostile toward the wielder within 60 feet. It does not reveal the specific creature’s location, only the direction. The effect penetrates barriers but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt. The rod can be used continuously for up to 10 minutes per day, which need not be consecutive.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, detect evil, detect thoughts

Name: Metamagic Rod (Greater, +1 Spell Level)
Description: This greater metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply a +1 spell level metamagic feat to spells of 9th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The specific metamagic feat depends on the rod variant (such as Empower Spell, Extend Spell, Enlarge Spell, etc.). The wielder must have the appropriate spell on their class spell list to benefit from the rod.

Name: Metamagic Rod, Apocalyptic (Greater)
Description: This greater metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Apocalyptic Spell metamagic feat to spells of 9th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The wielder must be capable of casting the spell normally.

Name: Metamagic Rod, Authoritative (Greater)
Description: This greater metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Authoritative Spell metamagic feat to spells of 9th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The wielder must be capable of casting the spell normally.

Name: Metamagic Rod, Blissful (Greater)
Description: This greater metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Blissful Spell metamagic feat to spells of 9th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The wielder must be capable of casting the spell normally.

Name: Metamagic Rod, Crypt (Greater)
Description: This greater metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Crypt Spell metamagic feat to spells of 9th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The wielder must be capable of casting the spell normally.

Name: Metamagic Rod, Tumultuous (Greater)
Description: This greater metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Tumultuous Spell metamagic feat to spells of 9th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The wielder must be capable of casting the spell normally.

Name: Rod of Splendor
Description: This rod appears to be a royal scepter. The wielder gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma for as long as she holds the rod. Three times per day, the wielder can command the rod to transform her clothing and accessories into grand and splendid attire, including jewelry and accoutrements appropriate to royal court. The garments last for 12 hours before disappearing. The rod also allows its wielder to use suggestion (DC 14) once per day.

Name: Rod of Withering
Description: This rod functions as a +1 light mace. On a successful hit, the rod deals 1d4 points of Strength damage and 1d4 points of Constitution damage to a living target (Fortitude DC 17 negates the Strength damage but not the Constitution damage). The rod has 3 charges per day, and each successful hit expends 1 charge. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.

Name: Rod of Vicious Ghosts
Description: This rod allows the wielder to call forth wrathful spirits. Three times per day, as a standard action, the wielder can create a swarm of ghostly apparitions that harry a single creature within 30 feet. The target takes 5d6 points of damage (Will DC 16 half). The spirits remain for 1 round, granting the target the shaken condition for the duration. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, spiritual weapon, cause fear

Name: Earthbind Rod
Description: This rod allows the wielder to cast earthbind three times per day. When used, the spell functions at caster level 9th. The spell forces a flying creature to descend, negating its ability to fly if it fails its Reflex save (DC 16).

Name: Rod of the Aboleth
Description: This rod allows the wielder to breathe water freely as if under the effects of water breathing. Three times per day, the wielder can use dominate person (DC 17). Once per day, the wielder can use slime wave (DC 18).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, water breathing, dominate person, slime wave

Name: Liberator’s Rod
Description: This rod allows the wielder to break bonds and restraints. Three times per day, the wielder can use break enchantment. In addition, once per day, the wielder can grant a single creature within 30 feet the effects of freedom of movement for 10 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, break enchantment, freedom of movement

Name: Metamagic Rod (Normal, +2 Spell Level)
Description: This normal metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply a +2 spell level metamagic feat to spells of 6th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or level. The rod can be used 3 times per day. The specific metamagic feat depends on the rod variant (such as Empower Spell, Maximize Spell, etc.). The wielder must have the appropriate spell on their class spell list to benefit from the rod.

Name: Metamagic Rod, Stygian
Description: This metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Stygian Spell metamagic feat to spells of 6th level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day.

Name: Rod of Thunder and Lightning
Description:
This rod can function as a +2 light mace. It has the following powers:

• Thunderclap: Once per day, the wielder can cause a thunderclap that deals 2d6 points of sonic damage in a 10-foot radius (Fortitude DC 14 half) and stuns creatures for 1 round if they fail their save.
• Lightning Strike: Once per day, the wielder can call down a lightning bolt (as the spell, 9d6 damage, Reflex DC 14 half).
• Thunder and Lightning: Once per week, the wielder can combine both effects in a single action.

Using the combined effect expends both daily uses.

Name: Metamagic Rod, Quicken (Minor)
Description: This minor metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Quicken Spell feat to spells of 3rd level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or level. The rod can be used 3 times per day.

Name: Rod of Negation
Description: This rod negates magical effects. Three times per day, the wielder can use dispel magic (as targeted dispel). Once per day, the wielder can use greater dispel magic. The caster level for these effects is 11th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, dispel magic, greater dispel magic

Name: Rod of Steadfast Resolve
Description: This rod grants the wielder a +4 morale bonus on Will saves against fear effects. Three times per day, the wielder can grant herself or an ally within 30 feet a +4 morale bonus on saving throws for 1 minute. Once per day, the wielder can remove fear from all allies within 30 feet.

Name: Highwayman’s Cape
Description: This dark cloak seems to swallow light around its folds. Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can teleport up to 30 feet to a space she can see. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. In addition, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks made in dim light or darkness.

Name: Juggernaut’s Pauldrons
Description:
These massive iron pauldrons grant the wearer a +4 competence bonus on bull rush and overrun combat maneuver checks and a +4 competence bonus to CMD against bull rush and overrun attempts.
Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +6 enhancement bonus to Strength for 12 rounds.

Name: Charlatan’s Cape
Description:
This flamboyant cape shimmers with illusory colors. The wearer gains a +10 competence bonus on Bluff checks.
Three times per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast major image (DC 16) as a spell-like ability.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Obsidian Steed)
Description: This obsidian statuette can transform into a heavy warhorse made of black stone. The steed can be used once per week for up to 24 hours. While in horse form, it can fly at a speed of 60 feet (good maneuverability).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, animate objects, overland flight

Name: Cauldron of the Dead
Description: This large iron cauldron can be used to create undead. Once per day, if a corpse is placed within and boiled for 1 hour, it rises as a zombie under the control of the user, as if animated by animate dead.

Name: Drums of Panic
Description: When beaten as a standard action, these drums create a wave of fear in a 30-foot-radius burst. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 16 Will save or become panicked for 2d4 rounds. The drums can be used once per day.

Name: Ioun Stone (Orange Prism)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +1 caster level.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be 12th level

Name: Ioun Stone (Pale Green Prism)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +1 competence bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks.

Name: Lantern of Revealing
Description: This bullseye lantern operates as a normal lantern but also reveals invisible creatures and objects within its light, as if using invisibility purge (CL 5th). The lantern functions continuously while lit.

Name: Racing Broom of Flying
Description: This broom functions as a broom of flying but has a fly speed of 60 feet (perfect maneuverability). It can carry up to 200 pounds and can be used for up to 9 hours per day.

Name: Cauldron of Resurrection
Description: If a deceased creature’s remains are placed within this cauldron and boiled for 1 hour, the creature is restored to life as if by raise dead (CL 13th). The cauldron can be used once per week.

Name: Carpet of Flying (5 ft. by 10 ft.)
Description: This carpet can fly as if using overland flight (CL 9th). It can carry up to 400 pounds and has a speed of 40 feet (perfect maneuverability). The carpet can fly for up to 9 hours per day.

Name: Golem Manual (Iron)
Description:
The wondrous items known as golem manuals contain all the information and magical power required to create a particular kind of golem. This effectively grants the Craft Construct feat to anyone using the manual to craft a golem of that type, and it provides an increase in caster level for the purpose of meeting the prerequisite to craft that specific type of golem.
Further, the manual grants a +5 competence bonus on skill checks to craft the golem and contains all the necessary spells, which can be activated by anyone who has the relevant spells on their class’s spell list (but only for the purpose of crafting the golem). When using a golem manual, you must still spend the normal amount of time to craft the golem and pay the cost of the golem’s body (or provide it through other means), but you do not need to pay the rest of the normal cost to create the golem.
The spells included in a golem manual require a spell trigger activation and can be activated only to assist in the construction of a golem. The cost of the book does not include the cost of constructing the golem’s body. Once the golem is finished, the writing in the manual fades and the book is consumed in flames. When the book’s ashes are sprinkled upon the golem, it becomes fully animated.
Iron: The book contains cloudkill, geas/quest, limited wish, and polymorph any object. The reader may treat her caster level as one level higher than normal for the purpose of crafting an iron golem.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Construct, cloudkill, geas/quest, limited wish, polymorph any object, creator must be caster level 16th

Name: Boro Bead (6th)
Description: This small wooden bead is carved with druidic symbols. Once per day, when the wearer prepares spells, she can recover one expended 6th-level druid spell as if it had not been cast.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be a druid

Name: Ioun Stone (Vibrant Purple Prism)
Description: This stone stores spells cast into it. It can store up to 3 spell levels at a time. A stored spell can be cast by the wearer as if she had prepared it.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, imbue with spell ability

Name: Orb of Utter Chaos
Description: This swirling sphere radiates unstable energy. Once per day as a standard action, the bearer can cause the orb to emit a 30-foot-radius burst of chaotic energy. Lawful creatures in the area take 5d6 points of damage (Will DC 18 half). Chaotic creatures instead gain 5d6 temporary hit points for 1 hour.

Name: Page of Spell Knowledge (6th)
Description: This sheet of parchment is covered in densely scribbled arcane formulas. A spontaneous arcane spellcaster can study the page for 1 hour to permanently add the spell on the page to her list of spells known. The spell must be of a level she can cast and must appear on her class spell list. Once used, the page becomes blank.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast the spell scribed on the page

Name: Pearl of Power (6th)
Description:
This seemingly normal pearl of average size and luster is a potent aid to all spellcasters who prepare spells. Once per day on command, a pearl of power enables the possessor to recall any one spell of a particular level that she had prepared and then cast that day. The spell is then prepared again, just as if it had not been cast.

The spell must be of a particular level, depending on the pearl. Different pearls exist for recalling one spell per day of each level from 1st through 9th and for the 0-level spells.

A pearl of power only functions for spells prepared by the possessor.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be recalled

Name: Preserving Flask (6th)
Description: This stoppered glass flask can hold a single 6th-level potion. Any potion placed within the flask does not lose potency over time and cannot be spoiled by environmental effects. A potion can remain within the flask indefinitely without degradation.

Name: Cauldron of Flying
Description: This large iron cauldron can be commanded to rise into the air and fly as if using overland flight (CL 13th). It can carry up to 1,000 pounds and has a fly speed of 40 feet (average maneuverability). The cauldron can fly for up to 13 hours per day.

Name: Enmity Fetish
Description: This carved idol creates hatred between two creatures. Once per day, the bearer can target two creatures within 30 feet; both must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or become hostile toward each other as if affected by hatred for 1 hour.

Name: Ioun Stone (Lavender and Green Ellipsoid)
Description: This stone absorbs spells targeted at its wearer, functioning as a spell turning effect that can absorb up to 8 spell levels per day.

Name: Ring Gates
Description: These two iron rings are linked by a permanent portal. Anything passed through one ring emerges from the other. Each ring has a diameter of 18 inches and can transport up to 100 pounds of material per day.

Name: Cauldron of Seeing
Description: When filled with water and activated, this cauldron functions as scrying (CL 13th). The user must concentrate for 1 hour to view the target. The cauldron can be used once per day.

Name: Crystal Ball
Description: This crystal sphere allows the user to see distant locations as if using scrying (CL 13th). The user must concentrate for 1 hour to view the target. The crystal ball can be used once per day.

Name: Golem Manual (Stone Guardian)
Description:
The wondrous items known as golem manuals contain all the information and magical power required to create a particular kind of golem. This effectively grants the Craft Construct feat to anyone using the manual to craft a golem of that type, and it provides an increase in caster level for the purpose of meeting the prerequisite to craft that specific type of golem.
Further, the manual grants a +5 competence bonus on skill checks to craft the golem and contains all the necessary spells, which can be activated by anyone who has the relevant spells on their class’s spell list (but only for the purpose of crafting the golem). When using a golem manual, you must still spend the normal amount of time to craft the golem and pay the cost of the golem’s body (or provide it through other means), but you do not need to pay the rest of the normal cost to create the golem.
The spells included in a golem manual require a spell trigger activation and can be activated only to assist in the construction of a golem. The cost of the book does not include the cost of constructing the golem’s body. Once the golem is finished, the writing in the manual fades and the book is consumed in flames. When the book’s ashes are sprinkled upon the golem, it becomes fully animated.
Stone Guardian: The book contains animate objects, geas/quest, limited wish, and stoneskin. The reader may treat her caster level as one level higher than normal for the purpose of crafting a stone guardian.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Construct, animate objects, geas/quest, limited wish, stoneskin, creator must be caster level 14th

Name: Drums of Haste
Description: When beaten as a standard action, these drums grant the effects of haste (CL 10th) to all allies within 30 feet for 10 rounds. The drums can be used once per day.

Name: Strand of Prayer Beads, Standard
Description:
This strand of prayer beads contains a number of magical beads. A standard strand includes a bead of blessing, bead of healing, bead of karma, and bead of smiting. Each bead can be used once per day.

Bead of blessing: Grants the effects of bless (CL 10th).
Bead of healing: Cures 3d8+10 points of damage.
Bead of karma: Grants a +4 insight bonus to caster level for 10 minutes.
Bead of smiting: Grants a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls against evil creatures for 10 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bless, cure serious wounds, divine power, creator must be able to cast divine spells

Name: Orb of Storms
Description: This crackling sphere allows the bearer to control weather in a 1-mile radius, as if using control weather (CL 15th). The orb can be used once per day and the effect lasts for 4d12 hours.

Name: Page of Spell Knowledge (7th)
Description: This sheet of parchment is covered in densely scribbled arcane formulas. A spontaneous arcane spellcaster can study the page for 1 hour to permanently add the spell on the page to her list of spells known. The spell must be of a level she can cast and must appear on her class spell list. Once used, the page becomes blank.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast the spell scribed on the page

Name: Pearl of Power (7th)
Description:
This seemingly normal pearl of average size and luster is a potent aid to all spellcasters who prepare spells. Once per day on command, a pearl of power enables the possessor to recall any one spell of a particular level that she had prepared and then cast that day. The spell is then prepared again, just as if it had not been cast.

The spell must be of a particular level, depending on the pearl. Different pearls exist for recalling one spell per day of each level from 1st through 9th and for the 0-level spells.

A pearl of power only functions for spells prepared by the possessor.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be recalled

Name: Staff of acid
Description:
This staff is capped with a translucent green crystal that constantly weeps droplets of harmless acid. It allows use of the following spells:

• acid splash (1 charge)
• acid arrow (2 charges)
• acid fog (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, acid arrow, acid fog, acid splash

Name: Staff of shrieking
Description:
This blackened bone staff constantly emits faint whispering. It allows use of the following spells:

• doom (1 charge)
• scare (2 charges)
• fear (3 charges)

Name: Chaotic staff
Description:
This staff functions as a +2/+2 quarterstaff and allows use of the following spells:

• chaos hammer (2 charges)
• protection from law (1 charge)
• align weapon (chaotic only) (1 charge)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, chaos hammer, protection from law, align weapon

Name: Holy staff
Description:
This staff functions as a +2/+2 quarterstaff and allows use of the following spells:

• holy smite (2 charges)
• protection from evil (1 charge)
• align weapon (good only) (1 charge)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, holy smite, protection from evil, align weapon

Name: Lawful staff
Description:
This staff functions as a +2/+2 quarterstaff and allows use of the following spells:

• order’s wrath (2 charges)
• protection from chaos (1 charge)
• align weapon (lawful only) (1 charge)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, order’s wrath, protection from chaos, align weapon

Name: Staff of healing
Description:
This white ash staff allows use of the following spells:

• cure light wounds (1 charge)
• cure moderate wounds (2 charges)
• cure serious wounds (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, cure light wounds, cure moderate wounds, cure serious wounds

Name: Unholy staff
Description:
This staff functions as a +2/+2 quarterstaff and allows use of the following spells:

• unholy blight (2 charges)
• protection from good (1 charge)
• align weapon (evil only) (1 charge)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, unholy blight, protection from good, align weapon

Name: Staff of the master (necromancy)
Description:
This blackwood staff is carved with skull motifs. It allows use of the following spells:

• ray of enfeeblement (1 charge)
• false life (2 charges)
• vampiric touch (3 charges)

This staff is one of several staves of the master, each themed to a specific school of magic.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, false life, ray of enfeeblement, vampiric touch

Name: Staff of spiders
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 201, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 495
Description:
This staff is topped with a carved spider of black obsidian. It allows use of the following spells:

• web (1 charge)
• spider climb (1 charge)
• summon swarm (spiders only) (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, spider climb, summon swarm, web

Name: Staff of electricity
Description:
This staff is capped with a forked metal tip that crackles faintly with sparks. It allows use of the following spells:

• shocking grasp (1 charge)
• lightning bolt (2 charges)
• call lightning (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, call lightning, lightning bolt, shocking grasp

Name: Heretic’s bane
Description:
This iron-shod staff is etched with holy symbols. It allows use of the following spells:

• detect evil (1 charge)
• searing light (2 charges)
• dispel magic (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, detect evil, dispel magic, searing light

Name: Musical staff
Description:
This staff is crafted from resonant darkwood and hums faintly when handled. It allows use of the following spells:

• sound burst (1 charge)
• suggestion (2 charges)
• shout (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, shout, sound burst, suggestion

Name: Staff of souls
Description:
This pale staff is carved with ghostly faces that seem to shift and whisper. It allows use of the following spells:

• gentle repose (1 charge)
• speak with dead (2 charges)
• spectral hand (1 charge)
• halt undead (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, gentle repose, halt undead, speak with dead, spectral hand

Name: Staff of toxins
Description:
This sickly green staff constantly smells faintly of bitter herbs. It allows use of the following spells:

• detect poison (1 charge)
• neutralize poison (2 charges)
• poison (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, detect poison, neutralize poison, poison

Name: Staff of stealth
Description:
This darkwood staff is wrapped in black leather and muffles the sound of movement. It allows use of the following spells:

• silence (1 charge)
• invisibility (2 charges)
• nondetection (2 charges)

Name: Staff of the avenger
Description:
This steel-bound staff is etched with runes of vengeance. It functions as a +2/+2 quarterstaff and allows use of the following spells:

• shield other (1 charge)
• searing light (2 charges)
• righteous might (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, righteous might, searing light, shield other

Name: Staff of aspects
Description:
This staff is adorned with carved animal forms. It allows use of the following spells:

• aspect of the falcon (1 charge)
• aspect of the bear (2 charges)
• beast shape I (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, aspect of the bear, aspect of the falcon, beast shape I

Name: Staff of speaking
Description:
This finely carved staff is etched with runes of many languages. It allows use of the following spells:

• comprehend languages (1 charge)
• tongues (2 charges)
• sending (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, comprehend languages, sending, tongues

Name: Staff of frost
Description:
This silver-tipped staff is cold to the touch. It allows use of the following spells:

• ray of frost (1 charge)
• ice storm (2 charges)
• wall of ice (3 charges)
• cone of cold (4 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, cone of cold, ice storm, ray of frost, wall of ice

Name: Staff of bolstering
Description:
This sturdy oaken staff is bound with iron bands. It allows use of the following spells:

• bear’s endurance (1 charge)
• bull’s strength (1 charge)
• cat’s grace (1 charge)
• eagle’s splendor (1 charge)
• owl’s wisdom (1 charge)
• fox’s cunning (1 charge)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, bear’s endurance, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, eagle’s splendor, fox’s cunning, owl’s wisdom

Name: Staff of curses
Description:
This dark staff is carved with grimacing faces. It allows use of the following spells:

• bane (1 charge)
• bestow curse (2 charges)
• ray of enfeeblement (1 charge)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, bane, bestow curse, ray of enfeeblement

Name: Staff of dark flame
Description:
This blackened iron staff is warm to the touch and sheds dim crimson light. It allows use of the following spells:

• produce flame (1 charge)
• flaming sphere (2 charges)
• fireball (2 charges)
• wall of fire (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, fireball, flaming sphere, produce flame, wall of fire

Name: Staff of cackling wrath
Description:
This twisted blackthorn staff seems to vibrate faintly with cruel amusement. It allows use of the following spells:

• hideous laughter (1 charge)
• rage (2 charges)
• crushing despair (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, crushing despair, hideous laughter, rage

Name: Staff of performance
Description:
This polished staff is decorated with musical notes and theatrical masks. It allows use of the following spells:

• heroism (2 charges)
• suggestion (2 charges)
• enthrall (1 charge)

Name: Animate staff
Description: This staff can be animated to fight independently. Once per day as a standard action, the wielder can command the staff to animate for 5 rounds. The staff functions as a +1/+1 quarterstaff and fights as if wielded by the wielder, using her base attack bonus and ability modifiers. The staff occupies its own space and can be attacked or destroyed.

Name: Staff of revelations
Description:
This ornate staff is capped with a many-faceted crystal. It allows use of the following spells:

• detect thoughts (1 charge)
• clairaudience/clairvoyance (2 charges)
• true seeing (3 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, clairaudience/clairvoyance, detect thoughts, true seeing

Name: Dimensional Shackles
Description: These shackles have golden runes traced across their cold iron surface. Any creature bound within them is affected as if by dimensional anchor. In addition, a DC 30 Escape Artist check is required to slip free of dimensional shackles. The shackles have hardness 10 and 30 hit points.

Name: Gauntlets of Skill at Arms
Description: These gauntlets grant the wearer proficiency with all martial weapons and a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls made with such weapons.

Name: Bracers of Armor (+6)
Description:
These items appear to be wrist or arm guards, sometimes etched with symbols of protection or depictions of vigilant-looking animals. Bracers of armor surround the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting him an armor bonus of +1 to +8, just as though he were wearing armor. Both bracers of armor must be worn for the magic to be effective.
Alternatively, bracers of armor can be enchanted with armor special abilities. See Table 3–3: Armor Special Abilities for a list of abilities. Special abilities usually count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of an item, but do not improve AC. Bracers of armor cannot have a modified bonus (armor bonus plus armor special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +8. Bracers of armor must have at least a +1 armor bonus to grant an armor special ability.
Bracers of armor cannot have any armor special abilities that add a flat gp amount to their cost. Bracers of armor and ordinary armor do not stack. If the wearer receives a larger armor bonus from another source, the bracers of armor cease functioning and do not grant their armor bonus or their armor special abilities. If the bracers of armor grant a larger armor bonus, the other source of armor ceases functioning.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, creator’s caster level must be at least two times that of the bonus placed on the bracers, plus any requirements of the armor special abilities

Name: Serpent Belt
Description: This scaled belt grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to natural armor. Once per day, as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +4 enhancement bonus on grapple combat maneuver checks for 1 minute.

Name: Monkey Belt
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Climb checks. In addition, the wearer gains a climb speed of 20 feet.

Name: Belt of Physical Might +2
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to two physical ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution), chosen at creation.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, bear’s endurance

Name: Belt of the Weasel
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks. In addition, once per day, the wearer can gain the effects of freedom of movement for 1 round as an immediate action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, freedom of movement

Name: Belt of Thunderous Charging
Description: When the wearer makes a charge attack, she can choose to deal an additional 2d6 points of sonic damage on a successful hit. This ability can be used three times per day.

Name: Minotaur Belt
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength. In addition, the wearer gains a +2 bonus on bull rush combat maneuver checks. If the wearer charges and successfully hits, she can attempt a free bull rush combat maneuver without provoking attacks of opportunity.

Name: Plague Rat Belt, Greater
Description: This improved version of the plague rat belt grants a +4 competence bonus on saving throws against disease. Once per day, as a standard action, the wearer can summon a rat swarm (as summon swarm) that lasts for 9 rounds.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon swarm, remove disease

Name: Belt of Equilibrium
Description: The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to balance. In addition, she can move across narrow or uneven surfaces without reducing her speed and without needing to make Acrobatics checks unless the surface is particularly hazardous.

Name: Security Belt
Description: This belt creates a small extradimensional pocket that can hold up to 5 cubic feet of items weighing no more than 50 pounds. Retrieving a stored item is a move action.

Name: Belt of Mighty Hurling, Lesser
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength for the purpose of determining attack and damage rolls with thrown weapons only. In addition, thrown weapons deal damage as if the wearer’s Strength score were 2 points higher than normal.

Name: Belt of Dwarvenkind
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution and a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities. The wearer gains darkvision 60 feet, if she does not already have it. If the wearer is a dwarf, she gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma and a +2 competence bonus on Appraise checks related to metal and stone.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bear’s endurance, darkvision

Name: Cord of Stubborn Resolve
Description: This thick cord grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution. When the wearer enters a rage, any hit point damage she takes is treated as nonlethal damage until the rage ends.

Name: Belt of Giant Strength +4
Description: This belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Strength of +4.

Name: Belt of Physical Perfection +2
Description: This belt grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, bear’s endurance

Name: Belt of Incredible Dexterity +4
Description: This belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Dexterity of +4.

Name: Belt of Mighty Constitution +4
Description: This belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Constitution of +4.

Name: Robe of Blending
Description: This robe enables its wearer to appear as another sort of creature. As a standard action, the wearer can assume the appearance of any humanoid creature of the same size, as if using disguise self. The effect lasts for 10 minutes per day, which need not be consecutive. While the robe is active, the wearer gains a +10 competence bonus on Disguise checks.

Name: Blazing Robes
Description: These robes grant the wearer fire resistance 10. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can unleash a 15-foot cone of fire that deals 4d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 14 half).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resist energy, burning hands

Name: Shocking Robe
Description: This robe grants the wearer electricity resistance 10. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can unleash a 60-foot line of electricity that deals 4d6 points of electricity damage (Reflex DC 14 half).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resist energy, lightning bolt

Name: Voidfrost Robes
Description: These robes grant the wearer cold resistance 10. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can unleash a 15-foot cone of cold that deals 4d6 points of cold damage (Reflex DC 14 half).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resist energy, cone of cold

Name: Bodywrap of Mighty Strikes +2
Description: This bodywrap grants a +2 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes and natural weapons.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, magic fang

Name: Monk’s Robe
Description: This simple robe grants the wearer the AC bonus, unarmed damage, and flurry of blows ability of a monk of 5 levels higher than his current monk level (to a maximum effective monk level of 20th). If the wearer is not a monk, he gains the AC bonus, unarmed damage, and flurry of blows ability of a 5th-level monk.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, righteous might or enlarge person

Name: Robe of Arcane Heritage
Description: This robe enhances a sorcerer’s bloodline. The wearer treats her sorcerer level as 4 higher for the purpose of determining the effects of her bloodline powers. This does not grant additional bloodline powers, spells known, or other benefits of increased sorcerer level.

Name: Shirt of Immolation
Description: Whenever the wearer is grappling (whether on the offense or defense), this shirt automatically bursts into flame, dealing 1d6+10 points of fire damage every round to anyone grappling the wearer. The flames do not harm the wearer and last one round (though it continues to burn if the wearer is still grappling after one round). The shirt burns for a maximum of 10 rounds per day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Name: Snakeskin Tunic
Description: A snakeskin tunic is a tight, form-fitting shirt crafted from the scales of a giant snake. When worn, it grants a +1 armor bonus to AC, a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity, and a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against poison.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cat’s grace, delay poison

Name: Bane Baldric
Description:
This ornate sash of embroidered velvet stretches across the chest from shoulder to waist. If the wearer is an inquisitor, she is treated as five levels higher when using her bane and greater bane abilities. If the wearer is not an inquisitor, she gains the bane ability of a 5th-level inquisitor, but must first attune a light or one-handed melee weapon to the baldric by hanging it from the cloth for 24 hours, and can only use the bane ability with the attuned weapon.
Attuning a new weapon to the baldric ends the attunement for the previous weapon.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster I, creator must be an inquisitor

Name: Unfettered Shirt
Description:
This loose, often ruffled, shirt is cut in a style designed to avoid hindering its wearer’s movement.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 10 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cat’s grace, freedom of movement

Name: Poisoner's Jacket (Lesser)
Description: Three times per day, the wearer of this dark jacket can create a vial containing one dose of any poison from the Core Rulebook that costs 300 gp or less. The jacket’s poison always looks like a murky amber fluid. This poison becomes inert after 1 hour.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, minor creation, poison

Name: Vest of the Cockroach
Description: This padded and slightly bulky vest, made from red-brown cloth, causes its wearer to feel vaguely uncomfortable whenever she is lying prone. If the wearer is a rogue, she gains the resiliency rogue talent. If she already has this talent, activating the talent grants her 2 hit points per rogue level instead of 1.

Name: Goggles of Elvenkind
Description: These green lenses grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks. In addition, the wearer gains low-light vision. If the wearer already has low-light vision, she can see four times as far as a human in dim light.

Name: Goggles of Brilliant Light
Description: These bright lenses protect the wearer from bright light and glare. The wearer gains immunity to blindness or dazzling effects caused by light. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can emit a flash of brilliant light in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in the area must succeed at a Reflex save (DC 14) or be blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1d4 rounds.

Name: Blind Man’s Fold
Description: This black silk blindfold grants its wearer blindsense with a range of 30 feet. While wearing the fold, the wearer is blinded but can perceive creatures and objects within 30 feet as if using blindsense. The wearer takes a –4 penalty on Perception checks relying on sight beyond 30 feet.

Name: Goggles of Night
Description: These goggles grant the wearer darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If the wearer already has darkvision, the range increases by 60 feet.

Name: Lenses of Figment Piercing
Description: These lenses allow the wearer to see through figment and glamer illusions. The wearer automatically disbelieves figment and glamer effects within 60 feet and can see through such illusions as if using true seeing, though the lenses do not reveal invisible creatures.

Name: Arachnid Goggles
Description: These dark, multifaceted lenses grant the wearer darkvision 60 feet and a +4 competence bonus on Climb checks. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can gain a climb speed of 30 feet for 10 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, spider climb, darkvision

Name: Boots of Escape
Description: These boots grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks. In addition, once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, freedom of movement

Name: Earth Root Boots
Description: These sturdy boots allow the wearer to root herself to the ground as a swift action, gaining a +4 bonus to CMD against bull rush, overrun, and trip attempts. While rooted, the wearer cannot move from her square. The wearer can end this effect as a free action.

Name: Nightmare Boots
Description: These black boots allow the wearer to move across difficult terrain without penalty and leave behind faint wisps of smoke. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can use scare (DC 14).

Name: Nightmare Horseshoes
Description: These horseshoes can be affixed to a horse’s hooves. The horse’s hooves deal an additional 1d6 points of fire damage on a successful attack. Once per day, the horse can use scare (DC 14).

Name: Caltrop Boots
Description: These boots allow the wearer to scatter caltrops in her wake. As a move action, the wearer can leave a trail of caltrops in a 5-foot square she moves through. The boots can create up to 10 squares of caltrops per day.

Name: Tremor Boots
Description: As a standard action, the wearer can stomp the ground to create a tremor in a 10-foot radius. Creatures in the area must succeed at a Reflex save (DC 14) or fall prone. This ability can be used three times per day.

Name: Boots of the Mastodon
Description: These heavy boots grant the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength. In addition, when the wearer charges, she deals an additional 1d6 points of damage on a successful melee attack.

Name: Shoes of the Lightning Leaper
Description: These shoes grant the wearer a +10 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump. Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can teleport up to 20 feet to a space she can see.

Name: Boots of Speed
Description: These boots allow the wearer to act as if affected by haste for up to 10 rounds per day. The rounds need not be consecutive. Activating the boots is a free action.

Name: Verdant Boots
Description: These boots allow the wearer to move across natural difficult terrain without penalty and grant a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks in forested terrain. Once per day, the wearer can use entangle (DC 14).

Name: Horseshoes of Crushing Blows +2
Description: These iron horseshoes grant the creature wearing them a +2 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with hoof attacks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, magic fang

Name: Winged Boots
Description: These boots allow the wearer to fly as if affected by fly for up to 5 minutes per day. The duration need not be consecutive.

Name: Deliquescent Gloves
Description: These damp, rubbery gloves grant the wearer a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls with natural weapons. In addition, the wearer’s natural weapons deal an additional 1d6 points of acid damage.

Name: Form-Fixing Gauntlets
Description: These metal gauntlets stabilize shapechanging magic. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on caster level checks made to resist dispel magic effects targeting polymorph effects on her.
