In addition, once per day, the wearer can reroll a saving throw to resist an unwanted polymorph effect.

Name: Iron Cobra Gauntlet
Description: This articulated metal gauntlet can transform into a mechanical cobra as a standard action. The cobra functions as a Tiny animated object with a bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage plus poison (Fortitude DC 14; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Con damage; cure 1 save). The cobra remains active for up to 5 minutes per day, which need not be consecutive.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, animate objects, poison

Name: Shadow Falconer’s Glove
Description: This dark leather glove allows the wearer to summon a shadowy falcon as a standard action. The falcon functions as an unseen servant that can fly and lasts for up to 10 minutes per day. The duration need not be consecutive.

Name: Spellstrike Gloves
Description: These gloves allow the wearer to deliver touch spells through a melee weapon attack as if using the magus’s spellstrike ability once per day.

Name: Glyphbane Gloves
Description: These gloves grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Disable Device checks made to disable magical traps and a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks made to notice magical traps.

Name: Glove of Storing
Description: This soft leather glove appears to be a normal glove. On command, it can store one item weighing up to 20 pounds and retrieve it as a free action. The item remains stored until retrieved.

Name: Gloves of Shaping
Description: These gloves grant the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Craft checks. Once per day, the wearer can use fabricate (caster level 7th).

Name: Pliant Gloves
Description: These flexible gloves allow the wearer to ignore hardness 5 when attacking objects. In addition, once per day, the wearer can gain a +4 bonus on combat maneuver checks to break objects.

Name: Gauntlet of Rust
Description: This heavy iron gauntlet allows the wearer to corrode metal objects with a touch. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can make a melee touch attack against a metal object to deal 3d6 points of damage to it (ignoring hardness).

Name: Gloves of Dueling
Description: These gloves grant the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength for the purpose of determining the effects of feats that improve weapon attacks, such as Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization. In addition, the wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on combat maneuver checks made with a chosen weapon type.

Name: Helm of the Mammoth Lord
Description: This horned helm grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength. In addition, when the wearer charges, she gains a +2 competence bonus on combat maneuver checks made to bull rush or overrun.

Name: Veil of Fleeting Glances
Description: This translucent veil grants the wearer a +2 dodge bonus to AC. Once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can gain concealment (20% miss chance) for 1 round.

Name: Mask of a Thousand Tomes
Description: This ornate mask grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Knowledge checks. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can gain a +10 insight bonus on a single Knowledge check.

Name: Medusa Mask
Description: This serpent-haired mask grants the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can use petrifying gaze as flesh to stone (Fortitude DC 14 negates).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, flesh to stone

Name: Cap of the Free Thinker
Description: This simple cap grants the wearer a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects. Once per day, the wearer can reroll a failed saving throw against a mind-affecting effect and must take the second result.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

Name: Halo of Inner Calm
Description: This faintly glowing halo grants the wearer immunity to confusion and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against emotion effects.

Name: Headband of Havoc
Description: This spiked headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Intelligence. In addition, once per day, when the wearer casts a spell that deals hit point damage, she can increase the damage by 2 points per spell level.

Name: Serpent’s Band
Description: This scaled headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma and a +4 competence bonus on Handle Animal checks made to influence reptiles. Once per day, the wearer can use charm animal (reptiles only).

Name: Headband of Mental Prowess +2
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to two mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, fox’s cunning, owl’s wisdom, eagle’s splendor

Name: Hunter’s Band
Description: This leather headband grants the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Survival checks and a +4 competence bonus on Perception checks to track creatures. Once per day, the wearer can use locate creature.

Name: Phylactery of Negative Channeling
Description: This small black box enhances the wearer’s channel negative energy ability, increasing the DC of channel negative energy by +2.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, channel negative energy

Name: Phylactery of Positive Channeling
Description: This small silver box enhances the wearer’s channel positive energy ability, increasing the DC of channel positive energy by +2.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, channel positive energy

Name: Veiled Eye
Description: This silk-wrapped circlet grants the wearer blindsense 30 feet against invisible creatures.

Name: Band of the Stalwart Warrior
Description: This iron headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution and a +2 competence bonus on Fortitude saves.

Name: Headband of Ninjitsu
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity and a +4 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Name: Headband of Alluring Charisma +4
Description: This attractive headband grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma.

Name: Headband of Inspired Wisdom +4
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

Name: Headband of Mental Superiority +2
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, fox’s cunning, owl’s wisdom, eagle’s splendor

Name: Headband of Vast Intelligence +4
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Intelligence and grants skill ranks as normal for a headband of vast intelligence.

Name: Shifter’s Headband +4
Description: This headband grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Constitution while under the effects of a polymorph effect.

Name: Amulet of Natural Armor +2
Description: This amulet, usually crafted from bone or beast scales, toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor bonus of +2.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, creator’s caster level must be at least three times the amulet’s bonus

Name: Amulet of Proof Against Petrification
Description: This amulet is carved from a chunk of marble or similar stone. The wearer is immune to petrification.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, stone to flesh

Name: Everwake Amulet
Description: This small metal disk bears the symbol of an open eye. The wearer needs no sleep, though she must still rest for 8 hours before preparing spells. The wearer is immune to magical sleep effects.

Name: Gravewatch Pendant
Description: This pendant is a circular disk of black iron engraved with skulls. The wearer can detect undead as if using detect undead at will. In addition, three times per day, the wearer can cast deathwatch.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, deathwatch, detect undead

Name: Hand of Glory
Description: This mummified human hand hangs by a leather cord around a character’s neck (taking up the neck slot). It allows its wearer to utilize up to three rings simultaneously (though only two can be magic rings; the third ring must be nonmagical). The hand can be used only by a character with 12 or more ranks in Use Magic Device.

Name: Torc of Lionheart Fury
Description: This heavy golden neck ring is engraved with a roaring lion’s head. Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can enter a state of fury for 5 rounds. During this time, the wearer gains a +2 morale bonus on melee attack rolls and weapon damage rolls and a +2 morale bonus on Will saving throws, but takes a –2 penalty to AC.

Name: Necklace of Fireballs (Type VI)
Description: This item appears to be a string or cluster of spherical beads, sometimes with the ends tied together to form a necklace. (It does not count as an item worn around the neck for the purpose of determining which of a character’s worn magic items is effective.) If a character holds it, however, all can see the strand as it really is—a golden chain from which hang a number of golden spheres. The spheres are detachable by the wearer (and only by the wearer), who can easily hurl one of them up to 70 feet. Each sphere detaches and bursts into a fireball as if cast by a 10th-level wizard (Reflex DC 14 half).

Name: Necklace of Fireballs (Type VII)
Description: This item functions as a necklace of fireballs (Type VI) but contains more beads (and thus a greater total number of fireballs).

Name: Amulet of Hidden Strength
Description: This amulet is crafted from dark leather cords wrapped around a core of braided sinew. Three times per day as an immediate action, the wearer can ignore the effects of being fatigued or exhausted for 1 round. This does not remove the condition, but it suppresses the penalties and limitations imposed by that condition for the duration.

Name: Necklace of Adaptation
Description: This necklace creates a shell of fresh air around the wearer, making her immune to all harmful vapors and gases (such as cloudkill and stinking cloud effects, as well as inhaled poisons) and allowing her to breathe, even underwater or in a vacuum.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, alter self or control water

Name: Amulet of Spell Cunning
Description: This small crystal amulet grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Spellcraft checks made to identify a spell as it is being cast.

Name: Collar of the True Companion
Description: This stout leather collar is typically fitted with a silver tag engraved with a stylized animal companion. If placed upon an animal companion, the collar allows the companion to speak with its master as if under the effects of speak with animals at all times. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the master may cast cure serious wounds upon the animal companion as if using a 9th-level caster.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure serious wounds, speak with animals

Name: Frost Fist Amulet
Description: This crystalline amulet is cold to the touch. The wearer’s unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d6 points of cold damage. Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause her unarmed strikes to deal an additional 2d6 points of cold damage instead for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, frostbite or ice storm

Name: Crystal of Healing Hands
Description: This small, faceted crystal glows faintly when held. Three times per day, the wearer can cast cure moderate wounds as a spell-like ability (CL 7th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure moderate wounds

Name: Guardian Gorget
Description: This polished steel collar protects the wearer’s throat. The wearer gains a +2 deflection bonus to AC and a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against breath weapons.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, shield of faith, resist energy

Name: Medallion of Thoughts
Description: This medallion allows the wearer to read thoughts, as the spell (Will DC 13 negates).

Name: Periapt of Protection from Curses
Description: This silver chain supports a disk set with a small gem. The wearer is immune to curse effects, including bestow curse and similar spells and spell-like abilities.

Name: Forge Fist Amulet
Description: This heavy iron amulet radiates warmth. The wearer’s unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d6 points of fire damage. Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause her unarmed strikes to deal an additional 2d6 points of fire damage instead for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, flame blade or fireball

Name: Amulet of Bullet Protection +3
Description: This amulet grants the wearer a +3 luck bonus to AC against firearm attacks that target touch AC.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from arrows

Name: Periapt of Wound Closure
Description: This stone pendant doubles the wearer’s natural healing rate. In addition, whenever the wearer is brought to below 0 hit points but not slain, he automatically becomes stable.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure serious wounds

Name: Amulet of Mighty Fists +2
Description: This amulet grants its wearer a +2 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with unarmed attacks and natural weapons.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator’s caster level must be at least three times the amulet’s bonus

Name: Necklace of Ki Serenity
Description: This string of polished wooden beads centers the wearer’s inner strength. The wearer gains 1 additional ki point if she has a ki pool. If she does not have a ki pool, she instead gains a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must have a ki pool

Name: Brooch of Amber Sparks
Description: This amber brooch contains a trapped spark of elemental fire. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can unleash a 30-foot cone of sparks that deals 6d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 15 half).

Name: Ring of entropy and order
Description: This iron ring is split into two halves: one polished and pristine, the other rusted and decayed. The wearer gains a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against chaotic and lawful effects. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can invoke either entropy or order. Entropy causes all manufactured weapons within 10 feet (including those held) to take a –2 penalty on attack rolls for 1 minute (Fortitude DC 15 negates for held items). Order grants all manufactured weapons within 10 feet a +2 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls for 1 minute (this does not stack with existing enhancement bonuses higher than +2).

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, align weapon, protection from chaos, protection from law

Name: Ring of forcefangs
Description: This ring has a band of interlocking fangs carved from white stone. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can make a melee touch attack that deals 2d6 points of force damage. This attack threatens a critical hit on a roll of 20 and deals ×2 damage on a confirmed critical hit.

Name: Ring of mind shielding
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 172, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring is usually of fine workmanship and wrought from heavy gold. The wearer is continually immune to detect thoughts, discern lies, and any attempt to magically discern her alignment. If the wearer dies while wearing the ring, her soul enters the ring unless it already houses a soul. The wearer of a ring with a soul in it can communicate with the soul telepathically.

Name: Ring of protection +2
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 173, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring grants a +2 deflection bonus to AC.

Name: Ring of strength sapping
Description: This ring is adorned with a black onyx gem. Once per day when the wearer successfully hits a creature with a melee attack, she can activate the ring as a swift action to deal 1d4 points of Strength damage to the target (Fortitude DC 14 negates).

Name: Soultether ring
Description: This iron ring bears a small chain motif linking two tiny skulls. If the wearer is reduced to –1 hit points or fewer, once per day the ring stabilizes the wearer automatically and prevents further hit point loss. If the wearer dies while wearing the ring, her soul is tethered to her body for 1 minute, during which time effects such as raise dead can be cast on her without requiring the usual material components.

Name: Ring of force shield
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 170, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: An iron ring with a shield device engraved on it, this item creates a shield-sized (and shield-shaped) wall of force that stays with the ring and can be wielded by the wearer as if it were a heavy shield (+2 AC). This special creation has no armor check penalty or arcane spell failure chance. It can be activated and deactivated at will as a free action.

Name: Ring of the ram
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 174, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring has the head of a ram engraved on its surface. The wearer can command the ring to deliver a forceful blow as a standard action. The ring has 3 charges per day. Each use deals 1d6 points of force damage per charge expended (maximum 3d6) and may bull rush the target with a CMB of +9. The bull rush does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If all 3 charges are expended in a single use, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be knocked prone.

Name: Scholar’s ring
Description: This ring grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on all Knowledge checks. In addition, once per day the wearer can attempt any Knowledge check untrained, even if the skill normally requires training.

Name: Ring of climbing, improved
Description: This ring functions as a ring of climbing, except it grants a +10 competence bonus on Climb checks.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have 10 ranks in Climb

Name: Ring of curing
Description: This ring allows the wearer to use cure moderate wounds three times per day. The caster level is 7th.

Name: Ring of foe focus
Description: Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can designate one creature within line of sight as her focused foe. For 1 minute, she gains a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls and weapon damage rolls against that creature.

Name: Ring of jumping, improved
Description: This ring functions as a ring of jumping, except it grants a +10 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks made to make high or long jumps.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have 10 ranks in Acrobatics

Name: Ring of ki mastery
Description: This ring is carved of a single piece of jade. When worn by a character with a ki pool class feature, it increases the total number of ki points in the wearer’s ki pool by 1. If the wearer does not have a ki pool, the ring has no effect.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, ki arrow or creator must have ki pool class feature

Name: Ring of revelation, lesser
Description: This ring is typically worn by oracles. It grants the wearer access to one revelation from her mystery. The revelation must be one she qualifies for and must be selected when the ring is created. The wearer uses her oracle level to determine the revelation’s effects. If she does not have the oracle class feature, the ring has no effect.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have the revelation to be granted

Name: Ring of swimming, improved
Description: This ring functions as a ring of swimming, except it grants a +10 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have 10 ranks in Swim

Name: Ring of animal friendship
Description: This ring continually allows the wearer to use charm animal as the spell (Will DC 13 negates). The wearer can use this ability at will, but can have only one animal charmed at a time.

Name: Ring of transposition
Description: Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can swap positions with a willing ally within 30 feet as if using dimension door. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Name: Ring of tactical precision
Description: This ring is decorated with crossed blades. When the wearer flanks an opponent, she gains a +2 insight bonus on damage rolls against that opponent. This bonus applies only while flanking.

Name: Ring of the sophisticate
Description: This elegant ring enhances the wearer’s charm and wit. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks.

Name: Decoy ring
Description: Once per day as an immediate action when the wearer is targeted by a melee or ranged attack, she can activate the ring to create an illusory duplicate of herself. The duplicate occupies the wearer’s space and grants concealment (20% miss chance) against that attack. After the attack is resolved, the duplicate disappears.

Name: Ring of craft magic
Description: This ring assists in the creation of magic items. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Spellcraft checks made to create magic items. In addition, once per day the wearer can reduce the crafting time of a single magic item by half (to a minimum of 1 day).

Name: Ring of ectoplasmic invigoration
Description: This ring allows the wearer to interact more effectively with incorporeal creatures. The wearer’s melee attacks deal full damage to incorporeal creatures (instead of half damage). This does not allow the wearer to ignore the miss chance normally granted by incorporeal creatures.

Name: Ring of energy resistance, minor
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 170, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: This ring grants the wearer resistance 10 against one type of energy (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic), chosen when the ring is created.

Name: Ring of the troglodyte
Description: This ring is carved from a chunk of mottled stone. The wearer gains darkvision 60 feet. If the wearer already has darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet instead. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can exude a foul stench for 5 rounds. Creatures within 10 feet must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be sickened for 1d4 rounds. This is a poison effect.

Name: Steelhand circle
Description: This ring is forged from dark steel. The wearer gains a +2 enhancement bonus on combat maneuver checks and to CMD when resisting disarm or sunder attempts.

Name: Ring of chameleon power
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 168, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring grants the wearer the ability to blend into her surroundings, allowing her to use hide in plain sight as the ranger ability. In addition, she gains a +10 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Name: Ring of spell knowledge III
Description: This ring functions as a ring of spell knowledge, except it can hold spells of up to 3rd level. Through study, the wearer can gain knowledge of a single spell in addition to those allotted by her class and level. The wearer must encounter a written, active, or cast version of the spell and succeed at a DC 20 Spellcraft check to teach the spell to the ring. Arcane spells not on the wearer’s class list are treated as one level higher for storage and casting.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be granted

Name: Ring of the sea strider
Description: This ring grants the wearer the ability to walk on water as if continually under the effects of water walk. In addition, the wearer gains a swim speed of 30 feet.

Name: Ring of retribution
Description: This ring allows the wearer to store up to 10 points of damage per day that she has taken from melee attacks. As an immediate action after being struck by a melee attack, the wearer can cause the attacker to take an amount of force damage equal to the damage she just took (maximum 10 points per day).

Name: Ring of water walking
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 480
Description: This ring allows the wearer to continually use water walk as the spell.

Name: Dungeon ring, jailer’s
Description: This iron band allows its wearer to activate dimensional anchor once per day (CL 7th) as a standard action. The effect lasts for 7 minutes.

Name: Ring of revelation, greater
Description: This ring functions as a ring of revelation, lesser, except it can grant access to a revelation that normally requires the oracle to be at least 7th level. The wearer must meet all other prerequisites for the revelation. The wearer uses her oracle level to determine the revelation’s effects. If she does not have the oracle class feature, the ring has no effect.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have the revelation to be granted

Name: Metamagic rod, Merciful (minor)
Description: The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that deal hit point damage as merciful spells without increasing the spell’s level or casting time. Merciful spells deal nonlethal damage instead of lethal damage. Only spells of 3rd level or lower can be affected.

Name: Metamagic rod (+1 spell level), minor
Description: This rod allows the wielder to cast up to three spells per day modified by a metamagic feat that increases spell level by +1 without increasing the spell slot used or casting time. Only spells of 3rd level or lower can be affected.

Name: Metamagic rod, Apocalyptic (lesser)
Description: This rod allows the wielder to cast up to three spells per day as apocalyptic spells without increasing the spell’s level or casting time. Apocalyptic spells deal half damage to objects and structures. Only spells of 3rd level or lower can be affected.

Name: Metamagic rod, Authoritative (lesser)
Description: This rod allows the wielder to cast up to three spells per day as authoritative spells without increasing the spell’s level or casting time. Authoritative spells compel creatures to kneel or fall prone if they fail their saving throw. Only spells of 3rd level or lower can be affected.

Name: Metamagic rod, Blissful (lesser)
Description: This rod allows the wielder to cast up to three spells per day as blissful spells without increasing the spell’s level or casting time. Blissful spells deal nonlethal damage to good-aligned creatures instead of lethal damage. Only spells of 3rd level or lower can be affected.

Name: Metamagic rod, Crypt (lesser)
Description: This rod allows the wielder to cast up to three spells per day as crypt spells without increasing the spell’s level or casting time. Crypt spells deal additional damage to undead creatures. Only spells of 3rd level or lower can be affected.

Name: Metamagic rod, Tumultuous (lesser)
Description: This rod allows the wielder to cast up to three spells per day as tumultuous spells without increasing the spell’s level or casting time. Tumultuous spells push creatures away from the spell’s area. Only spells of 3rd level or lower can be affected.

Name: Immovable rod
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 178, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 485
Description:
This rod looks like a flat iron bar with a small button on one end. When the button is pushed (a move action), the rod does not move from where it is, even if staying in place defies gravity. Thus, the owner can lift or place the rod wherever he wishes, push the button, and let go. Several immovable rods can even make a ladder when used together (although only two are needed). An immovable rod can support up to 8,000 pounds before falling to the ground.

If a creature pushes against an immovable rod, it must succeed at a DC 30 Strength check to move the rod up to 10 feet in a single round.

Name: Rod of Thunderous Force
Description: This mahogany rod is etched with the image of whirling storm clouds. Once per day on command, the wielder can slam the rod against the ground, releasing a concussive wave of sonic and force energy. This creates a 20-foot radius burst centered on the wielder. While it causes no damage, those within the burst must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude save or fall prone and be deafened for 1d4 rounds. The wielder is unaffected by this blast. This effect is a force and sonic effect.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Rod, blindness/deafness, wall of force

Name: Rod of Metamagic, Merciful (normal)
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 190, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 295
Description: The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that deal nonlethal damage as though using the Merciful Spell feat (Advanced Player’s Guide).

Name: Rod of ice
Description: This rod looks like a long sliver of ice and is cold to the touch, but deals no cold damage to its wielder. The wearer can use the rod to make a melee touch attack that deals 1d4 points of cold damage to any creature struck. Also, once per day on command, the wielder can touch the rod to the ground to create a 30-foot cone of ice that encrusts the earth, affecting the area as per the spell grease.

Name: Metamagic rod (+2 spell level), minor
Description:
Metamagic rods hold the essence of a metamagic feat, allowing the user to apply metamagic effects to spells (but not spell-like abilities) as they are cast. This does not change the spell slot of the altered spell. All metamagic rods are use-activated.

This entry represents a minor metamagic rod that applies a metamagic feat which increases the spell’s effective spell level adjustment by +2, without increasing the spell slot used. A caster may only use one metamagic rod on any given spell, but it is permissible to combine a rod with metamagic feats possessed by the rod’s wielder.

A minor (lesser) metamagic rod can be used with spells of 3rd level or lower. The wielder can use the rod up to three times per day (each use applies the feat to a spell as it is cast).

Name: Rod of Metamagic, Stygian (lesser)
Description: The wielder of this metamagic rod can cast up to three spells per day that suppress memories as though using the Stygian Spell feat.

Name: Rod of metal and mineral detection
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 182, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 485
Description:
This rod is valued by treasure hunters and miners alike, for it pulses and hums in the wielder’s hand in the proximity of metal. As the wearer aims the rod, the pulsations grow more noticeable as it points to the largest mass of metal within 30 feet. However, the wielder can also concentrate on a specific metal or mineral. If the specific mineral is within 30 feet, the rod points to any places it is located, and the rod wielder knows the approximate quantity as well.

If more than one deposit of the specified metal or mineral is within range, the rod points to the largest cache first. Each operation requires a full-round action.

Name: Metamagic (+1 spell level), normal
Description:
Metamagic rods hold the essence of a metamagic feat, allowing the user to apply metamagic effects to spells (but not spell-like abilities) as they are cast. This does not change the spell slot of the altered spell. All metamagic rods are use-activated.

This entry represents a normal metamagic rod that applies a metamagic feat which increases the spell’s effective spell level adjustment by +1, without increasing the spell slot used. A caster may only use one metamagic rod on any given spell, but it is permissible to combine a rod with metamagic feats possessed by the rod’s wielder.

A normal metamagic rod can be used with spells of 6th level or lower. The wielder can use the rod up to three times per day (each use applies the feat to a spell as it is cast).

Name: Rod of cancellation
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 181, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 485
Description:
This dreaded rod is a bane to magic items, for its touch drains an item of all magical properties. The item touched must make a successful DC 23 Will save to prevent the rod from draining it. If a creature is holding it at the time, then the item can use the holder’s Will save bonus in place of its own if the holder’s is better. In such cases, contact is made by making a melee touch attack roll. Upon draining an item, the rod becomes brittle and cannot be used again.

Drained items are only restorable by a wish or miracle spell. If a sphere of annihilation and a rod of cancellation negate each other, nothing can restore either of them.

Name: Cloak of Resistance +3
Description: Flecks of silver or steel are often sown amid the fabric of these magical cloaks. This garment offers magical protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus

Name: Cloak of the Duskwalker
Description:
This dark gray cloak allows the wearer to move with ease through areas of dim light or darkness. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can become invisible (as invisibility) for up to 7 minutes or until he attacks.

Name: Cocoon Cloak
Description: This silken cloak can wrap itself tightly around the wearer. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can have the cloak form a protective cocoon around her. While cocooned, the wearer gains damage reduction 5/magic and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws for 5 rounds. The wearer cannot move or attack while cocooned but can dismiss the effect as a free action.

Name: Pauldrons of the Bull
Description:
These heavy pauldrons grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on bull rush combat maneuver checks and a +2 competence bonus to CMD against bull rush attempts.
Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength for 7 rounds.

Name: Stone Cloak, Minor
Description: This rough cloak resembles overlapping plates of stone. Once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can gain damage reduction 10/adamantine for 1 round.

Name: Cape of the Mountebank
Description: On command, this bright red and gold cape allows the wearer to use dimension door once per day as a standard action. When he disappears, he leaves behind a cloud of harmless gray smoke and a loud popping noise, and appears in a similar fashion at his destination.

Name: Pauldrons of the Watchful Lion
Description:
These gleaming pauldrons grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Perception checks and a +2 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks.
Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain the benefits of true seeing for 1 round.

Name: Lion Cloak
Description:
This tawny cloak grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.
Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can roar like a lion. Creatures within 30 feet must succeed at a DC 16 Will save or be shaken for 1d4 rounds.

Name: Mantle of Spores
Description: This heavy, moldy-smelling cloak is made of damp fungus and moss. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cause the mantle to erupt in a cloud of choking spores in a 10-foot-radius burst centered on herself. Creatures in the area take 2d6 points of poison damage and are sickened for 1d4 rounds (Fortitude DC 15 negates the poison and the sickened condition). The cloud lasts for 1 round.

Name: Cape of Effulgent Escape
Description: This shimmering cape glows with prismatic light. Once per day as an immediate action when the wearer is targeted by a melee or ranged attack, she can teleport up to 30 feet to a space she can see. The teleportation occurs before the attack is resolved, potentially causing the attack to miss.

Name: Cloak of Arachnida
Description:
This black cloak is embroidered with a subtle web pattern. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Climb checks and can climb as if using spider climb.
Once per day, the wearer can cast web (DC 14) as a spell-like ability.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, spider climb, web

Name: Gunfighter’s Poncho
Description:
This wide-brimmed poncho grants the wearer a +2 dodge bonus to AC against ranged firearm attacks.
Once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can gain concealment (20% miss chance) against a single ranged attack.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from arrows

Name: Tentacle Cloak
Description: This slick cloak sprouts writhing tentacles at the wearer’s command. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cause the cloak to grow two tentacles that last for 5 rounds. The wearer can use the tentacles to make two secondary natural attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage (or 1d3 if Small).

Name: Demonspike Pauldrons
Description: These jagged pauldrons crackle faintly with infernal energy. Whenever a creature successfully grapples the wearer, the grappling creature takes 1d6 points of electricity damage. Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause the pauldrons to deal 2d6 points of electricity damage to a creature grappling her.

Name: Comfort’s Cloak
Description: This warm, well-made cloak protects the wearer from environmental hazards. The wearer is constantly protected as if by endure elements and gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against environmental effects such as extreme heat or cold.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, endure elements, resistance

Name: Cloak of Resistance +4
Description: Flecks of silver or steel are often sown amid the fabric of these magical cloaks. This garment offers magical protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus

Name: Shawl of the Crone
Description:
This ragged shawl grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge (arcana) and Knowledge (religion) checks.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast bestow curse (DC 16) as a spell-like ability.

Name: Prestidigitator’s Cloak
Description:
This flashy cloak shimmers with shifting colors. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Sleight of Hand checks.
Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can create a minor illusory distraction, granting herself concealment (20% miss chance) for 1 round.

Name: Chalice of Poison Weeping
Description:
This silver chalice has stylized representations of rearing unicorns serving as handles. The bearer of the chalice can expel toxins from a poisoned creature’s body, causing the target to weep the poison from its eyes and allowing the bearer to collect it in the chalice. This functions as neutralize poison on the target, eliminating that poison. If the target is immune to poison or the poison has run its course, the chalice has no effect.
If the poison normally has a solid or liquid form, it collects as a single dose of the poison in the cup (regardless of how many times the target was poisoned). The collected poison has all the normal effects of the original poison, except its DC is 4 lower, and can be stored in another container or used like any other poison. The chalice can be used once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, fabricate, neutralize poison

Name: Exorcist's Aspergillum
Description: This short aspergillum is made of silver. An inquisitor who carries it may use detect undead as if it were one of the spells associated with her detect alignment ability. Once per day, the item can alter an inquisitor’s judgment ability; by spending one use of her judgment ability, she can allow her spells of 3rd level and lower to have full effect against incorporeal creatures, as though using the Ectoplasmic Spell feat. This lasts until the combat ends.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, Ectoplasmic Spell (Advanced Player’s Guide), detect undead, creator must be an inquisitor

Name: Golem Manual (Flesh)
Description:
The wondrous items known as golem manuals contain all the information and magical power required to create a particular kind of golem. This effectively grants the Craft Construct feat to anyone using the manual to craft a golem of that type, and it provides an increase in caster level for the purpose of meeting the prerequisite to craft that specific type of golem.
Further, the manual grants a +5 competence bonus on skill checks to craft the golem and contains all the necessary spells, which can be activated by anyone who has the relevant spells on their class’s spell list (but only for the purpose of crafting the golem). When using a golem manual, you must still spend the normal amount of time to craft the golem and pay the cost of the golem’s body (or provide it through other means), but you do not need to pay the rest of the normal cost to create the golem.
The spells included in a golem manual require a spell trigger activation and can be activated only to assist in the construction of a golem. The cost of the book does not include the cost of constructing the golem’s body. Once the golem is finished, the writing in the manual fades and the book is consumed in flames. When the book’s ashes are sprinkled upon the golem, it becomes fully animated.
Flesh: The book contains animate dead, bull’s strength, geas/quest, and limited wish. The reader may treat her caster level as one level higher than normal for the purpose of crafting a flesh golem.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Construct, animate objects, bull's strength, geas/quest, limited wish, creator must be caster level 8th

Name: Harp of Shattering
Description:
This finely crafted masterwork harp fits comfortably in one hand, but it requires two hands to play. The harp has 10 charges, which refresh each day at daybreak. By making a DC 10 Perform (string) check, the bearer can produce the following effects:

  * break (1 charge)
  * shatter (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, break (Advanced Player’s Guide), shatter

Name: Insignia of Valor
Description: This small silver badge can be pinned to a cloak or armor. When the wearer is under the effect of a morale bonus from a spell (such as bless or heroism), the wearer can increase that morale bonus by +1 as a swift action. This increase lasts for the remaining duration of the spell. The insignia can be used once per day.

Name: Ioun Stone (Deep Red Sphere)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength.

Name: Ioun Stone (Incandescent Blue Sphere)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

Name: Ioun Stone (Pale Blue Rhomboid)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength.

Name: Ioun Stone (Pink and Green Sphere)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma.

Name: Ioun Stone (Pink Rhomboid)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution.

Name: Ioun Stone (Scarlet and Blue Sphere)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Intelligence.

Name: Needles of Fleshgraving
Description: This set of fine silver needles allows a creature to magically alter cosmetic features. When used over the course of 1 hour, the needles can change a creature’s appearance as alter self (CL 7th). This effect lasts for 24 hours. The needles can be used once per day.

Name: Restless Lockpicks
Description: These animated lockpicks grant a +5 competence bonus on Disable Device checks. Once per day, they can attempt to pick a lock on their own with a +10 bonus.

Name: Werewhistle
Description: When blown, this whistle forces lycanthropes within 60 feet to succeed at a DC 16 Will save or revert to their humanoid form. The whistle can be used once per day.

Name: Deck of Illusions
Description:
This set of parchment cards is usually found in an ivory, leather, or wooden box. A full deck consists of 34 cards. When a card is drawn and thrown to the ground, a major image of a creature appears, as shown on the card. The illusion lasts for 1d3 rounds, until dispelled, or until the card is picked up.

The illusory creature appears real and acts accordingly. It has AC 10 and disappears if struck. The illusion cannot cause harm, but creatures who believe the illusion can be affected normally. The deck may be used once per day.

Name: Candle of Invocation
Description:
This specially prepared candle is dedicated to a particular alignment. When burned, it grants a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks to creatures of that alignment within 30 feet. The candle burns for 4 hours.

If burned completely, the candle can also be used to summon an outsider of the candle’s alignment as if casting gate. The candle is consumed when used in this manner.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, gate, creator must be of the candle’s alignment

Name: Bag of Tricks (Rust)
Description: This bag appears normal but contains small fuzzy objects. When one is drawn and thrown to the ground, it transforms into a creature as if using summon monster IV. The bag can be used three times per week.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster IV

Name: Boro Bead (3rd)
Description: This small wooden bead is carved with druidic symbols. Once per day, when the wearer prepares spells, she can recover one expended 3rd-level druid spell as if it had not been cast.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be a druid

Name: Decanter of Endless Water
Description:
This item looks like a normal glass flask. On command, it produces water as follows.

  * "Stream" pours out 1 gallon per round.
  * "Fountain" produces 5 gallons per round.
  * "Geyser" produces 30 gallons per round and can push creatures back 5 feet (Strength check DC 12 to resist).

The decanter can produce water indefinitely.

Name: Loathsome Mirror
Description: When a creature looks into this mirror, it must succeed at a DC 16 Will save or see a horrifying version of itself. On a failed save, the creature is shaken for 1 minute.

Name: Page of Spell Knowledge (3rd)
Description: This sheet of parchment is covered in densely scribbled arcane formulas. A spontaneous arcane spellcaster can study the page for 1 hour to permanently add the spell on the page to her list of spells known. The spell must be of a level she can cast and must appear on her class spell list. Once used, the page becomes blank.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast the spell scribed on the page

Name: Pearl of Power (3rd)
Description:
This seemingly normal pearl of average size and luster is a potent aid to all spellcasters who prepare spells. Once per day on command, a pearl of power enables the possessor to recall any one spell of a particular level that she had prepared and then cast that day. The spell is then prepared again, just as if it had not been cast.

The spell must be of a particular level, depending on the pearl. Different pearls exist for recalling one spell per day of each level from 1st through 9th and for the 0-level spells.

A pearl of power only functions for spells prepared by the possessor.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be recalled

Name: Preserving Flask (3rd)
Description: This stoppered glass flask can hold a single 3rd-level potion. Any potion placed within the flask does not lose potency over time and cannot be spoiled by environmental effects. A potion can remain within the flask indefinitely without degradation.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Serpentine Owl)
Description: This serpentine owl statuette can transform into a giant owl. The owl serves the user faithfully for up to 8 hours per day. The figurine can be used once per day.

Name: Strand of Prayer Beads, Lesser
Description:
This strand of prayer beads contains several magical beads. A lesser strand contains a bead of blessing and a bead of healing. Each bead can be used once per day.

Bead of blessing: Grants the effects of bless (CL 7th).
Bead of healing: Cures 2d8+7 points of damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bless, cure serious wounds

Name: Bag of Holding (Type IV)
Description:
This bag appears similar to a type I bag of holding but is larger. It can hold up to 1,500 pounds not exceeding 250 cubic feet.

If a bag of holding is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is ruined, and its contents are lost forever. If a bag of holding is placed within a portable hole, it creates a rift to the Astral Plane.

Name: Boundary Chalk
Description: This white chalk can be used to draw a 20-foot-radius circle. For 1 hour, the circle functions as magic circle against evil (CL 7th). The chalk can be used once.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, magic circle against evil

Name: Chime of Resounding Silence
Description: When struck as a standard action, this chime creates an area of silence (as the spell) in a 20-foot-radius spread centered on the chime. The effect lasts for 7 rounds. The chime can be used once per day.

Name: Construct Channel Brick
Description: This brick can be embedded into a construct. Once per day, the construct can be healed by channel energy as if it were undead.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, inflict serious wounds

Name: Doomharp
Description: This darkwood harp can be played to instill despair in enemies. When played for 1 round, enemies within 30 feet must succeed at a DC 16 Will save or become shaken for as long as the harp continues to be played, plus 1 round thereafter. The harp can be used once per day for up to 10 rounds.

Name: Drum of Advance and Retreat
Description: This heavy war drum can be beaten to direct allies. When played, it grants allies within 60 feet a +10-foot enhancement bonus to their base speed for 5 rounds. The drum can be used once per day.

Name: Embalming Thread
Description: This fine thread can be sewn into a corpse over the course of 1 hour. The corpse is preserved indefinitely as if under the effects of gentle repose. The thread can be used once.

Name: Eye of the Void
Description: This glass eye allows its bearer to see invisible creatures and objects as if using see invisibility. The eye functions for up to 10 minutes per day, divided as desired.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Bronze Griffon)
Description: This bronze statuette can transform into a griffon. The griffon serves the user faithfully for up to 6 hours per day. The figurine can be used once per day.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Ebony Fly)
Description: This ebony statuette can transform into a giant fly that can carry up to 200 pounds and serve as a mount. The fly serves the user for up to 12 hours per day. The figurine can be used once per day.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Slate Spider)
Description: This slate statuette can transform into a giant spider. The spider serves the user faithfully for up to 12 hours per day. The figurine can be used once per day.

Name: Hourglass of Last Chances
Description: This delicate hourglass can be activated as an immediate action when the bearer would be reduced to 0 or fewer hit points. The bearer instead remains at 1 hit point and gains the effects of death ward for 1 round. The hourglass can be used once per day.

Name: Ioun Stone (Dark Blue Rhomboid)
Description: This stone grants its wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity.

Name: Ki Mat
Description: This woven mat enhances meditation. A monk who spends 1 hour meditating on the mat regains 1 additional ki point that day. The mat can be used once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, restoration, creator must be a monk

Name: Lord’s Banner, Swiftness
Description: This banner can be attached to a lance or similar weapon. While carried into battle, it grants allies within 30 feet a +5-foot enhancement bonus to their base speed.

Name: Malleable Symbol
Description: This holy symbol can be reshaped into the symbol of any deity as a standard action. It functions as a holy symbol for any divine spellcaster.

Name: Migrus Locker
Description: This heavy iron locker can store up to 100 cubic feet of material in an extradimensional space. Items placed within can be retrieved by speaking a command word as a standard action. If the locker is destroyed, its contents spill harmlessly into the nearest open space.

Name: Ornament of Healing Light
Description: This small crystal ornament glows with soft light. Once per day, it can be activated to emit a 30-foot-radius burst of positive energy, healing 3d8+9 points of damage to all living creatures in the area.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure serious wounds

Name: Prayer Wheel of Ethical Strength
Description: When spun as a standard action, this carved wooden prayer wheel grants the user a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities for 10 minutes. The wheel can be used once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

Name: Stone Horse, Courser
Description: This small statuette can transform into a heavy warhorse for up to 8 hours per day. The horse serves the owner faithfully. The figurine can be used once per day.

Name: Summon-Slave Crystal
Description: This faceted crystal can be attuned to a single humanoid creature. Once per day as a standard action, the holder can attempt to summon the attuned creature as if using dimension door (CL 9th). The creature can resist with a DC 16 Will save.

Name: Treasurer’s Seal
Description: This heavy signet seal can mark documents or containers. When used, it can cast arcane mark at will. Once per day, it can cast secret page (CL 9th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, arcane mark, secret page

Name: Black Soul Shard
Description: This dark crystal can capture the soul of a creature slain within 30 feet (as trap the soul, CL 9th). The shard can hold one soul at a time. Once used, the shard cannot be used again.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, trap the soul

Name: Golem Manual (Clay)
Description:
The wondrous items known as golem manuals contain all the information and magical power required to create a particular kind of golem. This effectively grants the Craft Construct feat to anyone using the manual to craft a golem of that type, and it provides an increase in caster level for the purpose of meeting the prerequisite to craft that specific type of golem.
Further, the manual grants a +5 competence bonus on skill checks to craft the golem and contains all the necessary spells, which can be activated by anyone who has the relevant spells on their class’s spell list (but only for the purpose of crafting the golem). When using a golem manual, you must still spend the normal amount of time to craft the golem and pay the cost of the golem’s body (or provide it through other means), but you do not need to pay the rest of the normal cost to create the golem.
The spells included in a golem manual require a spell trigger activation and can be activated only to assist in the construction of a golem. The cost of the book does not include the cost of constructing the golem’s body. Once the golem is finished, the writing in the manual fades and the book is consumed in flames. When the book’s ashes are sprinkled upon the golem, it becomes fully animated.
Clay: The book contains animate objects, bless, commune, prayer, and resurrection. The reader may treat her caster level as one level higher than normal for the purpose of crafting a clay golem.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Construct, animate objects, bless, commune, prayer, resurrection, creator must be caster level 11th

Name: Horsemaster’s Saddle
Description: This finely tooled leather saddle enhances the abilities of a mount. While ridden, the mount gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and Constitution. In addition, once per day the rider can grant the mount the benefits of haste for 5 rounds.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bear’s endurance, bull’s strength, haste

Name: Pipes of Dissolution
Description: These pipes produce a low, droning tone. When played for 1 round, unattended nonmagical objects within 30 feet must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or take 2d6 points of acid damage. The pipes can be used once per day.

Name: Pipes of Pain
Description: These pipes create a discordant melody that wracks creatures with agony. When played for 1 round, enemies within 30 feet must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or be staggered for as long as the pipes continue to be played, plus 1 round thereafter. The pipes can be used once per day for up to 10 rounds.

Name: Seeker’s Sight
Description: This crystal lens allows the user to see secret doors and traps as if using detect secret doors. The effect lasts for up to 10 minutes per day, divided as desired.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, detect secret doors

Name: Blessed Book
Description: This well-made tome is always of small size and holds up to 1,000 pages of spells. It functions as a wizard’s spellbook, except that writing a new spell into a blessed book takes only 1 hour per spell level and requires no material components or gp expenditure. The book is immune to damage from fire, water, and normal wear.

Name: Waters of Transfiguration
Description: This vial contains shimmering liquid. When consumed as a standard action, it functions as baleful polymorph (CL 9th, Fortitude DC 17 negates). If the target fails the save, it is transformed as the spell. The vial contains a single dose.

Name: Gem of Brightness
Description:
This prism-like gem radiates light. It has 50 charges and can produce the following effects:

  * Light (no charge cost)
  * Continual flame (1 charge)
  * Daylight (2 charges)
  * Flare (1 charge, Fortitude DC 14 negates blindness for 1d4 rounds)

The gem can be used until all charges are expended.

Name: Harp of Contagion
Description: When played for 1 round, this harp can cast contagion (CL 9th, Fortitude DC 16 negates) on a single target within 30 feet. The harp can be used once per day.

Name: Lyre of Building
Description: This magical instrument can be played to negate attacks against buildings, walls, and similar structures. If played for at least 1 full round, it negates any attacks made against buildings, walls, or similar structures within 300 feet for as long as the music continues, up to 30 minutes per day. The lyre also enables its player to complete construction projects in half the normal time if played for 8 hours per day.

Name: Void Pennant
Description: This black pennant can be attached to a weapon or carried on a pole. Allies within 30 feet gain a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities. The pennant functions continuously while carried.

Name: Stone Horse, Destrier
Description: This small statuette can transform into a heavy warhorse with military saddle and bridle. The horse serves the owner faithfully for up to 24 hours per week. The figurine can be used once per week.

Name: Book of the Loremaster
Description: This thick tome grants its reader a +5 competence bonus on Knowledge checks for 24 hours after 1 hour of study. The book can be used once per day.

Name: Cauldron of Plenty
Description: This iron cauldron can produce enough simple but nourishing food and water to feed up to 12 Medium creatures once per day. The food appears after the command word is spoken and remains fresh for 24 hours.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, create food and water

Name: Horn of Judgment
Description: When blown, this horn emits a thunderous blast. All evil creatures within 30 feet take 4d6 points of sonic damage (Fortitude DC 16 half). The horn can be used once per day.

Name: Horn of the Tritons
Description: When blown underwater, this horn summons 1d4+1 sharks (as summon monster V) that serve the user for 1 hour. The horn can be used once per week.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster V

Name: Pearl of the Sirines
Description: When held in the mouth, this pearl allows the user to breathe water and grants a swim speed of 30 feet for up to 1 hour per day, divided as desired.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Onyx Dog)
Description: This onyx statuette can transform into a riding dog. The dog serves the user faithfully for up to 6 hours per day. The figurine can be used once per day.

Name: Bag of Tricks (Tan)
Description: This bag appears normal but contains small fuzzy objects. When one is drawn and thrown to the ground, it transforms into a creature as if using summon monster V. The bag can be used three times per week.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster V

Name: Boro Bead (4th)
Description: This small wooden bead is carved with druidic symbols. Once per day, when the wearer prepares spells, she can recover one expended 4th-level druid spell as if it had not been cast.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be a druid

Name: Page of Spell Knowledge (4th)
Description: This sheet of parchment is covered in densely scribbled arcane formulas. A spontaneous arcane spellcaster can study the page for 1 hour to permanently add the spell on the page to her list of spells known. The spell must be of a level she can cast and must appear on her class spell list. Once used, the page becomes blank.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast the spell scribed on the page

Description:

Once per day on command, a pearl of power enables the possessor to recall any one spell of a particular level that she had prepared and then cast that day. The spell is then prepared again, just as if it had not been cast.

The spell must be of a particular level, depending on the pearl. Different pearls exist for recalling one spell per day of each level from 1st through 9th and for the 0-level spells.

A pearl of power only functions for spells prepared by the possessor.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be recalled

Name: Preserving Flask (4th)
Description: This stoppered glass flask can hold a single 4th-level potion. Any potion placed within the flask does not lose potency over time and cannot be spoiled by environmental effects. A potion can remain within the flask indefinitely without degradation.

Name: Scabbard of Keen Edges
Description: This simple leather scabbard can hold one slashing melee weapon. Once per day as a swift action when drawing the weapon, the bearer can cause the weapon to gain the benefits of keen edge (CL 10th) for 10 minutes.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Golden Lions)
Description: This pair of golden lion statuettes can transform into two lions. The lions serve the user faithfully for up to 1 hour per day. The figurines can be used once per day.

Name: Chime of Interruption
Description: This chime can be struck as an immediate action to counterspell as if using dispel magic (CL 7th). The chime can be used once per day.

Name: Broom of Flying
Description: This broom can fly as if using overland flight (CL 5th). It can carry up to 200 pounds and moves at a speed of 40 feet (perfect maneuverability). The broom can be used for up to 9 hours per day.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Marble Elephant)
Description: This marble statuette can transform into a Medium elephant. The elephant serves the user faithfully for up to 24 hours per week. The figurine can be used once per week.

Name: Staff of blessed relief
Description:
This simple wooden staff is capped with a silver sunburst. It allows use of the following spells:

• cure light wounds (1 charge)
• remove fear (1 charge)
• lesser restoration (2 charges)

The staff is typically created with 10 charges.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, cure light wounds, remove fear, lesser restoration

Name: Staff of minor arcana
Description:
This polished ash staff is capped with crystal. It allows use of the following spells:

• magic missile (1 charge)
• scorching ray (2 charges)
• lightning bolt (3 charges)

The staff is typically created with 10 charges.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, magic missile, scorching ray, lightning bolt

Name: Staff of tricks
Description:
This brightly painted staff has a carved jester’s head at the top. It allows use of the following spells:

• disguise self (1 charge)
• invisibility (2 charges)
• mirror image (2 charges)

The staff is typically created with 10 charges.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, disguise self, invisibility, mirror image

Name: Staff of the scout
Description:
This slender oak staff is wrapped in leather. It allows use of the following spells:

• detect secret doors (1 charge)
• invisibility (2 charges)
• clairaudience/clairvoyance (3 charges)

The staff is typically created with 10 charges.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, detect secret doors, invisibility, clairaudience/clairvoyance

Name: Staff of eidolons
Description:
This crooked staff is made of mahogany and decorated with the bones of eidolons that jut out of the wood. It allows the use of the following spells:

• lesser rejuvenate eidolon (1 charge; Advanced Player’s Guide)
• unfetter (1 charge; Advanced Player’s Guide)
• lesser evolution surge (2 charges; Advanced Player’s Guide)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, lesser evolution surge, lesser rejuvenate eidolon, unfetter

Name: Staff of accompaniment
Description:
This staff is adorned with musical notes. When held and used with bardic performance, it accompanies the song with the sounds of wind instruments, granting a +2 competence bonus on Perform checks. The staff allows use of the following spells:

• chord of shards (1 charge; Ultimate Magic)
• saving finale (1 charge; Advanced Player’s Guide)
• allegro (2 charges; Ultimate Magic)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, allegro, chord of shards, saving finale

Name: Staff of understanding
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 203, Pathfinder Society Field Guide pg. 54
Description:
This polished maple or oak staff is inlaid with ivory strips along its length, and runes of various languages also formed from inlaid ivory span the shaft. It allows use of the following spells:

• comprehend languages (1 charge)
• detect thoughts (2 charges)
• tongues (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, comprehend languages, detect thoughts, tongues

Name: Staff of charming
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 195, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 492
Description:
Made of twisting wood ornately shaped and carved, this staff allows use of the following spells:

• charm person (1 charge)
• charm monster (2 charges)

Construction.Requirements: Craft Staff, charm monster, charm person

Name: Charm Bracelet
Description: This delicate silver bracelet is adorned with five tiny charms. Each charm can be activated once per day as a swift action to grant the wearer a +2 luck bonus on one ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check. The wearer must declare the use of a charm before rolling.

Name: Duelist’s Vambraces
Description:
These elegant vambraces grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls made when fighting defensively or using Combat Expertise.
Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC for 1 round.

Name: Merciful Vambraces
Description: These vambraces allow the wearer to channel nonlethal force. Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause her melee attacks to deal nonlethal damage without the normal –4 penalty for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure moderate wounds

Name: Vambraces of the Tactician
Description:
These polished steel vambraces grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge (nobility) and Knowledge (history) checks.
Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can grant one ally within 30 feet a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls for 1 round.

Name: Bracers of Armor (+3)
Description:
These items appear to be wrist or arm guards, sometimes etched with symbols of protection or depictions of vigilant-looking animals. Bracers of armor surround the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting him an armor bonus of +1 to +8, just as though he were wearing armor. Both bracers of armor must be worn for the magic to be effective.
Alternatively, bracers of armor can be enchanted with armor special abilities. See Table 3–3: Armor Special Abilities for a list of abilities. Special abilities usually count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of an item, but do not improve AC. Bracers of armor cannot have a modified bonus (armor bonus plus armor special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +8. Bracers of armor must have at least a +1 armor bonus to grant an armor special ability.
Bracers of armor cannot have any armor special abilities that add a flat gp amount to their cost. Bracers of armor and ordinary armor do not stack. If the wearer receives a larger armor bonus from another source, the bracers of armor cease functioning and do not grant their armor bonus or their armor special abilities. If the bracers of armor grant a larger armor bonus, the other source of armor ceases functioning.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, creator’s caster level must be at least two times that of the bonus placed on the bracers, plus any requirements of the armor special abilities

Name: Seducer’s Bane
Description:
This slender bracelet appears harmless, but it is designed to ward off unwanted romantic influence. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against charm and compulsion effects.
Once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can reroll a failed saving throw against a charm or compulsion effect. She must take the second result, even if it is worse.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

Name: Bracers of the Avenging Knight
Description:
These steel bracers are engraved with holy symbols. The wearer gains a +2 sacred bonus on attack rolls made against creatures that have damaged her within the last round.
Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws for 1 round.

Name: Arrowmaster’s Bracers
Description:
These bracers grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls made with bows.
Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can treat one ranged attack made with a bow as though she had rolled a natural 20 to determine whether the attack threatens a critical hit (she must still roll to confirm the critical hit).

Name: Vambraces of the Genie (Efreeti)
Description:
These brass vambraces are warm to the touch and etched with flame motifs. The wearer gains fire resistance 10.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast scorching ray (CL 9th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resist energy, scorching ray

Name: Bracelet of Bargaining
Description:
This golden bracelet grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks made to influence attitude and on Appraise checks.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast glibness upon herself (CL 9th).

Name: Bracelet of Mercy
Description: This silver bracelet bears a small symbol of healing. Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can remove the fatigued, shaken, or sickened condition from herself or a creature she touches.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure serious wounds

Name: Bracers of the Merciful Knight
Description:
These polished bracers grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Heal checks.
Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cast cure serious wounds (CL 9th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure serious wounds

Name: Bracelet of Second Chances
Description: This bracelet allows the wearer to reroll one attack roll, saving throw, or skill check per day. The wearer must take the second result, even if it is worse.

Name: Bracers of Armor (+4)
Description:
