If the bracers of armor grant a larger armor bonus, the other source of armor ceases functioning.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, creator’s caster level must be at least two times that of the bonus placed on the bracers, plus any requirements of the armor special abilities

Name: Shackles of Durance Vile
Description:
These heavy iron shackles magically adjust to fit a creature of Small to Large size and automatically lock. A creature wearing shackles of durance vile is under a constant effect similar to geas/quest (Will DC 18 negates) determined by the wearer of the key. The effect persists as long as the shackles are worn.
The shackles have hardness 10 and 15 hit points. A DC 30 Disable Device check is required to pick the lock. A manacled creature can break free with a DC 28 Strength check or DC 35 Escape Artist check.

Name: Belt of Tumbling
Description: This supple leather belt grants the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks made to tumble through an opponent’s threatened area or through an opponent’s space.

Name: Beneficial Bandolier
Description: This bandolier has four pouches. Once per day per pouch, the wearer can draw an item from a pouch as a swift action. The pouch must contain the item at the start of the day, and the item must weigh 1 pound or less. Items that do not fit in the pouch cannot be drawn in this way.

Name: Meridian Belt
Description: This simple cloth belt grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Fortitude saves against effects that cause fatigue or exhaustion. If the wearer becomes fatigued, once per day she can remove the fatigued condition as a swift action.

Name: Bladed Belt
Description: This belt contains hidden sheaths that can store up to four daggers or similar light blades. Drawing a stored blade from the belt is treated as drawing a weapon and does not provoke attacks of opportunity. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Sleight of Hand checks made to conceal blades stored in the belt.

Name: Heavyload Belt
Description: This broad leather belt allows the wearer to carry more weight. The wearer treats her Strength score as 4 higher for the purpose of determining carrying capacity only. This does not grant any other benefit of increased Strength.

Name: Aquatic Cummerbund
Description: This wide silk cummerbund allows the wearer to breathe water as easily as air for up to 10 minutes per day. The duration need not be consecutive. Activating or dismissing this ability is a swift action.

Name: Equestrian Belt
Description: This sturdy leather belt grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Ride checks. If the wearer has the Mounted Combat feat, she can use that feat twice per round instead of once.

Name: Robe of Infinite Twine
Description: This simple robe produces an endless supply of sturdy twine. As a free action, the wearer can draw up to 50 feet of twine from the robe each round. The twine has hardness 0 and 2 hit points per 5-foot section. The twine disappears 1 hour after being drawn from the robe.

Name: Robe of Needles
Description: This robe appears normal but contains dozens of hidden needles. Once per round as a free action, the wearer can pull a needle from the robe and throw it as a ranged attack with a 10-foot range increment. The needle deals 1 point of piercing damage. The robe produces up to 10 needles per day.

Name: Robe of Bones
Description: This robe is adorned with small animal bones. The wearer can remove a bone and throw it to create a skeleton that obeys her commands. The robe contains bones sufficient to create up to 4 skeletons, each functioning as if created by animate dead (caster level 6th). Once a bone is used, it cannot be replaced.

Name: Bodywrap of Mighty Strikes +1
Description: This bodywrap grants a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes and natural weapons.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, magic fang

Name: Corset of the Vishkanya
Description: This tight-fitting corset grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Fortitude saves against poison. Once per day, the wearer can envenom a weapon she wields with a mild poison that deals 1d2 Constitution damage (Fortitude DC 13 negates).

Name: Druid’s Vestment
Description: This garment grants the wearer a +1 effective level for determining the abilities of her animal companion and wild shape ability.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon nature’s ally II

Name: Bandages of Rapid Recovery
Description: These clean white bandages can be wrapped around a wounded creature as a standard action. Once per day, when applied to a creature, the bandages allow that creature to recover hit points and ability damage from natural healing as if it had complete bed rest for 24 hours.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure light wounds

Name: Quick Runner’s Shirt
Description: This lightweight shirt allows its wearer to take an extra move action once per day. Activating the shirt is a swift action, and the extra move action must be taken in the same round.

Name: Endless Bandolier
Description: This leather bandolier has numerous pouches that can hold up to 20 pieces of ammunition of the same type. Any piece of ammunition drawn from the bandolier automatically returns to it after being fired or thrown, as if it had the returning special ability. The bandolier replenishes expended ammunition each day at dawn.

Name: All Tools Vest
Description: This vest contains numerous hidden pockets. As a swift action, the wearer can produce any mundane tool weighing up to 2 pounds. The tool lasts for 1 hour before disappearing. The vest can produce up to 5 such tools per day.

Name: Vest of Surgery
Description: This bloodstained vest grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Heal checks. Once per day, when the wearer succeeds at a Heal check to treat deadly wounds, the target heals an additional 1d6 hit points.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure moderate wounds

Name: Deathwatch Eyes
Description: These pale gray crystal lenses fit over the wearer’s eyes. Three times per day, the wearer can activate the lenses as a swift action to gain the effects of deathwatch for 1 minute.

Name: Eyes of the Eagle
Description: These items are made of special crystal and fit over the eyes of the wearer. They grant a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks.

Name: Goggles of Minute Seeing
Description: These brass goggles are engraved with intricate symbols. They grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Appraise checks and a +5 competence bonus on Craft checks to create items.

Name: Pirate’s Eye Patch
Description: This black leather patch grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Bluff checks. Once per day, the wearer can activate the patch as a standard action to gain the effects of invisibility for 1 minute or until she attacks.

Name: Spectacles of Understanding
Description: These spectacles grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Linguistics checks and allow her to understand the spoken form of one language of her choice while worn.

Name: Lenses of Detection
Description: These crystal lenses grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks to notice hidden doors and traps.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, detect secret doors

Name: Boots of the Cat
Description: These soft leather boots are incredibly supple. The wearer always lands on her feet and takes no damage from falling if the fall is 20 feet or less. For falls greater than 20 feet, she treats the fall as if it were 20 feet shorter than it actually is when determining damage.

Name: Daredevil Boots
Description: These boots grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump and a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to reduce damage from falling.

Name: Boots of the Enduring March
Description: These sturdy boots allow the wearer to hustle for 12 hours per day without taking nonlethal damage or becoming fatigued.

Name: Feather Step Slippers
Description: These soft slippers allow the wearer to move across natural difficult terrain without penalty.

Name: Boots of Friendly Terrain
Description: These boots allow the wearer to move across a specific type of terrain (such as forest, desert, or swamp) as if under the effects of pass without trace and without taking movement penalties from that terrain.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, pass without trace

Name: Boots of the Winterlands
Description: These boots grant the wearer immunity to nonlethal damage from cold and allow her to move across icy surfaces without penalty.

Name: Boots of Elvenkind
Description: These soft boots grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Name: Acrobat Slippers
Description: These flexible slippers grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks.

Name: Horseshoes of Speed
Description: These iron horseshoes can be affixed to a horse’s hooves. The horse’s base land speed increases by 30 feet.

Name: Boots of the Mire
Description: These boots allow the wearer to move through mud and similar soft terrain without penalty and grant a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to move across such terrain.

Name: Assisting Gloves
Description: These white cotton gloves grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Aid Another checks.

Name: Claws of the Ice Bear
Description: These fur-lined gloves grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Survival checks in cold environments. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can gain two claw attacks that deal 1d4 points of slashing damage (1d3 if Small) plus 1 point of cold damage for 1 minute.

Name: Gloves of Reconnaissance
Description: These supple leather gloves grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Perception checks. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can gain the benefits of see invisibility for 1 minute.

Name: Glowing Glove
Description: This thin white glove allows the wearer to cause her hand to glow as a torch at will. In addition, once per day as a standard action, the wearer can emit a flash of light that dazzles creatures in a 10-foot radius for 1 round (Fortitude DC 11 negates).

Name: Apprentice’s Cheating Gloves
Description: These gloves grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Sleight of Hand checks. Once per day, the wearer can reroll a single Sleight of Hand check and must take the second result.

Name: Challenger’s Gloves
Description: These gloves grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. Once per day as a swift action, the wearer can challenge a single creature within 30 feet, gaining a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls against that creature for 1 minute.

Name: Gloves of Larceny
Description: These gloves grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Sleight of Hand checks and a +5 competence bonus on Disable Device checks.

Name: Healer’s Gloves
Description: These white gloves allow the wearer to use cure light wounds twice per day (caster level 3rd).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure light wounds

Name: Engineer’s Workgloves
Description: These thick leather gloves grant the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Craft (mechanical) checks and a +5 competence bonus on Disable Device checks made to disable mechanical traps.

Name: Mask of Stony Demeanor
Description: This heavy stone mask covers the wearer’s face and muffles her expressions. The wearer gains a +10 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to hide her true intentions. In addition, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on saving throws against emotion effects.

Name: Cap of Human Guise
Description: This simple cloth cap allows a humanoid wearer to appear as a human of the same size. This functions as disguise self except that it only allows the wearer to appear human.

Name: Cap of Light
Description: This simple cap allows the wearer to create light at will, as the spell light.

Name: Hat of Disguise
Description: This apparently normal hat allows its wearer to alter her appearance as with a disguise self spell at will.

Name: Buffering Cap
Description: This padded leather cap grants the wearer a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

Name: Miser’s Mask
Description: This plain wooden mask allows the wearer to appraise items with great precision. The wearer gains a +10 competence bonus on Appraise checks.

Name: Stalker’s Mask
Description: This dark mask grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks. In addition, once per day as a swift action, the wearer can gain the benefits of invisibility for 1 round.

Name: Hand of the Mage
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 259, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 516
Description: This mummified elf hand hangs by a golden chain around a character’s neck (taking up space as a magic necklace would). It allows the wearer to utilize the spell mage hand at will.

Name: Aegis of Recovery
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 254, Rival Guide pg. 5
Description: An aegis of recovery grants its wearer a +2 resistance bonus on all saving throws made to recover from a continuing effect, such as ongoing poison damage, daily saving throws against a disease, a hold person spell, or lingering damage from an attack. This bonus does not help against initial saving throws against such effects. Should the wearer ever drop below 0 hit points, the aegis heals the wearer for 2d8+3 points of damage and then crumbles to dust.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, cure moderate wounds

Name: Amulet of Bullet Protection (+1)
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 254, Ultimate Combat pg. 143
Description: This amulet, usually crafted from the splintered remains of spent firearm bullets shaped into a rough holy symbol or clover, grants the wearer a luck bonus to AC against firearm attacks that target touch AC.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, divine favor, creator's caster level must be at least three times the amulet's bonus

Name: Brooch of Shielding
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 257, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 505
Description: This appears to be a piece of silver or gold jewelry used to fasten a cloak or cape. In addition to this mundane task, it can absorb magic missiles of the sort generated by the spell or spell-like ability. A brooch can absorb up to 101 points of damage from magic missiles before it melts and becomes useless.

Name: Necklace of Fireballs (Type I)
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 259, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 524
Description:
This item appears to be a string or cluster of spherical beads, sometimes with the ends tied together to form a necklace. (It does not count as an item worn around the neck for the purpose of determining which of a character’s worn magic items is effective.) If a character holds it, however, all can see the strand as it really is—a golden chain from which hang a number of golden spheres. The spheres are detachable by the wearer (and only by the wearer), who can easily hurl one of them up to 70 feet.
When a sphere arrives at the end of its trajectory, it detonates as a fireball spell (Reflex DC 14 half).
Spheres come in different strengths, ranging from those that deal 2d6 points of fire damage to those that deal 10d6. The price of a sphere is 150 gp for each die of damage it deals.

If the necklace is being worn or carried by a character who fails her saving throw against a magical fire attack, the item must make a saving throw as well (with a save bonus of +7). If the necklace fails to save, all its remaining spheres detonate simultaneously, often with regrettable consequences for the wearer.

Name: Amulet of Natural Armor (+1)
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 256, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 500
Description: This amulet, usually containing some type of magically preserved monster hide or other natural armor—such as bone, horn, carapace, or beast scales— toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, creator's caster level must be at least three times the amulet's bonus

Name: Golembane Scarab
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 258, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 529
Description: This beetle-shaped pin enables its wearer to detect any golem within 60 feet, although he must concentrate (a standard action) in order for the detection to take place. A scarab enables its bearer to combat golems with weapons, unarmed attacks, or natural weapons as if those golems had no damage reduction.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, detect magic, creator must be at least 10th level

Name: Necklace of Fireballs (Type II)
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 259, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 524
Description:
This item appears to be a string or cluster of spherical beads, sometimes with the ends tied together to form a necklace. (It does not count as an item worn around the neck for the purpose of determining which of a character’s worn magic items is effective.) If a character holds it, however, all can see the strand as it really is—a golden chain from which hang a number of golden spheres. The spheres are detachable by the wearer (and only by the wearer), who can easily hurl one of them up to 70 feet.
When a sphere arrives at the end of its trajectory, it detonates as a fireball spell (Reflex DC 14 half).
Spheres come in different strengths, ranging from those that deal 2d6 points of fire damage to those that deal 10d6. The price of a sphere is 150 gp for each die of damage it deals.

Name: Swarmbane Clasp
Description: An ancient fossilized insect lies trapped within this ornate amber clasp, impaled by the long golden pin that fastens the wearer’s cloak. The wearer’s weapons, unarmed attacks, and natural attacks deal full damage to swarms, regardless of the swarm’s immunity to weapon damage (if any, although damage reduction applies as normal). If the wearer is damaged by a swarm, she automatically succeeds on her saving throw against the swarm’s distraction ability.

Name: Mind Sentinel Medallion
Description:
The surface of this silver medallion is covered in angular geometric shapes that refract light randomly. The medallion grants a continuous +2 resistance bonus on saves versus mind-affecting spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities. If the wearer fails a save to avoid becoming dominated or confused, the amulet immediately grants the wearer a second saving throw to resist the effect.
If this second save is successful, the medallion’s power fades away entirely and it becomes a simple piece of silver jewelry.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

Name: Mummer’s Ruff
Description: Usually fashioned from brightly colored silk, a mummer’s ruff is a favored accoutrement of performers and con artists alike. The wearer of a mummer’s ruff gains a +10 bonus on Bluff skill checks when attempting to imitate another’s voice. In addition, once per day, the wearer of the mummer’s ruff can throw his voice as if using ventriloquism for up to 5 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, sculpt sound, ventriloquism

Name: Dungeon ring, prisoner’s
Description: This simple iron band is typically used to control prisoners. While worn, the ring imposes a –5 penalty on Escape Artist checks made to escape from manacles, ropes, or similar restraints. The ring must be worn to function.

Name: Ring of arcane signets
Description: This ring allows the wearer to cast arcane mark at will. The mark can be altered or dismissed as normal for the spell.

Name: Ring of spell knowledge I
Description: This ring allows a spontaneous arcane spellcaster to cast one 1st-level spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list as if it were known. The spell must be chosen when the ring is created and cannot be changed.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must be able to cast the spell to be stored

Name: Ring of protection +1
Description: This ring grants a +1 deflection bonus to AC.

Name: Ring of the grasping grave
Description: Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer can cause a skeletal hand to erupt from the ground in a square adjacent to her. The hand attempts a trip combat maneuver against one creature in that square using a CMB equal to the wearer’s base attack bonus + the wearer’s Charisma modifier. The hand disappears after the attempt.

Name: Ring of feather falling
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 170, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring is crafted with a feather pattern all around its edge. It acts exactly like a feather fall spell, and activates immediately if the wearer falls more than 5 feet.

Name: Ring of climbing
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 168, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This magic ring has the deceptively simple appearance of a plain leather cord that wraps securely around a finger. The ring continually grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Climb checks.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have 5 ranks in the Climb skill

Name: Ring of jumping
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 172, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This ring continually allows the wearer to leap about, providing a +5 competence bonus on all her Acrobatics checks made to make high or long jumps.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have 5 ranks in Acrobatics

Name: Ring of sustenance
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description:
This ring continually provides its wearer with life-sustaining nourishment. The ring also refreshes the body and mind; its wearer only needs to sleep 2 hours per day to gain the benefit of 8 hours of sleep. This allows a spellcaster that requires rest to prepare spells to do so after only 2 hours, but does not allow a spellcaster to prepare spells more than once per day. The ring must be worn for a full week before it begins to work.
If it is removed, the owner must wear it for another week to reattune it to himself.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, create food and water

Name: Ring of swimming
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Description: This silver ring usually has fishlike designs and motifs etched into the band. It continually grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Construction.Requirements: Forge Ring, creator must have 5 ranks in Swim

Name: Ring of ferocious action
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 170, Advanced Race Guide pg. 58
Description: This ring allows its wearer to persevere through physical or mental trauma that hampers his actions. Once per day, when the wearer gains the staggered condition from an enemy's attack, she can ignore that condition for up to 5 rounds. This does not prevent her from gaining the staggered condition again, and it does not protect her if she gained the staggered condition multiple times.

Name: Catching Cape
Description: This silvery cape furls and ripples like a flag with every step its owner takes. As a swift action, the wearer can order the cape to transform into a faint sphere of force that surrounds him on all sides. The field grants the wearer concealment (20% miss chance) against ranged attacks and lasts for 1 minute or until the wearer is missed by a ranged attack due to the power of the cloak, whichever comes first. When the field is used, all magic is lost from the cloak, leaving only a mundane silvery garment.

Name: Cloak of Human Guise
Description:
This plain cloak only has any effect when worn by a member of a half-human race, such as a half-orc or half-elf. It alters the wearer’s appearance similarly to a hat of disguise, but only to the extent that it conceals or alters the wearer’s nonhuman physical traits so the creature appears fully human. Any feature that is plausibly human remains.
For example, a half-orc wearing the cloak loses his green or gray skin color and pointed ears, has no visible tusks, and is otherwise completely able to pass as a human version of his normal self. Likewise, a half-elf wearing the cloak has round ears, humanlike eyes, and no other traits indicating elven ancestry. The wearer has no control over the specific guise, and those familiar with his normal appearance can recognize him in his human guise.

Name: Cloak of Resistance +1
Description: Flecks of silver or steel are often sown amid the fabric of these magical cloaks. This garment offers magical protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus

Name: Muleback Cords
Description: These thick leather cords wrap around the wearer’s biceps and shoulders. When worn, they make the wearer’s muscles appear larger than normal. The wearer treats his Strength score as 8 higher than normal when determining his carrying capacity. This bonus does not apply to combat, breaking items, or any other Strength-related rolls, it only contributes to the amount of equipment or material the wearer can carry.

Name: Shawl of Life-Keeping
Description:
This magical shawl is woven from silken, diaphanous material. Once per day, the wearer can speak a command word to transfer some of her life energy into the shawl (up to 10 hit points). If she is wearing the shawl and is reduced to –1 hit points or below, the shawl immediately heals her an amount equal to the number of hit points stored in the shawl. This healing cannot prevent the wearer from being killed.
The life energy stored in the shawl lasts for 24 hours or until it heals the wearer, whichever comes first. If the shawl is destroyed, the stored life energy is lost.
While the shawl is storing a creature’s life energy, it retains a connection to that creature. If another creature holds the shawl in its hand, the creature whose life energy is stored in the shawl takes a –2 penalty on Fortitude and Reflex saving throws against all effects from the current bearer of the shawl.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, cure light wounds, stabilize

Name: Shield Cloak
Description: The wearer of this rough, gray cloak can, as a move action, grasp the garment’s edge and cause it to harden. The wearer can use the hardened edge it as if it were a masterwork light wooden shield. Using the cloak in this fashion imposes no armor check penalty, but does impose a 5% arcane spell failure chance. The edge of the cloak can be dropped and made pliant again as a free action. Shield enhancement bonuses and special abilities can be added to the cloak as if it were a masterwork shield.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shield

Name: Quickchange Cloak
Description:
One side of this reversible gray hooded cape is exquisitely embroidered and richly decorated, while the other appears shabby and worn. On command, by passing the edge of the cloak over her face, the wearer may remove a mundane disguise (one applied with the Disguise skill) and store it in the cloak. This does not change the cloak’s appearance in any way.
Once a disguise is stored in the cloak, it can be reapplied to the wearer who placed it within the cloak on command, using the original result of the Disguise check. The cloak can store up to three disguises at once, and any wearer of the cloak can discard any number of disguises within the cloak as a free action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, prestidigitation, creator must have at least 5 ranks in Disguise

Name: Cowardly Crouching Cloak
Description: This nondescript gray cloak has a hood that can fit over the wearer’s entire face. The wearer can, as a move action, cover his face and drop to a huddling crouch. Any creature seeking to directly attack him while he does this must make a DC 11 Will save to do so (as the sanctuary spell). The wearer cannot see or take any actions while crouching. This makes him effectively blind, with all the normal penalties, but not helpless. The wearer can end his crouch simply by standing up or moving.

Name: Cloak of Elvenkind
Description: These cloaks of famed elven design are enhanced to reflect the wearer’s surroundings, aiding him in blending in with any terrain. When this plain gray cloak is worn with the hood drawn up around the head, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, invisibility, creator must be an elf

Name: Cloak of the Hedge Wizard
Aura: faint, school based on cloak type
Description:
This cloak comes in eight varieties—one for each school of magic. The cloak grants its wearer the ability to use a certain number of spells on command (caster level 1st) based on its school of magic. It also grants the wearer the ability to use prestidigitation on command and at will.
Abjuration: at will—resistance; 1/day—endure elements, shield
Conjuration: at will—acid splash; 1/day—mage armor, unseen servant
Divination: at will—detect magic; 1/day—detect secret doors, true strike
Enchantment: at will—daze; 1/day—charm person, sleep
Evocation: at will—light; 1/day—floating disk, magic missile
Illusion: at will—ghost sound; 1/day—color spray, silent image
Necromancy: at will—touch of fatigue; 1/day—cause fear, ray of enfeeblement
Transmutation: at will—mage hand; 1/day—enlarge person, expeditious retreat

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, prestidigitation and any spell the cloak allows the caster to use; the creator must have Spell Focus in the cloak’s school of magic

Name: Cloak of Fiery Vanishing
Description:
This thick leather cloak is charred and blackened around the edges and smells faintly of soot. Once per day, when subject to an effect that deals fire damage, the wearer can spend an immediate action while obscured by the flames to become invisible, leaving behind an illusory pile of ashes and bones, as if he had been slain by the fire effect. The wearer’s invisibility and his illusory remains last for 5 rounds or until the wearer attacks any creature.
Creatures that study or interact with the ashes can make a DC 11 Will save to disbelieve the illusion, though this does not end the invisibility effect.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, invisibility, silent image

Name: Cloak of Fangs
Description: Wearing this animal-hair cloak grants a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws. Furthermore, the wearer can force its teeth to grow rapidly up to five times per day as a swift action. The oversized teeth last for 1 round, during which time the wearer can make a bite attack. Treat this attack as a primary natural attack that deals 1d6 points of damage (or 1d4 if the wearer is Small). If the wearer already has a bite attack, the damage of that bite attack increases by one step (Bestiary 302).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, alter self, resistance

Name: Pauldrons of the Serpent
Description: Constructed of mithral, each of these pauldrons bears an embossed device of a viper coiled defensively. These pauldrons grant their wearer a +2 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity, and increase the wearer’s CMD by 2 against bull rush, grapple, reposition, and trip combat maneuvers.

Name: Stonemist Cloak
Description: In rocky or mountainous areas, when this stone-gray cloak is worn with the hood drawn up around the head, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks. Once per day, the wearer can create an area of fog equivalent to obscuring mist.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, invisibility, obscuring mist

Name: Anatomy Doll
Description: This small humanoid doll is covered in tiny runes and removable parts. When a creature’s blood is placed upon the doll as a standard action, the doll becomes attuned to that creature for 24 hours. During this time, the wielder gains a +2 insight bonus on Heal checks made to treat that creature and on Knowledge (arcana) checks made to identify effects currently affecting that creature.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, detect magic, gentle repose

Name: Bead of Newt Prevention
Description: This small glass bead protects its wearer from unwanted transformations. The wearer gains a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against polymorph effects.

Name: Beast-Bond Brand
Description: This magical brand can be applied to a creature as a standard action. Once branded, the creature gains a +2 morale bonus on Handle Animal checks and wild empathy checks made regarding that creature for 24 hours.

Name: Bookplate of Recall
Description: This ornate bookplate can be affixed to a book. Once per day as a standard action, the owner can speak a command word to teleport the book to her hand, as long as it is on the same plane.

Name: Boro Bead (1st)
Description: This small wooden bead is carved with druidic symbols. Once per day, when the wearer prepares spells, she can recover one expended 1st-level druid spell as if it had not been cast.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be a druid

Name: Concealing Pocket
Description: This small cloth pocket can be sewn onto clothing. It holds up to 1 cubic foot of material. Any object placed within the pocket is hidden from view and from detect magic unless the viewer succeeds at a DC 20 Perception check.

Name: Dowsing Syrup
Description: When poured upon the ground, this thick syrup seeps into the earth and reveals the presence of potable water within 100 feet, as if using detect water.

Name: Incense of Transcendence
Description: When burned for 10 minutes, this incense grants the user a +2 enhancement bonus on Concentration checks for 1 hour.

Name: Page of Spell Knowledge (1st)
Description: This sheet of parchment is covered in densely scribbled arcane formulas. A spontaneous arcane spellcaster can study the page for 1 hour to permanently add the spell on the page to her list of spells known. The spell must be of a level she can cast and must appear on her class spell list. Once used, the page becomes blank.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast the spell scribed on the page

Name: Pearl of Power (1st)
Description:
This seemingly normal pearl of average size and luster is a potent aid to all spellcasters who prepare spells. Once per day on command, a pearl of power enables the possessor to recall any one spell of a particular level that she had prepared and then cast that day. The spell is then prepared again, just as if it had not been cast.

The spell must be of a particular level, depending on the pearl. Different pearls exist for recalling one spell per day of each level from 1st through 9th and for the 0-level spells.

A pearl of power only functions for spells prepared by the possessor.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be recalled

Name: Preserving Flask (1st)
Description: This stoppered glass flask can hold a single 1st-level potion. Any potion placed within the flask does not lose potency over time and cannot be spoiled by environmental effects. A potion can remain within the flask indefinitely without degradation.

Name: Pyxes of Redirected Focus
Description: These small silver boxes are always found in pairs. When a spellcaster uses one pyx as a divine focus, she can designate the matching pyx as the spell’s origin point for the purpose of determining line of effect. Both pyxes must be on the same plane to function.

Name: Salve of Slipperiness
Description: This ointment grants the wearer the ability to slip free of restraints. When applied to the body, it grants a +20 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks for 8 hours. If applied to bonds, it immediately grants a new Escape Artist check with the +20 bonus to escape.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, freedom of movement

Name: Wasp Nest of Swarming
Description: When thrown as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet, this wasp nest shatters and releases a wasp swarm that attacks creatures in the area for 3 rounds. Afterward, the swarm disperses.

Name: Elixir of Fire Breath
Description: This elixir grants the imbiber the ability to breathe fire once within the next hour. The breath weapon deals 4d6 points of fire damage in a 15-foot cone (Reflex DC 14 half).

Name: Grave Salt
Description: When sprinkled on a corpse, this salt prevents it from being animated as undead for 24 hours. If used on undead, it deals 1d6 points of damage.

Name: Pipes of the Sewers
Description: These wooden panpipes can summon 1d3 rat swarms if played by a character with the Perform (wind instruments) skill. The rats are not under the control of the piper and attack anyone nearby. The pipes can be used once per day.

Name: Dust of Illusion
Description: This fine dust can be thrown into the air as a standard action. It creates a silent image effect (Will DC 13 disbelief) that lasts for 5 minutes.

Name: Goblin Skull Bomb
Description: This skull can be thrown as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet. On impact, it explodes in a 10-foot-radius burst dealing 3d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 14 half).

Name: Elixir of Dragon Breath
Description: This elixir grants the imbiber a single use of a breath weapon within 1 hour. The breath weapon deals 6d6 points of damage of a type determined when the elixir is created in a 30-foot line (Reflex DC 15 half).

Name: Bookmark of Deception
Description: This ornate bookmark can be placed within any book. Once per day as a standard action, the owner can cause the book to appear blank or filled with different text, as if using illusory script (Will DC 14 negates). The effect lasts for 24 hours.

Name: Word Bottle
Description: This stoppered glass bottle can capture a spoken word. When a creature speaks into the bottle as a standard action, the word is trapped inside. When the bottle is opened, the word is released and spoken aloud in the original speaker’s voice.

Name: Dust of Acid Consumption
Description: When thrown into acid, this dust neutralizes up to 10 cubic feet of acid and renders it harmless. If used against a creature composed of acid, it deals 2d6 points of damage (no save).

Name: Dust of Appearance
Description: This powder appears to be a very fine dust. When thrown into the air, it reveals invisible creatures and objects within a 10-foot radius for 5 minutes.

Name: Efficient Quiver
Description:
This appears to be a typical arrow container capable of holding about twenty arrows. It has three distinct portions. The first and smallest can contain up to 60 objects of the same general size and shape as an arrow. The second can contain up to 18 objects of the same general size and shape as a javelin. The third and longest can contain up to 6 objects of the same general size and shape as a bow, spear, or staff.

Once the owner has filled it, the quiver produces any item she wishes that is within it as a free action.

Name: Pipes of Sounding
Description: These wooden panpipes emit a loud, piercing sound when played. Once per day, the pipes can create a 30-foot cone of thunderous noise. Creatures in the area take 1d6 points of sonic damage (Fortitude DC 13 half) and are deafened for 1 round.

Name: Scabbard of Vigor
Description: A weapon stored in this scabbard for at least 1 minute gains a +1 enhancement bonus on damage rolls for 1 minute after being drawn. The scabbard can be used once per day.

Name: Agile Alpenstock
Description: This sturdy walking stick grants the wielder a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks while it is held. Once per day, the wielder can use it to gain a +10 enhancement bonus on a single Acrobatics or Climb check.

Name: Blood Reservoir of Physical Prowess
Description: This small glass vial is worn on a cord around the neck. When the wearer takes damage from a melee attack, the vial stores a portion of the spilled blood. As a swift action, the wearer can draw upon the stored blood to gain a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution for 1 round. The reservoir can be used once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, bear’s endurance

Name: Clamor Box
Description: This small wooden box can be opened as a standard action to create a cacophony of noise in a 20-foot radius for 5 rounds. Creatures in the area take a –2 penalty on Perception checks based on hearing.

Name: Dry Load Powder Horn
Description: This powder horn keeps black powder perfectly dry. Ammunition loaded from the horn cannot misfire due to moisture.

Name: Goblin Fire Drum
Description: When struck as a standard action, this drum releases a 10-foot-radius burst of fire centered on the drum. Creatures in the area take 2d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 14 half). The drum can be used once per day.

Name: Handy Haversack
Description:
A backpack of this sort appears to be well made, well used, and quite ordinary. It has two side pouches, each of which appears large enough to hold about a quart of material, and a central portion large enough to hold about 8 quarts. In fact, each side pouch can hold up to 2 cubic feet of material, while the central portion can contain up to 8 cubic feet.

No matter what is put into the haversack, the weight of the contents never exceeds 5 pounds. Retrieving a specific item from a handy haversack is always a move action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Name: Horn of Fog
Description: This small bugle allows its possessor to blow forth a thick cloud of heavy fog equal to that of an obscuring mist spell. The fog lasts for 1 minute. The horn can be used once per day.

Name: Iron Spike of Safe Passage
Description: When driven into the ground as a standard action, this iron spike creates a 10-foot-radius area that suppresses traps (magical and nonmagical) within its area for 10 minutes.

Name: Knight’s Pennon, Honor
Description: This small banner can be attached to a lance or similar weapon. While carried into battle, it grants the bearer a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

Name: Volatile Vaporizer (1st)
Description: This metal canister releases a cloud that functions as a stinking cloud spell affecting only creatures with 2 HD or fewer (Fortitude DC 14 negates). The effect lasts for 3 rounds. The vaporizer can be used once.

Name: Elemental Gem
Description: This gem contains a conjured elemental. When crushed, it summons a Large elemental of a specific type (air, earth, fire, or water) as if using summon monster V. The elemental remains for 11 rounds.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster V

Name: Flying Ointment
Description: When applied to a creature as a standard action, this ointment grants the ability to fly as the fly spell for 5 minutes (average maneuverability). The ointment is consumed when used.

Name: Sovereign Glue
Description: This pale amber substance is extremely adhesive. When applied, it forms an unbreakable bond between two surfaces. Only universal solvent can dissolve sovereign glue.

Name: Apple of Eternal Sleep
Description: This apple appears fresh and inviting. A creature that eats the apple must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or fall into a deep sleep as if affected by deep slumber. The sleep lasts until the creature is awakened by a break enchantment, dispel magic, or similar effect.

Name: Bag of Holding (Type I)
Description:
This appears to be a common cloth sack about 2 feet by 4 feet in size. The bag of holding opens into a nondimensional space. Type I can hold up to 250 pounds not exceeding a volume of 30 cubic feet.

If a bag of holding is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is ruined, and its contents are lost forever. If a bag of holding is placed within a portable hole, it creates a rift to the Astral Plane.

Name: Candle of Truth
Description: This white candle radiates a soft glow when lit. While it burns, creatures within 5 feet are affected as though by zone of truth (Will DC 13 negates). The candle burns for 1 hour.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, zone of truth

Name: Hexing Doll
Description: This small cloth doll can be attuned to a creature by incorporating a piece of the creature (such as hair or blood). Once attuned, the wielder can, once per day as a standard action, cause the target to take a –2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, and skill checks for 1 minute (Will DC 16 negates).

Name: Stone of Alarm
Description: This small stone can be placed upon the ground. When a creature other than the owner approaches within 10 feet, the stone emits a loud ringing noise as the alarm spell. The stone can be used once per day.

Name: Book of Extended Summoning, Standard
Description: This spellbook allows a spellcaster who prepares spells to extend the duration of one summon monster spell per day as though using the Extend Spell feat, without increasing the spell’s level. The spell extended can be up to 3rd level.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, Extend Spell, summon monster III

Name: Bead of Force
Description: This small black sphere can be thrown as a ranged attack with a range increment of 20 feet. On impact, it explodes in a 10-foot-radius burst, dealing 5d6 points of force damage (Reflex DC 16 half). Creatures that fail the save are also trapped within a resilient sphere for 1d3 rounds.

Name: Cauldron of Brewing
Description: This iron cauldron allows its user to brew potions as if she possessed the Brew Potion feat. The user must still meet the spell requirements for any potion brewed.

Name: Chime of Opening
Description: This hollow metal tube produces a clear chime when struck. When used, it casts knock upon a single lock or sealed portal within 30 feet. The chime can be used 10 times before it becomes inert.

Name: Philter of Love
Description: This potent draught causes the imbiber to become charmed by the first creature she sees after drinking it, as charm monster (Will DC 16 negates). The effect lasts for 1 hour.

Name: Rope of Climbing
Description: A 60-foot-long rope that is no thicker than a wand, this rope can be commanded to move as desired. It can tie itself securely, coil itself up, and move at a speed of 10 feet per round. It has hardness 10 and 20 hit points.

Name: Volatile Vaporizer (2nd)
Description: This metal canister releases a cloud that functions as a stinking cloud spell affecting only creatures with 4 HD or fewer (Fortitude DC 15 negates). The effect lasts for 5 rounds. The vaporizer can be used once.

Name: Shroud of Disintegration
Description: When placed over a corpse, this burial shroud causes the body to disintegrate as if affected by disintegrate. The body is reduced to fine dust.

Name: Bag of Tricks, Gray
Description: This small sack appears normal. When a creature reaches inside and pulls out a fuzzy object, it transforms into a living animal as if using summon monster IV. The bag can be used three times per week.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster IV

Name: Dust of Disappearance
Description: This powder appears to be a very fine dust. When thrown into the air, it coats creatures and objects in a 10-foot radius, rendering them invisible as if affected by invisibility for 5 minutes.

Name: Dust of Weighty Burdens
Description: When thrown into the air, this gray dust settles on creatures in a 10-foot-radius burst. Affected creatures treat their carried load as one category heavier for 10 minutes (Fortitude DC 15 negates).

Name: Noble’s Vigilant Pillbox
Description: This ornate pillbox contains small herbal tablets. When one is consumed as a standard action, the user gains a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks for 1 hour. The pillbox contains three tablets per day.

Name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Silver Raven)
Description: This tiny silver statuette can transform into a raven. The raven can speak one language known by its owner and serves as a faithful companion. It can be used once per day for up to 24 hours.

Name: Volatile Vaporizer (3rd)
Description: This metal canister releases a cloud that functions as a stinking cloud spell affecting only creatures with 6 HD or fewer (Fortitude DC 16 negates). The effect lasts for 7 rounds. The vaporizer can be used once.

Name: Sleeves of Many Garments
Description: These translucent cloth tubes easily fit over their wearer’s arms. The wearer of these sleeves can, when she slips them on, choose to transform the appearance of her current garments into any other nonmagical set of clothing. These new clothes fit her perfectly and are always clean and mended unless she specifically designates otherwise. When she removes the sleeves, her clothes revert to their original form.

Name: Armbands of the Brawler
Description: These scarred and worn armbands have clearly seen rough use, and are constructed out of coarse leather and fastened with thick leather straps. They grant their wearer a +1 competence bonus on grapple checks and checks to break a grapple.

Name: Bracers of Armor (+1)
Description:
These items appear to be wrist or arm guards, sometimes etched with symbols of protection or depictions of vigilant-looking animals. Bracers of armor surround the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting him an armor bonus of +1 to +8, just as though he were wearing armor. Both bracers of armor must be worn for the magic to be effective.
Alternatively, bracers of armor can be enchanted with armor special abilities. See Table 3–3: Armor Special Abilities for a list of abilities. Special abilities usually count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of an item, but do not improve AC. Bracers of armor cannot have a modified bonus (armor bonus plus armor special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +8. Bracers of armor must have at least a +1 armor bonus to grant an armor special ability.
Bracers of armor cannot have any armor special abilities that add a flat gp amount to their cost. Bracers of armor and ordinary armor do not stack. If the wearer receives a larger armor bonus from another source, the bracers of armor cease functioning and do not grant their armor bonus or their armor special abilities. If the bracers of armor grant a larger armor bonus, the other source of armor ceases functioning.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, mage armor, creator’s caster level must be at least two times that of the bonus placed on the bracers, plus any requirements of the armor special abilities

Name: Burglar's Bracers
Description: On command, these plain leather bracers can transform into a set of masterwork thieves’ tools. They can transform back to their bracer form with another such command. Once per day, while using these thieves’ tools or wearing these bracers, the user can take 10 on a single Disable Device check, even when in immediate danger or distracted.

Name: Bracers of Steadiness
Description: These tortoise-shell bracers fit so snuggly against their wearer’s skin that they almost seem part of him. The wearer of these bracers becomes exceptionally calm and composed if she takes her time to accomplish particular tasks. Whenever she takes 20 on a skill check for a skill that primarily depends on her arms and hands, she gains a +5 competence bonus on the check.

Name: Manacles of Cooperation
Description: These tight iron cuffs can fit over the wrists of any Large or smaller humanoid. When placed on a helpless humanoid, they make the captive more docile and compliant. The prisoner never attempts to escape of its own volition and agrees to any reasonable request unless it succeeds at a DC 11 Will saving throw.

Name: Shackles of Compliance
Description:
These battered iron manacles are typically found with a small spiked iron key in one of the locks. The shackles magically adjust themselves to fit around the wrists of any creature from Small to Large size and automatically lock. A creature wearing shackles of compliance becomes more susceptible to intimidation. Any creature attempting to intimidate or demoralize a target wearing shackles of compliance gains a +4 bonus on Intimidate checks.
In addition, the holder of the manacles’ key can cast command (DC 25 Will) on the wearer of the shackles three times per day.
Shackles of compliance have hardness 10 and 10 hit points, and a DC 30 Disable Device check is required to pick the shackles’ lock. A manacled creature can break free with a DC 28 Strength check or DC 35 Escape Artist check. The manacles lock can be opened with a DC 30 Disable Device check.

Name: Phylactery of Faithfulness
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 250, Core Rulebook pg. 520
Description: This item is a small silver box attached to a leather cord. It warns the wearer of actions that would violate his alignment. The phylactery functions continuously and automatically. If the wearer intends to perform an action that would cause him to violate his alignment, he receives a mental warning that doing so would violate his alignment.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Wondrous Item, detect evil, detect good, detect chaos, detect law

Name: Dead Man’s Headband
Description: This leather headband is adorned with a small skull charm. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on saving throws against fear effects. Once per day, when the wearer is reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, he can remain conscious and continue acting as if disabled for 1 round before falling unconscious.

Name: Metamagic Rod, Bouncing (Lesser)
Description: This lesser metamagic rod allows the wielder to apply the Bouncing Spell metamagic feat to spells of 3rd level or lower without increasing the spell’s casting time or spell level. The rod can be used 3 times per day.
